chapters.title: Chapter 3180 Existential Terraforming! III
paragraphs: An Existential Modulator.
A King.
An Emperor.
A Hero.
A Villain.
Noah had been many things in his short life, and today, it seemed like he would simply be taking on another role!

He sat on the multicolored throne made of pure Authorities of his vast Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as this construct itself...took on the role of a few thousand automated Synthetic Existences.
Among the many authorities, Relativity rose up with grandiosity as along with Manadynamics that had its tendrils across every stretch of energy- all things were seen as strings and waves.
"Take from my authority."
Noah spoke about grandly as his Body vibrated, the colorless authority of the Laborer rising from him like conscious mobile tendrils of snakes.
With his connection to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, he had it take reigns in terms of directing this authority as it took on the role of Existential Nuclear Fusion!

To take on two weavings of Existence of a part of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and fuse them, but just before they fully fused...have them split under the process of Existential Nuclear Fission and use the output of energy produced to end up with four weavings of Existence instead of the initial two.
|We shall start with Dreams.|
Dreams.

The Aletheian Haven of Dreams stood towards the very bottom of the massive Extremity Vein that was in the form of an Infinity symbol, but its location changed as it gravitated around this Extremity Vein over time.
As a Haven, its size was already massive. Its sandy gold brilliance stretched out for countless light years!
And yet at this moment, the makeup of the countless dreamy gold sands began to tremble.
Fusion.
And then Fission.
Truly, all that anyone could have possibly seen was a mere flash of colorless brilliance as in the next moment, the landscape of the Dream Aletheian Haven stretched out and enlarged!
Its concentration of this Existential Extremity Authority began to increase rapidly.
Golden brilliance flourished!
|Existential Terraforming has been successfully initiated in the Dream Aletheian Haven.|

In a far distance, seated on a colorful throne, Noah's body freely gushed out endless waves of mana that were channeled to bathe over the lands being Terraformed- his face not even showing tiredness or sweat!
No Synthetic Existences were needed.
No Existential Modulator from the Commonwealth was required!
|The concentration of the Existential Extremity Authority of Dreams is rapidly scaling upwards.|
The first Haven's progress was monitored.
And once nothing wrong was observed...
"Proceed with the Terraforming of other Havens."
Noah gave the command as his eyes radiated brightness.

His Atlas of Existence spun within the depths of himself as more Authority of the Laborer was pulled out, the First Mundi of Power that contained the Sources of all past Natural Laws, Decreta, and Havens beginning to pulse- the changes occurring being reflected here as well!
|The Process of Existential Terraforming has been initiated for the Aletheian Haven of Apollyon.|
|The Process of Existential Terraforming has been initiated for the Aletheian Haven of Fantasia.|
|The Process of Existential Terraforming has been initiated for the Aletheian Haven of Quantum.|
|The Process...|
One after another.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed proceeded forward boldly as endlessly, interminable waves of Mana continued to gush out from Noah to stabilize everything.
It was at this point that all across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
All across the Infinity symbol of the Extremity Vein that had Havens gravitating around it, and even inside of the Extremity Haven for the Haven budding within!
The potency of authority exploded.
The level of Existence was forcefully being elevated!
And this meant...
|Multiple Authorities are taking the step to become Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities.|
|The general level of Existence of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed is increasing.|
It was a thorough elevation.
It wasn't only the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that benefitted as Noah's own Source of Existence within his Atlas benefitted from the expansion and acceleration of Existence!
He closed his eyes.
On the Multicolored throne, his Wings stretched out brilliantly as if they could cover everything.
His lungs pulsed.
His heart beat.
And his eyes swirled with endless darkness.
He recalled the image of the floating Spiritual Land floating in the Beast World.
He recalled the Emperor Penguin within and the trials he had undergone.
He recalled where this grand construct of his had come from as he truly couldn't say where it would end up.
All he knew was that on this day, it would make yet another jump.
Before, he had to devour and eat up the place he was in for it to continue its rise.
He devoured Worlds, Universes, Cosmos, and Planes of Existence to reach these levels themselves.
He ate up the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains to further solidify its existence!
But thereafter, there wasn't a rampage of devouring.
And now, its advancement was purely from its own expansion of authority!
HUUM!

Tremendous storms of power surged as Noah opened his eyes to see the manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed clasping her hands on her chest, her figure scattering into waves of light as her intent flowed out.
|The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed has reached a critical level of Existence.|
|The weavings of Ascendancy have allowed the single Pillars of Existence supporting the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed to emulate the power of thousands.|
|As the Breadth of their Existence increases and they climb higher on the phases of Ascendancy, the emulated power will only increase.|
|The Authorities supporting the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed have met the requirements to officially advance it to the next stage.|
|Shall we proceed, Master?|
On the throne he sat on, Noah breathed out lightly.
He could see glimpses of the future, yes.
He didn't know what it held, but he knew that there would be boundless possible brilliance for him to discover.
So even with the profound enemies ahead.
Even with the advent of something not yet entirely understood.
He would continue his steady steps forward.
"Proceed."
He gave the command.
And...
|The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed has begun its elevation towards a Young Omniverse.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3181 Existential Terraforming! IV
paragraphs: Within Noah's home.
In a small village.
Children moved around busily as a few formed a circle that was kicking around a ball of mana- the goal being to keep it in the air for as long as possible.
Around the village, multiple plots cultivated with vibrant plants could be seen, this reality being one of serenity and happiness.
Near one of the plots around the village, a young woman with dazzling white hair and blue eyes sat down, her fingers digging into the earth below her as she smiled.
"Rising concentration of Existential Extremity Authorities, and..."
BZZT!
She felt the plot she was near vibrating as, a moment later, another one just like it appeared from a stretched earth, vibrant authority gushing from it as if existence here had been duplicated.

The kids playing within the village and the men and women toiling around stopped in shock, the ball of mana the kids had been kicking in the air falling down as it multiplied into multiple balls of light!
Towards the people beginning to look around at what was happening with curiosity...
"It's okay."
The white haired young woman spoke as she was none other than Sophia.
The past Guide of the Blue Planet from what seemed like eons ago.

She smiled as she gazed towards the distant blue skies that had arcs of Mana coursing through them, the faint connection she held allowing her to sense what was coming more than others as she continued.
"It's just another jump forward for our home."
Another jump forward.
Another step.
Towards what...even she didn't know!

She was among the trillions and quintillions of existences in various stretches of Aletheian Havens who began to feel rising atmospheric authority along with bursts of brilliance that they could only assume were the results behind the actions of their great Emperor.
|An Omniverse is structured and kept together by a high tier set of rules- of weavings of Existence that allow the stability of life across it.|
|The Greater the number of Existential Extremity Authorities weaving together to form Omniversal Authorities, the more stable an Omniverse becomes.|
|The weavings of Manadynamics lead the way forward the first Omniversal Authority of the budding Infinite Omniverse.|
It burned with a heavy light of Ascendancy as even Manadynamics alone held the weight of hundreds of thousands of Existential Extremity Authorities.
Entropy was the same.
Continuity was the same.
Dreams was the same!
A select few representing many- they spearheaded the path forward as at this time.
The Infinity symbol that was the Extremity Vein pulsed while beginning to course with interminable cerulean brilliance.
|The Unranked Omniversal Authority of Weorold is coming to fruition.|
The first Omniversal Authority of the Infinite Omniverse.
No longer an Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, it became something else as it distinguished itself as a Young Omniverse!
Barely risen, with its first Omniversal Authority born as it was made of a few dozen Existential Extremity Authorities that held the weight of millions when put together.
And as Existential Terraforming continued.

As the Breadth of Existence and potency of the Existential Extremity Authorities continued to be expanded... Frankly, the elevation of Authorities across the Phases of Ascendancy was going to be much faster and easier for the Infinite Omniverse with continued Terraforming- with its pace likely exceeding Noah's progress with Quintessence and the Protagonist!
But since the very Sources of all elevated extremes, even in the Infinite Omniverse, were bound to Noah...he received all the glorious benefits.

So much so that at this time, his First Mundi of Power seethed with heavy brilliance, millions of snake like colorless tendrils of the Authority of the Laborer being produced as the weight of Existence he emanated became that much heavier!

|The Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence has become even more potent, the Source of the Conceptual System of Existence exceeding all other assimilated Systems of Existence within the First Mundi of Power by a Quintessential margin.|

|The assimilated System of Existence of Opulentia has caused the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence to further increase in potency as the wealth under your banner has significantly increased in value!|
His whole Existence became suffered with brilliance as across the weavings of spacetime, he remained seated on his throne!

His eyes crackled with tendrils of colorless brilliance as they observed weavings of the Unranked Omniversal Authority of Weorold come together from all directions- this Authority including all the Pillars of Existence that kept up the Infinite Omniverse along with Noah's own Existential Extremity Authorities.
It all converged into a single central figure of a woman formed from pure authority, her eyes being blazing white brilliance as the moment she was formed, she kneeled towards Noah.
|Master.|
|The features of the Infinite Omniverse are experiencing a Quintessential elevation as we step into the stage of a genuine Omniverse.|
Her monotone voice held a terrifying presence and authority at this moment as she continued.
|New Authorities have also come to fruition.|
|The feature of Omniversal Expedition has come to fruition.|
HUUM!

|With undefined limitations, the Infinite Omniverse is now capable of warping its Omniversal Signature of Existence and releasing its markings that search for other Omniversal Signatures of Existence. Once discovered, it is possible to traverse across the markings of the Omniversal Signatures to arrive into a different Omniverse.|
The capability to traverse into another Omniverse.
Towards other Sources of Existence!
Neye's eyes burned with a brilliant colorless light as this boon was worthy of being among the first to arise after the advent of the Infinite Omniverse.
He didn't know much about the Commonwealth, but he could understand that the main reason for their power was their capability to discover and bring under their banner new Omniverses.
If the words and actions of the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales remain true, there was tremendous power to be found in monopolizing and colonizing Omniverses.
As for Noah...there was also the study of other Sources of Existence for his Atlas!

chapters.title: Chapter 3182 Existential Terraforming! V
paragraphs: The feature of Omniversal Expedition!
Noah looked forward to the products of this feature as he gave the command.
"Begin releasing the markings of our Omniversal Signature of Existence. Let's see if we can discover any other Signatures in the near future."
They didn't know how long it would take. It could be within a matter of seconds that they discover another signature, or it may take days!
The Infinite Omniverse moved fast while still overseeing the Existential Terraforming of all Havens.
|The Signature of the Infinite Omniverse has begun to spread across Existence.|
|The Omniversal Signature of Existence of the Omniverse the Infinite Omniverse is currently in has been recorded.|
The Natal Omniverse Noah was in was recorded right away.
And after that...a glorious search began.
|The Feature of Omniversal Authority generation has come to fruition.|

|Apart from current Pillars of Existence, abstruse Existential Extremity Authorities will be formed and have their weavings connected to further strengthen the Unranked Omniversal Authority of Weorold.|
|The stability of the Infinite Omniverse will only continue to increase as none of the possible negatives of Existential Terraforming will be applicable to it.|
|The feature of Nuclear Omniversal Weapons Generation has been born.|

|Spearheaded by Entropy, Relativity, Manadynamics, Weak Nuclear Force, and Strong Nuclear Force among others, the feature of Nuclear Omniversal Weapons Generation seeks to focus on the negative aspect of Existential Terraforming and exploit it. It seeks to create Weapons that cause for an unstable weaving of Existence to be initiated in specific areas for effects of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction. If successful, portions of entire Omniverses or even an entire Omniverse could be erased by the successful targeted attack of a Nuclear Omniversal Weapon that cause the very weavings of Existence to unravel and decay- decimating all life and forms of Existence within it.|
An unbreakable heavy feature came to fruition.

They were tapping into Nuclear Fusion and Nuclear Fission as this process of expanding and accelerating Existence had negatives if done wrong...and the Infinite Omniverse designed a feature to specifically study these possible wrongs.
To possibly Weaponize these wrongs into a deadly form of attack!
Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.
Even Entities at the vast Autarchical Stage or equivalent would be affected as they all held weavings of Existence.
Noah reviewed the continued details of this feature as he was forced to pause at it, gazing towards the manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse as he voiced out calmly.
"Be careful with this."
|Of course, Master.|
He may not have even needed to say it.
The smaller mistake could cause weavings of their own Existence in the Infinite Omniverse to unravel!
But the Infinite Omniverse was too fantastical in its capabilities. He knew that there should be no reason to worry.
The Infinite Omniverse had just come to be.
Its boons were just beginning!
As for the one who made the theory of all of this possible...her figure was currently evaluating the continued Terraforming of Cappadocia and the region around it.
Within Cappadocia.
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales sighed as she looked at the tablet in her hands.

"I've talked too much already. Things seem to be proceeding smoothly here as the Terraforming of the other two locations should be the same. The waves of change will spread from all three points of Terraforming as once they connect, the whole Omniverse will be further catalyzed and accelerated towards a more potent Existence. During this time...|
The tablet on her hand glowed as she tapped on it and allowed it to float upwards- a brilliant light shooting from it and showing an illusory scene above.

|I am also one of the messengers to the major forces of this Omniverse to let you know that as Existential Terraforming is underway, the Commonwealth has a formal event to introduce the locals to the new arrivals of their Omniverse...to foster some understanding and kinship. For this, the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery is held.|

Above the spinning tablet, the illusory scene of a massive golden trophy could be seen- an interminable Wheel painted on the sides of this trophy as the illusory figure of a monkey-like Existence burning with crimson gold fur was holding up this trophy gloriously!
The Empress of the Orcanium Whales saw the raised brows of Noah and Eckert in the distance as she harrumphed.

"I am very much serious. Protectors of the Commonwealth will be there along with the Architects that will be designing the Omniversal Constructs in this Omniverse, and of course...lucky Citizens of the Commonwealth who were granted an Omniversal Visitation Ticket to observe a newly discovered Omniverse and the myriad of Sources of Existence that will participate in this Celebration of Omniversal Discovery."
Cerulean flames burned around her figure as the tablet floating above returned to her, her fingers tapping out and releasing two balls of light toward Noah and Eckert.

"Details and location are included within. I believe the first Omniversal Construct of the Commonwealth has been completed at the point of Entry of the First Protector to arrive at, so you all can select however many of your people will witness the Commonwealth and this new unfolding era for your Omniverse...or not attend and be the first to offend them. Your choice."
Noah grabbed the bundle of information as he nodded towards her.
"And you?"

"Me? I have to now oversee the fruits of my labor and ensure the smooth continuity of Existential Terraforming. If I leave it alone and anything goes wrong, the effects could be catastrophic." The Empress tapped her feet as a sea of blue flames bloomed below her.
A body of water made of paradoxical flames was quickly formed as she submerged into it, sitting in a meditative pose beside the massive trunk of the Existential Modulator in the form of a tree.

Her words made Noah think of the feature of Nuclear Omniversal Weapons Generation and the types of weapons that the Infinite Omniverse wanted to build that would carry out the exact catastrophe that the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales wanted to prevent!

They were tapping into Nuclear Fusion and Nuclear Fission as this process of expanding and accelerating Existence had negatives if done wrong...and the Infinite Omniverse designed a feature to specifically study these possible wrongs.
To possibly Weaponize these wrongs into a deadly form of attack!
Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.
Even Entities at the vast Autarchical Stage or equivalent would be affected as they all held weavings of Existence.
Noah reviewed the continued details of this feature as he was forced to pause at it, gazing towards the manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse as he voiced out calmly.
"Be careful with this."
|Of course, Master.|
He may not have even needed to say it.
The smaller mistake could cause weavings of their own Existence in the Infinite Omniverse to unravel!
But the Infinite Omniverse was too fantastical in its capabilities.
He knew that there should be no reason to worry.
The Infinite Omniverse had just come to be.
Its boons were just beginning!
As for the one who made the theory of all of this possible...her figure was currently evaluating the continued Terraforming of Cappadocia and the region around it.
Within Cappadocia.
The Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales sighed as she looked at the tablet in her hands.
"I've talked too much already.
Things seem to be proceeding smoothly here as the Terraforming of the other two locations should be the same.
The waves of change will spread from all three points of Terraforming as once they connect, the whole Omniverse will be further catalyzed and accelerated towards a more potent Existence.
During this time...|
The tablet on her hand glowed as she tapped on it and allowed it to float upwards- a brilliant light shooting from it and showing an illusory scene above.

|I am also one of the messengers to the major forces of this Omniverse to let you know that as Existential Terraforming is underway, the Commonwealth has a formal event to introduce the locals to the new arrivals of their Omniverse...to foster some understanding and kinship.
For this, the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery is held.|

Above the spinning tablet, the illusory scene of a massive golden trophy could be seen- an interminable Wheel painted on the sides of this trophy as the illusory figure of a monkey-like Existence burning with crimson gold fur was holding up this trophy gloriously!
The Empress of the Orcanium Whales saw the raised brows of Noah and Eckert in the distance as she harrumphed.
"I am very much serious.

Protectors of the Commonwealth will be there along with the Architects that will be designing the Omniversal Constructs in this Omniverse, and of course...lucky Citizens of the Commonwealth who were granted an Omniversal Visitation Ticket to observe a newly discovered Omniverse and the myriad of Sources of Existence that will participate in this Celebration of Omniversal Discovery."
Cerulean flames burned around her figure as the tablet floating above returned to her, her fingers tapping out and releasing two balls of light toward Noah and Eckert.
"Details and location are included within.

I believe the first Omniversal Construct of the Commonwealth has been completed at the point of Entry of the First Protector to arrive at, so you all can select however many of your people will witness the Commonwealth and this new unfolding era for your Omniverse...or not attend and be the first to offend them.
Your choice."
Noah grabbed the bundle of information as he nodded towards her.
"And you?"
"Me?
I have to now oversee the fruits of my labor and ensure the smooth continuity of Existential Terraforming.
If I leave it alone and anything goes wrong, the effects could be catastrophic." The Empress tapped her feet as a sea of blue flames bloomed below her.
A body of water made of paradoxical flames was quickly formed as she submerged into it, sitting in a meditative pose beside the massive trunk of the Existential Modulator in the form of a tree.

Her words made Noah think of the feature of Nuclear Omniversal Weapons Generation and the types of weapons that the Infinite Omniverse wanted to build that would carry out the exact catastrophe that the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales wanted to prevent!

chapters.title: Chapter 3183 Existential Terraforming! VI
paragraphs: Her ideas made way for Noah to begin Terraforming himself, and the biggest negative she wanted to prevent was something that Noah was already studying how to induce it.
It was a terrifying set of actions if ever she found out about it, but her current actions were also ones that spoke about a new reality that was unfolding right in front of them.
Her action of Terraforming followed by her remaining fully situated in this place.
It was an action representative of many things, but one thing was clear.
And Noah gazed towards Eckert as the two of them shared the same gaze of understanding.
The main action this represented was that truly, Cappadocia was no longer under the banner of the natives of this Omniverse.
This applied to Cappadocia today, and it would apply to many places in the near future as the Existential Terraforming continued.
So truly...how would they triumph against the Commonwealth in the future to come?

A challenging question with no answer, but Noah calmly looked forward to the future as his body split into two in the next moment- one shooting towards the direction that should be the first Entry Point of Protector Antonio while his other body...

"You wouldn't mind if I continued to talk to you from one Citizen of the Commonwealth to another, right? I want to know of any connection there is, if any, between the Worms of Existence and the Commonwealth."
More information on the Commonwealth.
The Empress of the Orcanium Whales here was more talkative than anyone Noah had met...so why not milk her for some more information?

And even this Celebration Omniversal Discovery where the forces of the Commonwealth would be showing themselves along with multiple Entities from all sorts of walks of Existence...all of it was akin to a research paradise for Noah who was looking to fill up his Atlas of Existence!
He looked forward to it.

At the same time, the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Manadynamics burned around him to create a cerulean sea the same size as the Empress, his figure becoming surrounded by it as he looked out with interest.
The Empress of the Orcanium Whales looked at him silently before her lips parted to open.

"Right. As fellow Citizens...well, this information isn't something regulated as you would come to know sooner or later. The Worms of Existence...are a form of Anti-Existence prevalent across the Omniverses."
In her sea of flames.
She seemed to be recalling distant memories as the sea of flames around her undulated- her figure filled with a unique sense of beauty as she continued.

"Your Omniverse has the initial stages of their infection, with Neonatal Worms of Existence beginning to eat up your Omniverse as such an infection is reversible. The Commonwealth has been eradicating Worms of Existence for as long as history has been preserved, with the constant cycles making them extremely perceptive to each other as where the Commonwealth goes, the Worms of Existence follow. And wherever the Worms of Existence go...there is a high likelihood for the Commonwealth to also discover them and follow."
The Commonwealth had been fighting Worms of Existence since history began to be recorded!

"Right now, at their Neonatal Stage, the Worms of Existence are extremely perceptive to threats that can eradicate them as they will likely hide and continue their infection through the gaps of Existence within this Omniverse. To locate them, the Protectors will likely utilize Synthetic Existences to track them down before they take action. If the infection had advanced with these Worms of Existence Devouring a large portion of this Omniverse...the trouble that comes with that is something you cannot even imagine."
Her eyes burned with a somber tone as she spoke about this, Noah nodding with interest as in the far distance, the figure of Eckert had a thoughtful expression!
Eckert had many of those he subjugated devoured by the Worms of Existence as his Will had been inside of them more times than he could count before it was broken down.

Recalling every sensation of destruction he felt and the fact that these Worms of Existence were only in their initial stages while being a massive threat to this so called Commonwealth for countless eons...if he could somehow subjugate any of them before his Will was destroyed...
A blooming idea.

And one that the Great Usurper did not waste any time on before he began to enact it as while he also absorbed new waves of information from the Empress of the Orcanium Whales, his Will stretched out across tens of thousands of Imperium forces began to move.
In the flaming blue sea, The Empress of the Orcanium Whales seemed to have sensed something as she briefly turned her gaze towards Eckert's direction before she continued.

"The Commonwealth arriving here allows for this infection of Worms of Existence to stop, and eventually be eradicated in time. Any hostility you all may have against the Commonwealth should be dulled down greatly with such a reality, yes?"
The Protectors.
Their name held meaning as they fought on the front lines against enemies that wished to devour all of Existence.

Noah smiled at such a notion as he continued to talk to the Empress of the Orcanium Whales, his other body arriving at the point within this Omniverse where the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery should be taking place.
Iridescent.
This was the single best word to describe what used to be a dark point in a corner of the Omniverse with no signs of life.
Yet at this moment, it was shining unfathomably bright as massive golden Pillars burning with flames acted like beacons lighting everything up.
And they floated like celestial candles as they encircled a massive circular construct that seemed to be in the form of a Wheel!

Noah appeared in this region as his eyes squinted at the massive construct that exceeded the size of many Existential Domains, its golden brilliance painted with a crimson hue making it look like an object that no normal entity could ever construct.

The construct in the form of a Wheel held too many intricate designs to count, but there was a wide entrance at its very center where, at this moment, millions of auras of other beings could already be felt!

chapters.title: Chapter 3184 The Commonwealth! I
paragraphs: It was not still.

The massive Wheel spun gloriously as it radiated pulses of golden light towards the surroundings- Noah feeling these waves even from a distance as they seemed to be enriching all surrounding forms of Existence.
|You have entered an area of an Existential Domain with Absolute effects.|
|The Existential Ruling of the Wheel of Weaving seeks to impose itself on your Existence.|
|Your Source of Existence will circulate 20% faster in this domain, its expansion and strengthening further increased by 50%|
|In addition to this, the marking of the Wheel of Weaving will be applied to your current Existence- its location and status being constantly recorded.|
A boon and a tracking feature to come along with it.
Noah's eyes shone brightly as he began to analyze everything while floating closer towards the incandescent Wheel.

The massive pillars of crimson gold light that seemed to be like torches lit up everything as even from afar- Noah could see the monkey like figures in the millions floating towards the center of the Wheel.
The moment he neared.
Or truly, it was the moment the waves of golden light pulsing from the Wheel touched him.
Many auras gazed towards his direction as if they knew.
This was because moments later...
WAP!
A figure warped before his eyes.

White gold fur. A humanoid monkey face. A vibrant gold tail. The features weren't as regal or oppressive as Protector Antonio's, but this being held their own charm as they smiled and spoke toward Noah!
"You must be one of the Prime Citizens of this Omniverse. I shall be your Guide to the Commonwealth and this glorious Celebration of Omniversal Discovery. Please..."
The Guide pointed towards the pulsing Wheel of Weaving as Noah floated in freely while asking.
"Prime Citizen?"

"Mmm, any leader of the Factions of the newly discovered Omniverse gets this perk that allows you much more leeway and freedom across the workings of the Commonwealth. Observing your figure and based on the information passed down...you must be Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont?"

An air of profound confidence burned within the Guide as he spoke, Noah sensing tendrils of Authority equivalent to the stage of Autarchy from this being as his Source of Existence was still not easy to discern!
"That would be me. Is it protocol for millions of entrants to come into a newly discovered Omniverse" Noah's eyes were locked onto the scenes around the Wheel of Weavings as he asked.
Beside him, the Guide let out a smile as he shook his head.

"Only for large Omniverses filled with high levels of Existence and potential. More join in with the festivities of the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery as every time this occurs, a show gets to be put on for Entities from a variety of different Sources of Existence to express themselves. The main attraction of the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery- The Gladiators of the Omniverses!"
WAA!
The Gladiators of the Omniverses.
Literal sparks and waves of golden brilliance burst from the mouth of the Guide as he said these words.

"Those who are victorious and achieve high rankings as Gladiators of Omniverses...get to enjoy and revel in the Vaults of the Commonwealth as they can further propel their Existence forward. But to attain any high ranking and distinction, one must attain victory over multiple Entities with different Sources of Existence. Conceptual Systems of Existence like yours make up the majority, but then you have the variety of Existence coming in, as there are those with different Sources of Existence that you can only experience to understand. Overcome them and prove your System of Existence...and glory lies ahead."
A chance to fight against other Entities from different Sources of Existence!
If outstanding enough, one could receive a high ranking that allowed them access to the Vaults of the Commonwealth.
Noah gazed at the Guide and the auras of many entities far ahead as he had to say it.
The Commonwealth were invaders, but they were truly good at what they did.

They invaded and began taking taking over and Omniverse, and yet every part of their approach made it seem like they were saving the Omniverse from a grave danger as thereafter...they were doing everything they could to include it in a more massive civilization!
"Please..."

They arrived at the massive entry point of the construct in the form of a wheel, this entry point alone being the size of a Cosmos as hundreds of thousands of uniquely designed vessels were already floating and moving around it.
Within them, Entities adorned in regal dresses and clothing at the Teracosm and Paracosm Equivalent Stages could be discerned, their eyes bright as if they were about to set off to visit a zoo.
Many rose their wills to observe Noah as if he had a marking above him that stated he was a native!
Seeing this scene, the Guide smiled as he took them in while explaining.
"The Citizens of the Commonwealth love nothing more than connecting with others of different Existences. Of course, matches of the Gladiators Omniverses also draw in a lot of us..."
As the Guide spoke, Noah fully entered the Wheel of Weavings as within it, it felt like one had stepped into an entirely different reality.

All sound seemed cut off as in the far distance, a massive golden portal could be seen to the left where Vessels constantly streamed out of- its weavings immeasurably stable as it was an established connection between this Omniverse and another.
And to the right...was something radiant with a crimson and golden glow that could only be described as a coliseum from pure dreams and fantasy!
"The Gladiators' Arena."
The Guide spoke succinctly as the aura of Autarchical Equivalent entities...could be felt towards that direction the most.
"The place that will be the center of all activities. Come, Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont, and let me show you the wonders of the Commonwealth."
Their figures warped towards the Gladiators' Arena, Noah keeping a close eye on everything as amidst all of this showy exterior, his inquisitive mind could see many things that were never explained!

chapters.title: Chapter 3185 The Commonwealth! II
paragraphs: Of the massive Wheel of Weavings he had seen, the entrance alone led one into an area where they could see a portal to the left where the forces of the Commonwealth were coming from, and the Gladiators' Arena to the right where the bulk of the festivities would be taking place.
But these were only relatively small parts of the Wheel of Weavings.
This construct was massive as what was the purpose of all the intricately designed areas apart from this Gladiators' Arena and iridescent golden portal?
The mind of the Weaver of Existence buzzed.
A part of itself was sectioned off from Noah and left behind, the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence wrapping around it as it stayed behind.
It was time to discover just what else this massive construct of the Commonwealth held, Noah's will silently melding into the weavings of existence in the surroundings and shooting upwards!
At the same time, his body arrived at the entry point of the Gladiators' Arena, stepping through wide crimson doors as alongside them, Entities with different variations could be seen.
Many had a monkey-like humanoid physiology, their fur variations of gold, crimson, white, and even black as they were adorned in similar armaments and clothing.
Others were more similar to Noah in their humanoid appearance, and figures of a few Entities that were ten times bigger compared to others here could also be seen.

Many of them were at the Teracosm and Paracosm Stage as it was only after passing through the crimson doors...did Noah's eyes capture the aura of Autarchical Equivalent Entities he had felt from a distance.
The first point of Entry within the Gladiators' Arena showed a long extended walkway lined with golden stones, and to its left and right...a variety of what looked like stores were set up.
Dazzling armaments radiating profound waves of Existence.
Vessels put on display.
And towards the far end, there was even a taller building that many people were going in and out of that had the inscription of [Tavern of Existence] above its doors.

"Delicacies, Armaments, and various forms of entertainment can be found within the Gladiators' Arena, with other areas even holding Domains with distorted weavings of Time and Existence. An hour within such Domains would only be 30 minutes out here, and the concentration of the Weavings of Existence are much more potent for Cultivation. One has to pay to gain access to it, and currency is of course...anything that is born from an Omniverse that is conducive to the promotion of Existence."
Currency.

When they got to this point, Noah gazed over the establishments with Teleios, Teracosm, and Paracosm Stage Entities overseeing them as they held Armaments of Existence shimmering with multicolored radiance among other things.
Within him, the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence buzzed as he evaluated many things before he sought to...release the bait.
He waved his hand to materialize a golden Quintessential Fruit of Existence as he asked.
"Currency like this?"
The mere wave of his hand caused the Guide's eyes to open wide as he reached out to clasp the golden Quintessential Fruit of Existence in his hands.
It was born from the Aletheian Haven of Elysium as liquid gold light surrounded its surface, a potent aura leaking from it as it even caused a few eyes in the surroundings to turn over!

"This purity of Existence...this potency...even I can make small advancements if I eat up enough of these..." The Guide brought the Quintessential Fruit of Existence to his nose and smelled as his eyes simmered with brightness thereafter.
"A single one of these would be equivalent to upwards of 1,000 Units of the Wheel..."
The Wheel.
The Currency of the Commonwealth!
The eyes of the Guide turned towards Noah as they held a fervent light within them at this moment as he asked.
"Are these the Fruits born naturally within Existential Domains in this Omniverse? Are they all like this?"
His eyes seemed to be burning with brilliance as he asked! And Noah looked at this scene with a silent smile as he replied.
"Some areas produce something like this, some areas don't. With the Terraforming you all are doing..."

The eyes of the Guide opened in surprise. "You know of that? Hmm, yes. May I keep this? In exchange, I will introduce to you the Tavern of Existence and how one can truly enrich oneself within it- my treat; after that, we can get you the Mark of the Gladiator and be ready when things start."

Even as he spoke, his hands flashed with a blue device that scanned the Quintessential Fruit of Existence and caused it to disappear, the tail of this monkey-like being visibly moving with a hint of expectation and excitement as he pulled Noah forward!

Around them, the Teleios Stage Entities and above looked at each other with sharp eyes of greed before they stared out of the Gladiators' Arena- out towards the vast Omniverse they had just arrived in.
It seemed this Omniverse held great riches for them to attain and further elevate their existence! —
Within the Wheel of Weavings.
Far above the dazzling golden portal and the Gladiators' Arena, a portion of Noah's will was moving silently across the countless threads and waves of Existence.

He passed through radiant crimson gold Pillars and walls that connected together to form this massive construct, the material being something that even someone at the Paracosm Stage had to put in effort to break.
He passed through many empty rooms and halls of varying sizes, with nothing within but the hollowness of Existence.
This continued for a few minutes as he continued to carefully move his will across, until eventually...
He passed through a wall that didn't have only emptiness beyond it.
His Will arrived at an area of the Wheel of Weavings that was extremely vast, tendrils of crimson gold light swirling within as they surrounded multiple identical devices.
They looked like hourglasses, but their ends converged towards each other to form a small circle on both ends!
At the midpoint of the thousands of massive hourglasses, Noah could see a band of, yet again...a wheel.

His Will burned with brightness as he began to analyze just what these massive objects could be, but not before his will locked onto a calm but terrifying aura towards the very center of these clustering hourglasses.
And the moment he locked onto and discovered this figure...
|Hmm?|
This figure also raised his head up and began to look around!

sentences.text: Of the massive Wheel of Weavings he had seen, the entrance alone led one into an area where they could see a portal to the left where the forces of the Commonwealth were coming from, and the Gladiators' Arena to the right where the bulk of the festivities would be taking place.
But these were only relatively small parts of the Wheel of Weavings.
This construct was massive as what was the purpose of all the intricately designed areas apart from this Gladiators' Arena and iridescent golden portal?
The mind of the Weaver of Existence buzzed.
A part of itself was sectioned off from Noah and left behind, the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence wrapping around it as it stayed behind.
It was time to discover just what else this massive construct of the Commonwealth held, Noah's will silently melding into the weavings of existence in the surroundings and shooting upwards!
At the same time, his body arrived at the entry point of the Gladiators' Arena, stepping through wide crimson doors as alongside them, Entities with different variations could be seen.
Many had a monkey-like humanoid physiology, their fur variations of gold, crimson, white, and even black as they were adorned in similar armaments and clothing.
Others were more similar to Noah in their humanoid appearance, and figures of a few Entities that were ten times bigger compared to others here could also be seen.

Many of them were at the Teracosm and Paracosm Stage as it was only after passing through the crimson doors...did Noah's eyes capture the aura of Autarchical Equivalent Entities he had felt from a distance.
The first point of Entry within the Gladiators' Arena showed a long extended walkway lined with golden stones, and to its left and right...a variety of what looked like stores were set up.
Dazzling armaments radiating profound waves of Existence.
Vessels put on display.
And towards the far end, there was even a taller building that many people were going in and out of that had the inscription of [Tavern of Existence] above its doors.
"Delicacies, Armaments, and various forms of entertainment can be found within the Gladiators' Arena, with other areas even holding Domains with distorted weavings of Time and Existence.
An hour within such Domains would only be 30 minutes out here, and the concentration of the Weavings of Existence are much more potent for Cultivation.
One has to pay to gain access to it, and currency is of course...anything that is born from an Omniverse that is conducive to the promotion of Existence."
Currency.

When they got to this point, Noah gazed over the establishments with Teleios, Teracosm, and Paracosm Stage Entities overseeing them as they held Armaments of Existence shimmering with multicolored radiance among other things.
Within him, the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence buzzed as he evaluated many things before he sought to...release the bait.
He waved his hand to materialize a golden Quintessential Fruit of Existence as he asked.
"Currency like this?"
The mere wave of his hand caused the Guide's eyes to open wide as he reached out to clasp the golden Quintessential Fruit of Existence in his hands.
It was born from the Aletheian Haven of Elysium as liquid gold light surrounded its surface, a potent aura leaking from it as it even caused a few eyes in the surroundings to turn over!

"This purity of Existence...this potency...even I can make small advancements if I eat up enough of these..." The Guide brought the Quintessential Fruit of Existence to his nose and smelled as his eyes simmered with brightness thereafter.
"A single one of these would be equivalent to upwards of 1,000 Units of the Wheel..."
The Wheel.
The Currency of the Commonwealth!
The eyes of the Guide turned towards Noah as they held a fervent light within them at this moment as he asked.
"Are these the Fruits born naturally within Existential Domains in this Omniverse?
Are they all like this?"
His eyes seemed to be burning with brilliance as he asked!
And Noah looked at this scene with a silent smile as he replied.
"Some areas produce something like this, some areas don't.
With the Terraforming you all are doing..."
The eyes of the Guide opened in surprise.
"You know of that?
Hmm, yes.
May I keep this?

In exchange, I will introduce to you the Tavern of Existence and how one can truly enrich oneself within it- my treat; after that, we can get you the Mark of the Gladiator and be ready when things start."

Even as he spoke, his hands flashed with a blue device that scanned the Quintessential Fruit of Existence and caused it to disappear, the tail of this monkey-like being visibly moving with a hint of expectation and excitement as he pulled Noah forward!

Around them, the Teleios Stage Entities and above looked at each other with sharp eyes of greed before they stared out of the Gladiators' Arena- out towards the vast Omniverse they had just arrived in.
It seemed this Omniverse held great riches for them to attain and further elevate their existence!
Within the Wheel of Weavings.
Far above the dazzling golden portal and the Gladiators' Arena, a portion of Noah's will was moving silently across the countless threads and waves of Existence.

He passed through radiant crimson gold Pillars and walls that connected together to form this massive construct, the material being something that even someone at the Paracosm Stage had to put in effort to break.
He passed through many empty rooms and halls of varying sizes, with nothing within but the hollowness of Existence.
This continued for a few minutes as he continued to carefully move his will across, until eventually...
He passed through a wall that didn't have only emptiness beyond it.
His Will arrived at an area of the Wheel of Weavings that was extremely vast, tendrils of crimson gold light swirling within as they surrounded multiple identical devices.
They looked like hourglasses, but their ends converged towards each other to form a small circle on both ends!
At the midpoint of the thousands of massive hourglasses, Noah could see a band of, yet again...a wheel.

His Will burned with brightness as he began to analyze just what these massive objects could be, but not before his will locked onto a calm but terrifying aura towards the very center of these clustering hourglasses.
And the moment he locked onto and discovered this figure...
|Hmm?|
This figure also raised his head up and began to look around!

chapters.title: Chapter 3186 The Commonwealth! III
paragraphs: The figure was that of an old man.
Seeming entirely human without a speck of fur or tail that many of those from the Commonwealth seemed to hold.
His stature was that of an old man, and yet his hair and long beard were black and brimming with Vitality.
He was adorned in a white robe that seemed to hide a robust body underneath, with his pupils dark and cloudy as if they held countless planes of existence within.
In the center of the constructs that looked like Hourglasses, this old man had been walking around when he suddenly raised his head- his eyes squinting as he voiced out in this vast space.

"A sliver of something peering here...going by the fact that nobody from the Commonwealth would be spying on this place or me, this gaze should be one of someone from this Omniverse wanting to see just who has invaded their home."
The old man spoke calmly as he went back to walking around the hourglass constructs, checking them as he passed.
"I commend you for your capabilities and guts. Are you wondering what all these little trinkets are? Whether you've found an answer to what the Commonwealth is doing in this Omniverse?"
His eyes seemed filled with immeasurable wisdom and age as after stroking one last hourglass, he walked towards the absolute center of this space and sat down.
Before him, a golden fire bloomed as a tea kettle came into existence, two cups appearing opposite the kettle as the old man breathed out with tiredness.

"Let's see, by the process of elimination...you wouldn't be that Uttera nor that Imperium. They would want to plan more in their age before they move. Being younger can make one bold in their abilities. So you must be...the youngest faction leader in this place. Osmont, is it?"
His vibrant dark hair listened as he stroked his beard, the tea within the kettle beginning to release golden steam as he breathed in with contentment while beckoning with his hands!

"Please, I like to look at the person I'm talking with out of politeness. Don't let an old man ramble by himself to nothing. As a bonus, I'm currently burning tea leaves from an Omniversal Oak of Existence that an entire Omniverse depended on- the tea born from this is so pricy and hard to even get your hands on, you know?"
His gaze was calm.
He was sure there was someone in this space, and he made a conjecture that it was Noah!

And at this moment, he actually invited him to sit opposite him as while the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence burned around him, Noah foresaw many possibilities before a moment later...
WAP!
A point of colorless singularity appeared beside the seated old man.
This singularity twisted and distorted greatly before moments later, it transformed into the handsome visage of Noah in a similar white robe!
Radiant colorless wings spread out behind his back and feet as he sat down, looking at the old man before him whose aura seemed reserved but unfathomably heavy.
And the old man smiled at him with interest as he nodded and grabbed the tea kettle, pouring golden liquid brimming with Existence onto the cups before him.

"They have files on all of you disseminated to the higher-ups and anyone pertinent already. All analyses they made, your probable psyche, power, and lands governed. The one who holds a Unique Mobile Plane of Existence while also having the youngest probable age of Existence is one that caught my eye. Emperor Osmont, is it?"
Small tidbits of information were revealed as Noah took the cup holding the vibrant golden liquid, nodding calmly as he asked.
"And you are?"
An abstruse old man.
His Existence held tremendous power, and yet his disposition was a unique one as he smiled while taking a sip of his tea before he replied.
"An old man lost in the vast seas of Existence. But those who know me...know me as Ashmole. A simple Alchemist."
Ashmole!
A terrifying name and an even more unique occupation, this being nodding with contentment as he sipped the tea made from an Omniversal Oak Tree and continued!

"I study the origins of Existence. The variety of Sources of Existence that arise across the Omniverses...their differences, and their similarities. The transformation of life itself and exactly what binds everyone together."
HUUUM!

Just from his speech, the surrounding weavings of existence turned tumultuous and heavy, his eyes radiating a penetrative light of brilliance as he continued, this time while he pointed to the hourglasses around them.

"What you see before you are my alchemical creations. Something I had already been working on, but the Commonwealth made me mass-produce it after I came in contact with them a long time ago. I called it...The Transformare of Existence. A tool to smoothly extract the very essence of Existence and transform it into an even more valuable version of Existence. Something that could be used to make many alchemical creations possible. I believed it was a step forward to learning more about the Origins of Existence."
The Transformare of Existence.
Noah looked at the thousands upon thousands of these massive hourglasses as he asked succinctly.
"And what do you believe now?"
He came across the Commonwealth just like Noah.
He came under their banner similar to the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales!
But his power and standing seemed to be much more terrifying.
At Noah's words, he sipped on the vibrant tea while shaking his head.

"Now, my alchemical tools will be used to extract the Nectar of Existence of your Omniverse as they have been getting used for many other Omniverses. They've become corporate tools for the flourishing of more Existence, yes. But I am no closer to answering my questions regarding the Origins of Existence. I've been working tirelessly all these years as countless weavings tell me an answer is close. That an answer is near. But just when it seems I have arrived at the cusp of obtaining it...it slips further away."

chapters.title: Chapter 3187 The Commonwealth! IV
paragraphs: Ashmole.
An old man holding terrifying origins, with his existence searching for the very Origins of Existence themselves!

"Why do different Omniverses produce similar lifeforms but with different Sources of Existence? Why is the humanoid form of Existence the most prevalent, and yet with the weakest beginnings and values? Why..."
Questions flowed freely from this being as he seemed to be recalling everything he wanted to answer.
After going on like this for a while, he shook his head and locked his gaze on Noah once more.

"I have many questions that still need to be answered, and thus, I take great curiosity in any unique things I come across. I may not come close to being one of the terrifyingly powerful Existences within the Commonwealth, but I pride myself somewhat in my power. For you to have been able to hide from me to the extent that I couldn't pinpoint where you were...must mean you have a truly unique origin of Existence. The more of such origins I study, the more chances that one day, I may actually understand the origins of everything. So...for the sake of research, may I have a bit of your blood?"
Ashmole sipped his tea with seriousness after he finished speaking.

And Noah looked at him silently as his eyes turned to the Transformare of Existence all around them- what would be getting used to essentially farm Existence itself from this Omniverse that the Commonwealth was fattening up with Existential Terraforming!
"I won't just ask and take without anything to give back. Look here..."
Before his, Ashmole continued his musings as he pulled out a pure white book.
A Grimoire.
A Codex.
On its cover, it held the title...|The Manuscript of Existence|.

"A Record of the myriad parts of Existence I've come across over the eons. It ranges from the weakest lifeforms I've come across to the strongest ones who have complied with my requests. You share with me a drop of blood, and I..."
HUUM!
He waved his hand over the glorious white book as a fourth of its pages simmered as illusory pages came up.

"A portion of my records of Existence from the Manuscript of Existence are yours you read. From all sorts of life forms and oddities I've come across as I traveled under the banner of the Commonwealth."
The pages shone with potent waves of Existence as they floated towards Noah.
He looked at them carefully as this was exactly what he wanted for himself- records of different Sources of Existence and how similar or different they were to his Atlas of Existence!
But his expression remained placid as he asked first.
"Under the banner of the Commonwealth...why do you follow their Banner? Why make them The Transformare of Existence and be with them for all of these eons?"
The reason for this Alchemist to follow the Commonwealth.
It couldn't purely be to further his research, could it?
Ashmole smiled at such a question as he looked up at the enclosed wall in this space above while he replied.

"As vibrant as Existence is, there are also things that absolutely decimate and erase Existence. Many eons ago, I found myself coming to a realization of how hilariously outmatched I was when it came to forces whose natural aims are the erasure of Existence, and the Commonwealth was the only thing with the strength to stand against them. I may not agree with many of their methods. I may not like those who sit at the highest levels of power within the Commonwealth. But they are doing what must be done, and they have the power to do it. That is why I am where I am, Osmont. Why are you here?"
An Entity of his caliber.
Someone that at this moment, Noah could not say with confidence whether he would even be capable of getting through his defenses!
Even now as his Atlas of Existence sought to analyze everything, seeing through this old man was an impossibility as much about him was unknown.
But he still stated why he was where he was- why he did what he did.
As for Noah...
He grabbed the illusory pages in front of his whole giving his reply.
"I'm actually following the same goal as you. Understanding all three different Systems of Existence out there."
His words caused Ashmole to raise his head and stroke his beard as he asked dubiously.

"You wouldn't be among those seeking to assimilate different Sources of Existence, would you? I've looked into that route. All that I've seen has been instability and destruction to existence overall, my friend. Of course, it is also something the Commonwealth has outlawed..."
His last words were more of a reminder towards Noah- to caution him as he smiled while his Will delved into the few pages from the Manuscript of Existence.
"Why of course. The purity of Existence is what keeps the Wheel turning, is it not?"
BOOM!
Simple words from Noah.

But in the next moment, the very weavings of Existence of Ashmole erupted out with immensity and grandiosity- purple tendrils of brilliance seething around him as his eyes became as deep as the Domains of Existence of an Omniverse!
He looked at Noah with immense somberness as he voiced out while emanating a terrifying aura.
|Why did you say that?|
Around Noah, silent and unseen tendrils of the Authority of the Laborer began to gather as his eyes became sharp while he asked.
|Say what?|
Both of their words were now filled with intent and authority.
Terrifying waves of Existence pulsed.
The eyes of Ashmole were deep as he seemed to be reigning himself in as he spoke slowly.
|"The purity of Existence is what keeps the Wheel turning". Why did you say this, what do you know about the Wheel?|
WAA!
The Wheel.
Noah's simple words had evoked such a reaction from this being as he pointed around them while replying calmly.

|The massive Wheel shaped construct we are all in. The wheels binding the center of your hourglass constructs...it seems that a Wheel is a big theme with you all as I just said words related to it. Why did it cause you to get like this, my friend?|
Noah truly had just spoken the words out freely.
But for them to evoke such a reaction...did he stumble onto a grand secret inadvertently?
The purity of Existence is what keeps the Wheel turning.
The Purity of Existence.
The Wheel.
Ashmole looked into Noah's eyes with interminable brilliance before moments after, his aura receded into nothingness as he simply sat back down in front of his teapot.
Noah did the same as the old man before him smiled apologetically, going back to speaking without authority.
"I seem to have misunderstood and made a fool of myself, excuse me for that. Now, you accepted the pages of my lifelong work. Can I expect a drop of blood?"
A drop of blood. Something simple.
Something small.
But the consequences for it...were things that not even Ashmole nor Noah understood at this moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 3188 The Commonwealth! V
paragraphs: Everything retained its calmness after the brief eruption of Authorities that stemmed from a few simple words.
Words that Noah said freely before, but he now engraved them in his heart.
The Purity of Existence is what keeps the Wheel turning!
It was something wholly against what he was doing, but it seemed critical to the Commonwealth.
His eyes burned brightly at this thought as he brought the illusory pages from the Manuscript of Existence closer while his left hand tapped out.
A small cut appeared on his finger with this simple tap, and from it, a drop of golden blood containing minuscule weavings of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor Lineage flowed out!
Only small tendrils of weavings of his Lineage.
The eyes of Ashmole lit up as he opened his pristine Manuscript of Existence- its pages actually flying out and rotating around him as if they were stellar bodies.
A single blank page came out as it was the one to receive the golden drop of blood.
Blood and paper came in contact.
And the page began to vibrate with a cacophony of noises as Ashmole's entire being focused!
At the same time, Noah looked at the first illusory page he had gained from the Manuscript of Existence.

[Gigantomanus]:: A species with a unique Source of Existence that is reliant only on size to determine their power. The Gigantomanus start off the size of an atomic particle and gradually increase in size as their Existence becomes more enriched. As they increase in size, their existence becomes increasingly harder to enrich as they have to devour a great deal of the pure essence of Existence to advance. Those who have attained the size of Domains of Existence are dangerous, and Legend has it that one Gigantomanus has long since attained the size of an Omniverse, but such a creature has yet to be observed. Further analysis of the Gigantomanus has been broken down in |Physiology|, |Behavior|, |Quantifiable Values|...
A single page.
And yet it held a great deal of information within that opened Noah's eyes to another Source of Existence.
A system of Existence based purely on size!
The larger they were, the more powerful they were.
It was a simple and straightforward System of Existence as it didn't rely on anything else.
No concepts, no wealth, nothing!
It made Noah even hungrier for coming in contact with such an Existence as if he could study their physiology, he would likely be able to assimilate this Source of Existence into his Atlas as well.
His Will moved rapidly to another page.

[Leubh]:: A unique Lineage of Existence found within an Omniverse plagued by eons of peace and serenity. It relies on the power of love and affection to propel one across the weavings of Existence, with those burning with boundless love being capable of withstanding a few moves from even someone of my caliber. The thought was to initially dismiss them as something such as love was not an idea I considered truthful towards the Origins of Existence themselves, but these creatures have truly overcome everything over the eons with the power of love. Idiotic, but useful nonetheless. Further analysis of the Leubh has been broken down in |Physiology|, |Behavior|, |Quantifiable Values|...
The power of...love?
Even something that sounded outrageous like this could take one towards Autarchy?

It was a maddening possibility as just when Noah was about to flip onto another page, his Will that was also always monitoring Ashmole and what was occurring with the record of a smidgen of his blood...caught something that forced him to pause.
The figure of Ashmole...was trembling.

A terrifying Entity that collected information of dozens if not hundreds of Entities from different Sources of Existence...was trembling moments after a drop of blood from Noah entered his Manuscript of Existence!
The white page was pointed gold as it pulsed again and again.
And every time it pulsed, the expression of Ashmole became more and more stern until he turned his gaze towards Noah's figure.
And he looked at him as if he were looking at an Omniversal oddity.
"What are you?"
What was he?
It was a simple and obvious enough question, and yet Ashmole took the golden page Noah's blood had dripped on and shook it within his hands as he continued.

"Every creature has a Source. An Origin. Draconian. Simian. Viral. Bacterial. Plantae. Human. Every single creature I've recorded has a Source stemming from a certain type of Existence. You...I cannot locate your source. You look human. You seem human. Your physiology is human. But your Origin...is not human. So what exactly are you?"
WAA!
A bold accusation!
One that the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor shook his head towards and spoke with sharp eyes.
"I was born human, and I've continued to be human. My Origins have never changed."
His Bloodline had evolved over time.
He had incorporated lineages of other races into him over time.
Ranging from Reality Ursidae to Willow Tree, all the way to Demons, Celestials, Kun Pengs, and more!
But ultimately, his basal form remained human.
His Origin remained human.
Yet even as he affirmed this Ashmole shook his head with a somber expression.
"No, you don't understand."
HUUM!

"Even if you had mixed qualities of other Bloodlines into yours. Even if you had remained pure throughout. You would still carry a marker. A signature that distinguishes you into a certain group. You...don't have any such markers. Your Origin is not something I have observed across my eons of research and many travels across different Omniverses. I cannot pinpoint exactly what you are, but I can say with absolute surety that you, my friend, are not human."
His eyes were filled with immense seriousness.
He looked Noah up and down as if he were dissecting and analyzing everything, wishing to know even more as at this time...
"It seems like our meeting has to come to a close here"
His figure rose as he put the rest of the illusory pages of the Manuscript of Existence he had obtained away.

The Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence began to flicker as the quick change of pace caused a change in the expression of Ashmole whose mind now seemed entirely fascinated by the entity before him.
An Entity with an entirely unknown Origin!

chapters.title: Chapter 3189 The Commonwealth! VI
paragraphs: An entire unknown Origin.
Based on the sheer database of information that Ashmole had, this shouldn't even be possible.
Everything fit somewhere. Whether partly or wholly, everything fits!
But there were no unique markers from any studied Origin that Ashmole could find for this Entity disappearing ahead of him as statically, such a thing shouldn't be possible.
"We'll be in touch."
As Noah disappeared, Ashmole's voice echoed out heavily in this space, his figure surrounded by dazzling pages of his Manuscript of Existence as his eyes were focused on a single one.
A page still unable to classify and fully analyze a drop of blood.
A new mystery he had to solve.
But he was Ashmole.
The secrets of Existence were things he had uncovered too many times, and he would step up to this current challenge as in time, he would solve it.
Was it truly an Origin he had never come across before and it matched no other Origin, or was it something else entirely...
A mystery!

While one entity sought to solve something in one area, Noah's other body within the Gladiators' Arena was uncovering mysteries regarding the workings of the Commonwealth ever so slowly- even if it was in how they entertained themselves.

The Tavern of Existence he had entered with the Guide was much larger within than its structure outside, an establishment the size of a small world stretching out within as countless areas held their own unique happenings.
Sections where dazzling arrays of meats crackled over golden flames as they pulsed with the fervor of Existence.

Places where golden rivers flowed down as those near it held chalices in their hands that they dipped into this river to drink its potent nectar. Places where what seemed to be games and competitive sports were taking place- one particularly interesting one being 20 Teracosm Stage Entities facing off against each other as they sought to pierce a miniaturized Cosmos they were kicking with their feet towards an opposing goal on the other side!
This sport alone took an area of a whole 1,000 miles as a few hundred thousand gathered around to see who would come out victorious.
Of course, Noah had been listening to the Guide talking as he went to the area filled with food stalls cooking all sorts of exotic Beasts.
[The Cultivated Beast Meat of the Beluga Sturgeon has been devoured. The elevation of Existence is minimal, and analysis shows a weak Source of Existence not conducive to Cultivation.]

[The Cultivated Beast Meat of the Eonian Cattle has been devoured. The elevation of Existence is minimal, but the unique Source of Existence makes them viable for mass production in the Infinite Omniverse.]
There were very few surprises as Noah obtained a variety of meats to see how many things with different Sources of Existence he could get his hands on.

In the stalls, the monkey like humanoid Entities preparing and selling different types of meats were all looking towards Noah hungrily as he took out vibrant Quintessential Fruits of Existence to pay for large amounts of Delicacies that he also put away for later- enough to even feed hundreds as he wasn't just doing it for his own research, but also for his people to enjoy!
And as he waded through this region of Delicacies, the Guide to his right smiled as he nodded towards another area shining with darkened crimson radiance.
"A big spender like you can really enjoy themselves over there in the Health and Wellness district as well."

The eyes of the Guide were directed towards an area where gorgeous men and women could be seen adorned in loose clothing and welcoming others into tall buildings where nobody could see what was happening within.

Many of the Entities there held a single horn or two horns erupting from their heads as their skin held no fur, with crimson gold wings of light erupting from their backs- their beauty being the main point as their bodies brimmed with vitality!

"Its a unique lineage of Entities who thrive on cultivating with others- the Fae of Vitality. Their time is precious and pricey, but a few hours or days in there, and your Source of Existence will feel soothed and calmed to the extent that making advancements in your existence becomes all that much easier."
The eyes of the Guide proposed such a place with a smile as Noah only spared it a glance before shaking his head.
"No, let's complete the registration process so I can attain the Mark of the Gladiator."
The Tavern of Existence was full of things to enrich oneself, but he had gotten all he needed for now.
The Guide nodded with a nod as their figures began to flicker.
"Another time then."
WAP!
By the time they reappeared, they were in another section of the Gladiators' Arena.

It wasn't even apt to say in another section, but truly at the very center of the Gladiators' Arena as the figures of the Guide and Noah found themselves atop a floor made of pure gold that stretched out for thousands of miles.

And yet in the far distant corners, massive statues of Entities could be seen, half of which were those with monkey like qualities and golden tails, another half having their own unique physiologies or more humanoid in nature.
Such statues surrounded the massive Arena in all directions.

"The Champions of previous battles. Gladiators of the Omniverses who distinguished themselves to be full of power. This Existential Arena was the land that forged them into Legends, and their Legends carry on to this day."
As the Guide spoke, his tail smashed the center of the Arena they stood on as a golden card flew out- a card that floated towards Noah as it shone with an ecriture that read [Gladiator]!
"If you would mark that with a signature of your existence, you will have your Mark of the Gladiator and be ready to participate when things kick off soon."
