chapters.title: Chapter 3190 What have you done? I
paragraphs: A golden card.
Now burning with a miniscule portion of his existence, it distinguished him as a Gladiator that could join the fight against other terrifying Entities from different Omniverses.
Each one with a different System of Existence.
Each one being someone he could analyze and potentially obtain a new Source of Existence.
Noah waved his hands and caused the golden card to disappear as he looked at the massive statues stretched out all around them.
The monkey like Entities made the majority as the Guide spoke while they looked at their magnificent figures.

"The Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Lineage makes up the bulk of the Commonwealth. We have waded across eons of history and Existence. We saved every Omniverse we've come across, or are in the process of saving others even now. You may have your own perception of us now as we've come to your Omniverse, but we truly are here to help. To make things better."
The Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Lineage.
The golden tails.
The variations of fur on their humanoid bodies.
The Guide spoke of his people as from his words, Noah picked a few that he focused on.
"What Omniverses are still in the process of being saved right now?"
The Simian Guide looked at him calmly after such a question as after a brief silence, he replied.

"There are Omniverses where the infection of the Worms of Existence has advanced tremendously. They had already devoured over half of these Omniverses by the time we found them, and they were no longer in their Neonatal Stage. Fighting against them and reclaiming any Omniverses has been an endless battle as if they are given any edge whatsoever- If a Source Worm who devoured an entire Omniverse ever rises...this will be an unfathomable loss that very few can even grasp."
The work of the Commonwealth!
It was so critical that they sent their forces on endless battles to ensure that entire Omniverses were not devoured under the banner of those antithetical to Existence itself.

"Nobody knows how they came to be. Nobody knows how even we came to be. There is an interesting old man who should have also been assigned to come to this Omniverse who is looking into the Origins of Existence, but even this has turned out to be a fruitless endeavor as right now, the most important thing is to maintain the equilibrium of Existence. To not give an edge to those seeking the disruption of Existence...this is the mission of the Commonwealth, this is-"
WAP!
The Simian Guide had his eyes blazing with brilliance as he spoke of the glorious purpose of the Commonwealth.

But before his words could continue, the flickering light of teleportation warped near them as the figure of another Simian Guide appeared- a heavy aura of Autarchy surrounding him as he wasn't alone.
A golden haired man adorned in a white robe accompanied him, his eyes shining with unfathomable golden splendor as just his sheer presence made it seem like he was the center of everything nearby.
The moment he arrived, his gaze instantly honed in on Noah.
Eyes that held endless halcyon brilliance.
Grace that shone unfathomably bright.
It was none other than the Imperium Autarch making an appearance.
"Oh? Your tour has yet to end, Reiner?" The newly arriving Simian Guide spoke to the Guide that had been moving with Noah this whole time with a smile.
But before a reply could be made...
WAP!
Another Distortion of space occurred.
Another Simian Guide appeared.
And this one was a female Simian with pure gold fur, her eyes vibrant as they looked around towards the other Guides here!
"My oh my..."
She came with a dark haired man surrounded by heavy obsidian radiance, his eyes filled with coldness as he came to gaze at Noah and the Imperium Autarch.
This...was none other than the Eonic Uterra.
"All the leaders of the Factions of this Omniverse meeting at the center of the Gladiator' Arena before things kick off...how unique."
Whether by design or coincidence.
What the Commonwealth considered the Hegemons of this Omniverse met on the Gladiators' Arena, colorless brilliance surging in the surroundings!
"A stroke of Existential Fate it is then. Come, why don't we all finish the tour together as we await for the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery to begin?"
The female Simian Guide pulsing with unique waves of power smiled towards her peers as they raised their brows and acquiesced.
At the same time, a flash of brilliant light flashed in the eyes of the Eonic Uterra, Imperium Autarch, and Noah as they stared at each other!
Far away from the dark point of the Omniverse that was now turned into a splendorous area with a massive Wheel of Weavings stationed.
At the heart of the Source of Pompeii.

The figure of Noah could be seen grasping a silver ashen singularity that was none other than the Seed of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Pompeii- this being another Intersect Omniversal Authority similar to Aitia that led towards and was at the heart of an Autarchical Omniversal Authority!

After returning from the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, clearing the dangerous musings of this Greater Omniversal Authority were an easy thing for Noah as he exceeded any progress that the Omniversal Pillagers made.
At this moment, he was alone as Sona and all others were sent back into the Infinite Omniverse.

The Source of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Pompeii within his hands pulsed as his mouth opened to devour it- its silver ashen light being pulled towards his lungs as waves of prompts began to rise!
|The Intersect Omniversal Authority of Pompeii is being assimilated into your Omniversal Organ.|
|A pathway towards its connected Autarchical Omniversal Authorities will soon be analyzed and traversed.|
The prompts came and went, but Noah remained right where he was.
He was waiting for something.
Someone.
His colorless wings fluttered with a regal brilliance as within moments...
WAP!
A golden figure appeared in front of him.
WAP!
And a dark figure encased in shrouds of obsidian majesty appeared behind him!
The Imperium Autarch and the Eonic Uterra- two of the strongest Entities within this Omniverse before the advent of the Commonwealth!

The figure of Noah could be seen grasping a silver ashen singularity that was none other than the Seed of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Pompeii- this being another Intersect Omniversal Authority similar to Aitia that led towards and was at the heart of an Autarchical Omniversal Authority!

After returning from the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record, clearing the dangerous musings of this Greater Omniversal Authority were an easy thing for Noah as he exceeded any progress that the Omniversal Pillagers made.
At this moment, he was alone as Sona and all others were sent back into the Infinite Omniverse.

The Source of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Pompeii within his hands pulsed as his mouth opened to devour it- its silver ashen light being pulled towards his lungs as waves of prompts began to rise!
|The Intersect Omniversal Authority of Pompeii is being assimilated into your Omniversal Organ.|
|A pathway towards its connected Autarchical Omniversal Authorities will soon be analyzed and traversed.|
The prompts came and went, but Noah remained right where he was.
He was waiting for something.
Someone.
His colorless wings fluttered with a regal brilliance as within moments...
WAP!
A golden figure appeared in front of him.
WAP!
And a dark figure encased in shrouds of obsidian majesty appeared behind him!
The Imperium Autarch and the Eonic Uterra- two of the strongest Entities within this Omniverse before the advent of the Commonwealth!

chapters.title: Chapter 3191 What have you done? II
paragraphs: The two strongest entities within this Omniverse that controlled vast numbers of Existential Domains in the case of the Imperium Autarch, and Legions of Omniversal Pillagers in regards to the Eonic Uterra!
Not too long ago, the Eonic Uterra had even sent his Omniversal Pillagers in this very Domain of Pompeii to tell Noah to go to him for a meeting.
And yet at this moment, both he and the fearsome and mysterious entity that was the Imperium Autarch appeared before him.

They came to him as when they appeared together in the center of the Gladiators' Arena, he was the one who was confident to send out a signal with a flash of his eyes towards the Imperium Autarch and the Eonic Uterra without being discovered by the forces of the Commonwealth around them!
And his bet paid off as at this moment, both these terrifying Entities brought part of their Wills here.
"Very interesting..." The voice of the Imperium Autarch was magnetic as a golden sea unfurled below his feet, a throne rising from it as he sat down freely.

"Whatever did you do to the Sanctus Autarch? All of her forces? I haven't been able to find anything regarding the Sanctus Populi across the Omniverse. And that baffles me greatly. Did you usurp her power entirely or...?"
He spoke with immense curiosity as if he found everything about Noah interesting.
Seeing his mannerisms, Noah waved his hands to bring out a colorless throne of Quintessence, his Wings spreading out gloriously behind it as he sat down.
The visage of the Eonic Uterra shook his head as behind him, an obsidian throne radiating terrifying pressure formed that he sat down on as well.
Both his eyes and the eyes of the Imperium Autarch were on Noah as between the two of them, he was the one they least understood regarding his origins and power.
He had very little time of history within this Omniverse, with his origins truly being found from a destroyed Domain of Existence days ago!
And yet now, he was considered one of the three strongest forces under the banner of this Omniverse as he shared a seat with the Eonic Uterra and the Imperium Autarch.
Seeing Noah not answer his question, the Imperium Autarch smiled as he continued.

"But hey, look at us? Playing kings and Emperors over stretches of Existence, and then tiny worms come to remind us of our mortality as they are followed by another force invading our lands and dividing it up for themselves. Yet...here we are sitting on our grandiose thrones."
WAA!
His words were heavy ones.
His words were true ones!
Imperium turned towards the Eonic Uterra as his smiling expression faded to show calmness.

"You, I've tolerated all these years as you've remained silent for the most part, understanding this isn't your true home. But you melded with the Authorities of the Omniverse and changed yourself. From your Devouring...you became assimilated yourself. That is fine."
HUUM!
The visage of the Eonic Uterra buzzed with a fearsome light as he squinted at the golden throne and the man who sat on it, a gruff voice echoing out.

"Do you think your mere birth gives you a claim over vast stretches of Existence? Do you take your distinction that seriously? Then tell me, O Great Omniversal Ankyra. What did you do as invaders entered your home?"
The Eonic Uterra knew many things.
Things like the fact that the Imperium Autarch was the Omniversal Ankyra.
Things like what such a title represented!
His words didn't cause any waves on the calmness of the Imperium Autarch as he moved his gaze from him and towards Noah.

"I had a choice to make. Wage war right away and lose trillions of lives, or wait and learn about the invading enemy and see how to deal with it with the least possible casualties. I left the Eonic Uterra alone all these years because the number of lives that would have been lost outweighed the benefits of seeking the end of his existence. I was only just coming to learn of you before your Weavings became obscured as I now wonder...will you be friend or foe of this Omniverse?"
The Omniversal Ankyra spoke towards the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor.
Was he a friend of the Omniverse, or a foe?
The Omniversal Ankyra was backed by the weavings of an Unknown Number of Autarchical Omniversal Authorities as the sheer pressure that he emanated alone caused the weavings of existence to tremble.
His golden hair flowed with majesty as he sat back on his throne and continued.

"What exactly are you all doing for this Omniverse right now as you receive worthless tours of a portion of the Commonwealth? The stories the Protectors and Guides are spouting? Will you truly masquerade yourselves as Gladiators in their games? As they make a mockery of your Distinctions?"
His eyes burned with galaxies of golden radiance.
He asked as the Eonic Uterra remained silent and pondering.
He asked as for the first time, the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor spoke out with unfathomable radiance.
"I am weighing the breadth of your Existences on a scale and deciding whether it is worth the effort to include you all in my plans."
HUUM!
The weavings of Existence for countless light years buzzed and turned tumultuous.
What was he doing amidst all of this? What exactly was Noah doing for this Omniverse?
In the Infinite Omniverse.
In a domain filled with interminable waves of Entropy and rivers of crackling Manadynamics.

Countless waves and strings attracted and repulsed each other as Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy could be seen at the very center, and the figure of the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse was beside him as they stared at an extremely dense and volatile singularity.
The Fruits of their labor.
The first viable result of their experiments to make a Nuclear Omniversal Weapon that could play the role of a Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.
|The Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction, designated with the moniker [Fat Monkey] had come to fruition.|
An extremely dense singularity.
One that after sparked, the weavings of Existence where it was deployed would begin to unravel in a shocking manner- potentially causing the erasure of part of an Omniverse if not a majority of one!
This was just one of the things Noah had been working on as at this moment, what he needed was a place to test it.
A place to carry out the test of a Nuclear Omniversal Weapon!

chapters.title: Chapter 3192 Fat Monkey! I
paragraphs: A testing location.
Noah never thought he would arrive at such a point in his existence where he could design something so disastrous that he needed an entirely different setting just to observe its effects.
Due to many unknown factors regarding the scope of its effects and the permanent damage left behind thereafter, the testing grounds had to be within an entirely different Omniverse.

And given the reality that even though the Infinite Omniverse was actively looking for other Omniverses right now, no results had come from this as the only thing left...were the much easier to access Eonic Omniverse Records.

Records reachable via unique weavings of Existence- one that Lumen made possible along with the alteration of the weavings of Existence through the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist!

When the Sentinels of Lumen remained active between the three-way battle before, more of them had died to the Worms of Existence that enough shards to formulate a gateway to a few Eonic Omniverse Records became possible.
And there was something else even more pristine in connection to Eonic Omniverse Records and the Atlas of Existence that was formed with one!
It related to the Sources of Existence obtained and assimilated into the First Mundi of Power within his Atlas.

|The assimilated weavings of all new Systems of Existence are recorded and kept for further analysis within the Atlas of Existence, with these weavings capable of being traced across Existence to other Sources similar to them, within Eonic Omniverse Records similar to them.|

|If the connection and similarity of Existence is strong enough, a gateway could potentially be formed toward another Eonic Omniverse Record with enough Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence.|

There were just some of the prompts that had risen over the last day after Noah's busy movements, which gave him two ways to go about entering Eonic Omniverse Records- but both weren't entirely usable as currently, there was an active search and surveillance for what caused the eradication and implosion of the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record!
The entry into another Eonic Omniverse Record set up by the Commonwealth would almost certainly draw the gaze of eyes currently monitoring and making Noah predict unfavorable future weavings.
But...if he entered an Eonic Omniverse Record ever so briefly just for the purpose of deploying and understanding the effects of his Nuclear Omniversal Weapons...

|There is a 70% probability of observing the full effects of the deployment of Fat Monkey in their entirety. There is a 40% Probability of being discovered at entry, with this probability rising over time. With the veiling of the Authority of Laborer, it is estimated that only if the enemy exceeds the quantified values of Autarchy by a large margin would they be able to discover you right away. But if only a portion of your Will is sent, it could be destroyed with all traces erased thereafter.|
The sonorous voice of manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse echoed out beside Noah as the forming idea became more and more cemented.

A blinding light shone from Noah's body as part of himself was sectioned off, three dazzling shards of light also being brought out as they converged into a singularity beside them that began to balloon into a small blue portal!

In his prior visions under the banner of Invictus Maximus, he had seen 9 portals of light surrounding him that each led to different locations- and he still wanted to bring this vision to fruition after his Authorities continued to be elevated in power to the extent that he didn't have to worry about anyone watching or seeking him.
But for what he needed to do now, one was enough.
|The Three Fragments of the Wasser Existential Omniversal Map have joined together and formed the gateway into the Wasser Eonic Omniverse Record.|
|The stability of the gateway has been purposefully reduced to ensure that nothing outside the bounds of Autarchy is capable of passing through.|
Safe measures were put in place as Noah nodded. He looked at the unstable point of singularity as he voiced out.
"Let's put Fat Monkey in its intended home before deployment."
HUUM!
The weavings of Manadynamics shone.

The Authorities flowing in the surroundings converged around the Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction as an outline of a fat monkey began to form, the material coming out being finalized with a golden metallic sheen that showed a statue of a monkey that had simply eaten too much over the years.
The statue showed a big round belly that the hands of this monkey held onto, its face that of contentment as it was smiling with its eyes squinted!

Noah nodded with contentment at this Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction, his authority carefully wrapping around it as he took it within the folds of his existence...and disappeared towards the blue portal before him.
Wasser.
It was an ancient word closely linked to nothing else but...water.

As he felt the distortions of Existence itself, his small sectioned will was further veiled by the Authority of the Laborer that even Ashmole was only able to sense, but not know exactly where he was!
Within moments.
WOOSH!
He warped into an entirely new weaving of Existence.

Not a genuine Omniverse, but an Eonic Omniverse Record that was somehow made through the hands of the Commonwealth. It was here that Protectors placed Existences whose Omniverses were destroyed...among others!
The reason why wasn't entirely clear. The weavings of Existence became extremely clear within moments as his sectioned Will found itself in a body of water.
All around him was an endless sea stretching out in all directions, and the moment he arrived...
HUUM!
Countless chains of golden brilliance instantly blazed with gold flames all across these blue waters.
Alongside it, a voice that seemed to be a few light years away boomed out jovially!
|Haha, do you know how much of my Existence I've had to stretch out across different Eonic Omniverse Records waiting for you, O Follower of Anti-Life?!|
The voice was booming and filled with a potent authority.

An authority that felt capable of suppressing the colorless brilliance of any normal Autarch as it coursed through the countless chains that were no doubt spread out across this Eonic Omniverse Record!

chapters.title: Chapter 3193 Fat Monkey! II
paragraphs: An intent that came along with blazing good flames and chains all across this Eonic Omniverse Record!

|You still hide? You people are always so bold and flashy in everything you do, so why hide now? I've cleared this Eonic Omniverse Record on everything but myself, and these Omniversal Chains can even prevent escape in a genuine Omniverse, much less a Record of one. You aren't getting out of here, so how about you tell me why the hell you all would begin targeting Records of Omniverses now?|
Noah's will remained veiled as he spread himself out.
Across light years, his Will traversed until in a distant direction, he captured the visage of Royal Existential Omniversal Simian.
Lustrous gold as white fur, this Entity had his tail blazing in white flames as his figure was robust and filled with muscles under the radiant fur!

|Oh, there is the boldness I know- I can feel your gaze on me. But what's stopping you from coming out? Does every part of you not feel the hatred all others under your banner feel? The countless numbers of you vermin that we have eradicated? Come on, let me see a glimpse of you before I erase you entirely.|
Taunting words boomed out as thus being truly designated Noah as someone he had yet to gain enough knowledge of.
Someone belonging to Anti-Life!
Was this under the same weavings of the Worms of Existence that could be designated as Anti-Existence? Or something else entirely?
Noah calmly mulled things over as he prepared the Fat Monkey to be deployed.

The enemy was someone he couldn't fully quantify the strength of, but if they faced The Sanctus Autarch or others of her caliber, they would likely be able to suppress them within nanoseconds. It was a good candidate to obtain some values and numbers- and even possibly allow him to better quantify the strength of Protectors and others he was coming across from the Commonwealth.

|My friend, if you won't show yourself, I will simply burn every ounce of Anti-Existence here. I'll have to wait a bit more before finding out why you fools are targeting Records of Omniverses now instead of genuine Omniverses, but time...is something I have in abundance.|
HUUM!
The gold flames all around began to burn with scalding heat that even caused Noah to frown, but at this moment...
A colorless light flashed.
A few light years away, the statue of a Fat Monkey with a content expression appeared!
The moment it did so, the white and gold furred Simian with an astonishing visage appeared in front of it with eyes of skepticism while he tugged on the golden chains all around it.
|What is this?|
The Simian did not approach any closer as he probed the Fat Monkey before it with his senses.
At this point, the monotone voice of the Infinite Omniverse rang out in Noah's mind.
|The first test of the Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction, Fat Monkey, is being recorded.|
A test.
A simple, simple test of something that came to be after Noah and the Infinite Omniverse observed the Existential Terraforming of an Omniverse through the hands of the Commonwealth.

What could go wrong with the Artificial expansion of the weavings of existence? To purposefully induce the unstable unwinding of Existence itself, and then further hasten and magnify this process with Entropy and other terrifying weavings of Existence!
To cover an extremely large surface area as anything caught up in it would face the same induction of the unwinding of Existence itself.
'Let's see what you're made of, Fat Monkey.'
Noah's Will observed sharply.
And the moment that the Royal Existential Omniversal Simian had his will merely come in contact with the Fat Monkey...
A mechanism was set off.
The smiling and content happy face of the Fat Monkey twisted and became angry as its belly began to expand.
The golden pupils of the Simian constricted as a blinding pillar of light manifested from him that smashed down onto the exploding Fat Monkey!
But at this point, it was all too late.
A heavy and murky obsidian light had already expanded as the Fat Monkey was no more.
When the immense pillar of golden light smashed down, the potent weavings of existence itself that made it...began to unravel the moment it touched the expanding murky obsidian light!

The blinding Pillar turned into fine strings of light that lost all luster before they began to blaze with a murky obsidian radiance- this unraveling and changing of gold to black occurring at an incredibly rapid pace as in a fraction of a nanosecond, the murky black light already neared the fingertips of the dazzling Royal Existential Omniversal Simian.

His expression turned rageful as his whole figure blazed with iridescent golden flames, the illusion of massive White gold Simian with a blindfold seated in a meditative position wrapping around him protectively!
And...
BOOOM!
The mechanisms of the Fat Monkey fully unfolded as its unraveling obsidian light bloomed out to cover 10 Light years right away in a heavy explosion.
Noah watched this scene with calm eyes as a voice rang out in his mind.
|Initial range of explosion is deemed to be 10 Light Years in diameter.|
10 light years.
This was how vast the initial explosion stretched out to as after this...
BOOM!
Noah felt his sectioned Will vibrate as heavy Shockwaves stretched out all the way to his position dozens of light years away.
These Shockwaves alone were withstood by his Authority of the Laborer, but judged they would be sufficient to erase the existence of even a Paracosm Stage Entity!
After the Shockwave, scalding waves of dark tendrils of brilliance erupted out further, unraveling Existence everywhere they passed.
In the surroundings, the waters endlessly stretched throughout dried as reality distorted and broke down into crumbs.

The weavings of existence crumbled as if they were sand, waves of debris accumulating rapidly as moments later, heavy rotational movements ravaged everything along with the unraveling of Existence, another explosion booming out as it showed...a massive cloud of debris of decaying Existence being flung out in all directions.
It was shocking.
It was monstrous.
It was...
"Beautiful..."

Across light years, his Will traversed until in a distant direction, he captured the visage of Royal Existential Omniversal Simian.
Lustrous gold as white fur, this Entity had his tail blazing in white flames as his figure was robust and filled with muscles under the radiant fur!
|Oh, there is the boldness I know- I can feel your gaze on me.
But what's stopping you from coming out?
Does every part of you not feel the hatred all others under your banner feel?
The countless numbers of you vermin that we have eradicated?
Come on, let me see a glimpse of you before I erase you entirely.|
Taunting words boomed out as thus being truly designated Noah as someone he had yet to gain enough knowledge of.
Someone belonging to Anti-Life!
Was this under the same weavings of the Worms of Existence that could be designated as Anti-Existence?
Or something else entirely?
Noah calmly mulled things over as he prepared the Fat Monkey to be deployed.
The enemy was someone he couldn't fully quantify the strength of, but if they faced The Sanctus Autarch or others of her caliber, they would likely be able to suppress them within nanoseconds.
It was a good candidate to obtain some values and numbers- and even possibly allow him to better quantify the strength of Protectors and others he was coming across from the Commonwealth.
|My friend, if you won't show yourself, I will simply burn every ounce of Anti-Existence here.
I'll have to wait a bit more before finding out why you fools are targeting Records of Omniverses now instead of genuine Omniverses, but time...is something I have in abundance.|
HUUM!
The gold flames all around began to burn with scalding heat that even caused Noah to frown, but at this moment...
A colorless light flashed.
A few light years away, the statue of a Fat Monkey with a content expression appeared!
The moment it did so, the white and gold furred Simian with an astonishing visage appeared in front of it with eyes of skepticism while he tugged on the golden chains all around it.
|What is this?|
The Simian did not approach any closer as he probed the Fat Monkey before it with his senses.
At this point, the monotone voice of the Infinite Omniverse rang out in Noah's mind.
|The first test of the Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction, Fat Monkey, is being recorded.|
A test.
A simple, simple test of something that came to be after Noah and the Infinite Omniverse observed the Existential Terraforming of an Omniverse through the hands of the Commonwealth.
What could go wrong with the Artificial expansion of the weavings of existence?
To purposefully induce the unstable unwinding of Existence itself, and then further hasten and magnify this process with Entropy and other terrifying weavings of Existence!
To cover an extremely large surface area as anything caught up in it would face the same induction of the unwinding of Existence itself.
'Let's see what you're made of, Fat Monkey.'
Noah's Will observed sharply.
And the moment that the Royal Existential Omniversal Simian had his will merely come in contact with the Fat Monkey...
A mechanism was set off.
The smiling and content happy face of the Fat Monkey twisted and became angry as its belly began to expand.
The golden pupils of the Simian constricted as a blinding pillar of light manifested from him that smashed down onto the exploding Fat Monkey!
But at this point, it was all too late.
A heavy and murky obsidian light had already expanded as the Fat Monkey was no more.
When the immense pillar of golden light smashed down, the potent weavings of existence itself that made it...began to unravel the moment it touched the expanding murky obsidian light!

The blinding Pillar turned into fine strings of light that lost all luster before they began to blaze with a murky obsidian radiance- this unraveling and changing of gold to black occurring at an incredibly rapid pace as in a fraction of a nanosecond, the murky black light already neared the fingertips of the dazzling Royal Existential Omniversal Simian.

His expression turned rageful as his whole figure blazed with iridescent golden flames, the illusion of massive White gold Simian with a blindfold seated in a meditative position wrapping around him protectively!
And...
BOOOM!
The mechanisms of the Fat Monkey fully unfolded as its unraveling obsidian light bloomed out to cover 10 Light years right away in a heavy explosion.
Noah watched this scene with calm eyes as a voice rang out in his mind.
|Initial range of explosion is deemed to be 10 Light Years in diameter.|
10 light years.
This was how vast the initial explosion stretched out to as after this...
BOOM!
Noah felt his sectioned Will vibrate as heavy Shockwaves stretched out all the way to his position dozens of light years away.
These Shockwaves alone were withstood by his Authority of the Laborer, but judged they would be sufficient to erase the existence of even a Paracosm Stage Entity!
After the Shockwave, scalding waves of dark tendrils of brilliance erupted out further, unraveling Existence everywhere they passed.
In the surroundings, the waters endlessly stretched throughout dried as reality distorted and broke down into crumbs.

The weavings of existence crumbled as if they were sand, waves of debris accumulating rapidly as moments later, heavy rotational movements ravaged everything along with the unraveling of Existence, another explosion booming out as it showed...a massive cloud of debris of decaying Existence being flung out in all directions.
It was shocking.
It was monstrous.
It was...
"Beautiful..."

chapters.title: Chapter 3194 The Designation of Anti-Life! I
paragraphs: Beautiful.
This was the word that rose in Noah's mind as he saw the progression of Fat Monkey being deployed and the unraveling of Existence that followed!

Massive shockwaves spreading out for light years, fiery blasts of Existence Devouring heat, and crumbling weavings of existence that all came together to cause a swirling cloud of debris to begin spreading out like a storm endlessly.
The golden chains burning with flames in the surroundings all became broken and joined this enlarging debris, their grande fading so rapidly that it was maddening to see.
Every second that passed, more and more surface area of the Eonic Omniverse Record was being covered as the obsidian tendrils of light that peeled apart Existence itself were everywhere.
Now, at the center of all this...was terrifying Royal Existential Omniversal Simian who had taken this blast head on.
Just how was this Existence faring?
BOOM!
From the very center of unraveling weavings where Fat Monkey was deployed.

A point of flickering gold radiance was flung out like a twinkling star, seeking to escape the raging tendrils of unraveling Existence at the very center and going towards the storm of debris of existence stretching out in the surroundings.

It moved rapidly to escape the expanding range of the Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction with every ounce of its remaining power, this figure becoming clear to Noah as it was hard to look at!
The white gold radiance of the Simian was all bit gone.
Across its body, clear holes could be seen throughout as parts of its skin and musculature were constantly peeling away.
From his eye Sockets, one eye had already fallen out while the other was hanging.
A golden brilliance tried to keep everything together unsuccessfully, more and more of this being's Existence unraveling after taking a direct impact from Fat Monkey!
HUUM!
And yet brilliance continued to unfold as all remaining golden chains were forcefully pulled towards its body, less than 50% making it to his figure while the rest had already broken down.

But the moment they branded themselves unto him, his existence stopped unraveling just for a few moments as he gazed at the unraveling weavings of existence all around with unfathomable rage and hatred, his figure disappearing in the next instant!
WAP!
A terrifying Entity whose power exceeded most Autarchs was so gravely injured and forced to run away from the single explosion of Fat Monkey.
It was a stupendous result!
|The Analysis of the effects of Fat Monkey has exceeded expectations.|
|The area of effect continues to increase with the passage of time, with Existence unraveling at an accelerated rate in the very center of the blast.|
|Further analysis is required to grasp if the area of effect will remain contained, or if the unraveling of Existence becomes an ongoing process that only continues.|
A few things had to be made clear.
They had to know if the unraveling of Existence would stop after a certain point, or if it continued- just how drastic its effects would be!

But at this time, the Eonic Omniverse Record began to shake in its entirety as even though it was a fraction of what an Omniverse was, mere record of it- more than half of its space had been covered by the storm of debris from Fat Monkey.
Over half of its weavings of Existence were actively shredded apart as this process even continued.
So naturally...
|The Wasser Eonic Omniverse Record is proceeding towards an end.|
HUUM!
Entropy cheered.
In the depths of his heart, Apocalypse and other weavings of existence attuned towards the end seethed!
Sadly, the analysis of the full effects of the Fat Monkey may not be observed in their entirety due to how horrific its effects were on this Omniverse Record.
This reality was a great one to see in ascertaining how terrifying the Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction he was designing were, but it was also a cautionary tale.
Something similar to this- maybe much slower and not as disastrous, was the negative effect of Existential Terraforming if things went wrong.
If the augmented weavings of Existence were not stabilized over time.
What he was seeing in real-time at this moment was if the research of the Empress of the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whales ever went wrong- this was exactly what would happen to his Omniverse.
Thus, he had to be vigilant!
The test showed that if powerful enemies of the Commonwealth were close as this weapon was deployed, a genuine chance to decimate them could arise.
Thus, this had to be used with tremendous planning and care.
So...
"Begin the manufacturing of more Fat Monkeys. See if there lies any viable path of increasing their potency and rate of unraveling Existence..."
He would build a grand arsenal of these Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.
It would be dangerous.
It would be beautiful.
But just as he gave this command...
His will buzzed as it felt weavings traverse across an unfathomable distance seeking to reach him.
When he squinted his eyes towards a certain direction to view and analyze them, their weavings were displayed in the form of prompts!
|Your deployment of Fat Monkey and its subsequent results have become a topic being discerned by Entities sitting unfathomably high on the Wheel of Existence.|
HUUM!
His will buzzed as his Records turned tumultuous.
The Wheel of Existence!
He felt like he had just received a glimmer of terrifying information as he remembered the words he had said to Ashmole not too long ago.
The purity of Existence is what keeps the Wheel turning.
Ashmole had erupted with a heavy reaction at these mere words as he knew.
He knew of the Wheel of Existence!

The massive construct that the Commonwealth constructed in his Omniverse at this moment was given through distinction of the Wheel of Weavings as around the structures of the Commonwealth, they had flags painting an image of an intricate Wheel.
The Wheel.

There was something of insurmountable importance with the mere idea of this, and on this day, Noah had done something so heavy that the results of his actions became something that was getting discerned by those sitting with high statures on the Wheel of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3195 The Designation of Anti-Life! II
paragraphs: It was undoubtedly something brought to fruition by the escape of the Royal Existential Omniversal Simian whose very existence was collapsing and being torn to shreds from the effects of Fat Monkey.
|For the first time, the musings of your Existence are being reflected back to you from the Wheel of Existence.|
|The Wheel of Existence contains all things relating to Existence, and the results of your actions have garnered a distinction.|
|Existence is power, and the Distinctions of one's Existence contain even more power. The weavings of your Existence have been associated with the distinction and designation of Anti-Life.|
|Your Source of Existence has become more perceptive and proficient towards all weavings related to the erasure or unraveling of life.|
A flow of information kept coming as Noah and the Infinite Omniverse observed the last flicker that was the Wasser Eonic Omniverse Record.
Anti-Life.
Anti-Existence.
Were they not one and the same? Were the Worms of Existence not considered Anti-Existence with how they treated the weavings of Existence?
Could an Entity be Anti-Life and still be considered a supporter of Existence but simply deny one aspect of Existence itself- Life?
These questions buzzed in Noah's mind as he had to make things clear.
What he did just now- the unraveling of the weavings of Existence itself; was it only antithetical to life in this Eonic Omniverse but not antithetical to Existence itself?
Could what he did actually fall under the banner of Existence?!
He sat with these weavings and mulled them over silently as everything around him shattered into pieces.
He couldn't give a definitive answer. He couldn't say for sure!
But one thing was clear.
The answers, if any, could be affirmed through nothing else but the Wheel of Existence.
Something the powerful echelons of the Commonwealth knew of and understood enough to take the symbol of the Wheel as their core dictum.
|Master, the possibilities of design and computation of the possible Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction have jumped from 1,000 to 1,000,000.|
The voice of the Infinite Omniverse that was connected to his core weavings echoed out in his mind.

It was a tremendous jump in possibilities as this was brought to be by nothing else than the prior flow of information that stated Noah's Source of Existence had become more perceptive and proficient towards all weavings related to the erasure or unraveling of life!
The Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction he could make could become even deadlier.
And...
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy is leaping towards the next phase of Ascendancy.|
|The weavings of Apocalypse have attained the first Phase of Ascendancy.|
|The weavings of Destruction have attained the first Phase of Ascendancy.|.
|The weavings of Tyranny have attained the first Phase of Ascendancy...|
His weavings of Existence geared towards the end surged with power as in his Atlas of Existence, the First Mundi of Power shone brightly.
The Authority of the Laborer within it jumped in production and potency as multiple weavings of concepts elevated their level of Existence!
Uniquely, even his weavings of Tyranny were grouped up as weavings of the end or the unraveling of life.
All of this...came as a byproduct of Noah being designated with the distinction of Anti-Life from the Wheel of Existence.
By those who were already distinguished within it looking at his actions and placing him in this designation!
Such a thing truly showed that stories had power. That Fables...
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Fables is leaping towards the next phase of Ascendancy.|
His Atlas of Existence seethed even further.
Yes.
Stories held tremendous power as depending on how someone was perceived...a lot of things arise from it!
He would allow them to continue perceiving him this way.
In the meantime, he had to understand.
Just what exactly is the Wheel of Existence? "And how can I find you..."
HUUM!

The unraveling of Existence of the Wasser Eonic Omniverse Record reached a critical point as everything crumbled, the First test of a Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction coming to an end as the results it produced were many.
Lost in the tumultuous weavings of Existence, Noah's sectioned Will returned with many boons as there was a lot to ponder on and analyze!
Back in Noah's Natal Omniverse.
Inside what used to be the Heart of Pompeii.
Three thrones floated in the obscurity of silver and ash as Existence itself was trembling after the words that the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor had stated.
He had stated that he was weighing the breadth of their Existences on a scale and deciding whether it was worth the effort to include them all in his plans!
He said this!
But who were they?
One was an Omniversal Ankyra, and the other was an Entity whose origins were not entirely clear.
Noah's gaze was placid as before any replies could be made, the stern eyes of the Imperium Autarch flickered and looked ever closer at Noah as if he had discerned something.
His voice was filled with interminable brilliance as it echoed out calmly.
"And where exactly have we landed on your scale?"
He didn't erupt with unfathomable pride and arrogance.
He didn't exert his influence or bellow out that he was the Omniversal Ankyra!
He only asked calmly amidst such brazen words uttered by Noah.
So Noah looked at this being with the same calm gaze as he replied.

"The Commonwealth is more dangerous than any of us have currently theorized. For the sake of information and understanding everything about them before any moves can be made...there is more benefit in numbers."
More benefit in numbers.
He was not alone within this Omniverse.
There were Entities like Eckert.
There was a genuine Omniversal Ankyra blessed with the weavings of an Omniverse itself.
An Anchor of this entire Omniverse!
The least Noah could do was put him and others to work as he better understood the Commonwealth and how far their reach extended into the Wheel of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3196 Gladiators! I
paragraphs: Three Entities gazed at each other.
All three had different ideologies and mindsets, with each of them leading over their own respective Empires.
On this day, when a common enemy came into their home and began taking over everything- their weavings began to intertwine so that they could ensure that their Fables did not dim into oblivion.
The Imperium Autarch looked at Noah calmly before he began to speak.

"They are carrying out Terraforming of Existence itself across the Omniverse. An Artificial manipulation of Existence that is extremely dangerous, and yet they are proceeding as if it doesn't matter. Any semblance of instability can destroy everything. A positive of this is...the Artificial increase of Existence is causing the complex weavings of Greater and Autarchical Omniversal Authorities to double or triple, which in turn pushes up our power..."
A process affecting their Omniverse also affected them since their System of Existence utilized its weavings of Existence to get where they were!

"What is an utter shame is the fact that this process is irreversible. The new artificial weavings do not hold the best stability as they have their own means to stabilize Existence, and this Omniverse has to now depend on them to perpetuity. Thus, before this problem is solved...even thinking of the destruction of the Commonwealth is akin to destroying ourselves."
The Omniversal Ankyra spoke out about the dire situation the Omniverse was in.
Noah reciprocated his calm gaze as this being had already uncovered much of the information he knew, and gazing at him made him wonder.
What twisted mindset did he have?
To eradicate the entire Lineage of Lumen in the past all for the sake of the Worms of Existence never locating this Omniverse.
To enslave any other traces of those connected to them into Existential Domains governed by Codexes of Extremity that farmed Fruits of Existence all across this Omniverse.
And now, did he see himself still as a chosen being fighting to save this same Omniverse? "..."
The silence made the shrouded figure of the Eonic Uterra to rise as he spoke out gruffly.
"Where I came from...was a place already governed by the Commonwealth. So let me tell you how this Omniverse will look after eons under the rule of the Commonwealth."

Both Noah's eyes and the eyes of the Imperium Autarch turned towards the Eonic Uterra. When he saw the dazzling image of the Protector appear before him in this Omniverse, he did everything in his Existence to pretend not to know anything about them!
He was too weak back then, never seeing anything like the Contract of Existence that was given to him this time around.
And he was successful in passing below their radar.
His figure pulsed with a Devouring light of brilliance as he spoke while gazing up at the dispersing silver rays of ash all around them.

"Over the years, an influx of millions of Entities will occur. In the centers where they began Terraforming, massive devices will be installed and protected by their people as the very essence of the Omniverse will be extracted by them. Slowly. Efficiently. Everything they do, they do so with purpose as after a sufficient enough time, you will feel like an outsider in your own home."
WAA!

"Around you will be invisible chains of regulations and rules that slowly dwindle your very existence. You cannot devour that. You cannot sample another System of Existence. You cannot leave your Omniverse unless permitted. You cannot enter another omniverse unless permitted...A boundless weaving of rules will bind and stifle you to oblivion as you will wish you ceased to exist."
Words that made the atmosphere unfathomably somber echoed out.
Three Entities looked at each other as information about what the future may look like was being shared.
Noah didn't know what the other two were doing outside of this congregation here, but his Will was stretched across multiple areas doing many things!
Inside the Infinite Omniverse.
In an area swirling with thick tendrils of Entropy that made it seem like cycles of Apocalypse were occurring again and again.
The dazzling gold visage of Piety stood tall amidst the raging Entropy as his body pulsed with an unfathomable colorless aura of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence.
The weavings of Lumen he radiated were that much more potent- his Existence having proven its worth after being shredded and ground down again and again by Atlas!
It had battled hundreds of times and been shredded apart hundreds of times.
Not a single victory had been granted to Piety in all of these battles, but it kept on going back again and again with the same goal.
Unbeknownst to it, everything in its existence was shredded apart within the space of the Atlas of Existence by the Authority of the Laborer; its weavings were edited ever so slightly each time.
After enough battles with such a process, the Existence of Piety became substantial enough to handle a glimpse of the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence.
He had proven his existence.
But he wasn't the only one.

With a gaze that showed trauma after having their existence decimated by his father again and again, Henry Osmont was also riding the chaotic waves of the elevating Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy as weavings of the Authority of the Laborer wrapped around him.
Hundreds of Battles without a single win, but he had proven his existence.
And so did the dazzling visage of Sona- an Anomaly that sought to collect anomalies as her mission!
Her figure was bathed in a frosty gold radiance while familiarizing herself with the terrifying new authority, the visage of the Sanctus Autarch not being far from her as she did the same.

The stout figure of Erikson looked like a bronze statue belonging from a celestial beach in his attire as he held a serious expression, Lilith being nearby holding a crimson Codex pulsing with Hatred while Kazuhiko stroked a sharp blade that was coursing with a colorless radiance!
Noah floated before each of these Entities that had proven their Existence as he spoke with interminable clarity.
"They want Gladiators...let us give them Gladiators."

All three had different ideologies and mindsets, with each of them leading over their own respective Empires.
On this day, when a common enemy came into their home and began taking over everything- their weavings began to intertwine so that they could ensure that their Fables did not dim into oblivion.
The Imperium Autarch looked at Noah calmly before he began to speak.
"They are carrying out Terraforming of Existence itself across the Omniverse.
An Artificial manipulation of Existence that is extremely dangerous, and yet they are proceeding as if it doesn't matter.
Any semblance of instability can destroy everything.

A positive of this is...the Artificial increase of Existence is causing the complex weavings of Greater and Autarchical Omniversal Authorities to double or triple, which in turn pushes up our power..."
A process affecting their Omniverse also affected them since their System of Existence utilized its weavings of Existence to get where they were!
"What is an utter shame is the fact that this process is irreversible.

chapters.title: Chapter 3197 Gladiators! II
paragraphs: Gladiators!

On a glorious time when the Commonwealth discovered yet another Omniverse and saved it from the infestation of the Worms of Existence, it was a time of festivities as the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery.

At this moment, the coincidental meeting of the three leaders had already passed as they were all brought into an area within the Wheel of Weavings that held hundreds of floating golden thrones around a circular white table that glowed with Existential radiance.

The center of the table displayed the scene of the landscape of the golden area that was at the center of the Gladiators' Arena- this whole area being termed Gladiators' Barracks where those with the Mark of the Gladiator could stay and communicate with other distinguished entities across different Omniverses while seated on grandiose thrones.

The Guide had finished his job as he was giving Noah blank golden cards that represented Marks of the Gladiators after he asked for more in order for powerful Entities under him to participate, and the Guide had been very enthusiastic regarding this, but his whole expression changed moments later.
A stern light flashed through his eyes as if something had occurred- Noah observing these changes as undoubtedly, they were likely caused by his own action of the deployment of the first Fat Monkey!
News had begun to spread as the identity of the being he gravely wounded- a being that managed and oversaw Eonic Omniverse Records; must have been a distinguished one.
"Is everything okay?"
Noah asked nonchalantly as of course, there would be no way he was involved in whatever had just occurred!
The Guide began to flicker with a spatial radiance as he replied while looking around him.

"The enemies of the Commonwealth seem to be getting bolder and more unique. Some changes have occurred that may even affect the events today- everyone will be notified soon enough. Until then, Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont."
WAP!
With a flicker of radiance, he disappeared.

All of them...would be Entities Noah could begin analyzing as if he met them in the arena and was able to devour weavings of their Authority, it may just be sufficient enough for the Atlas of Existence to replicate them.

Noah kept a hidden smile on his face as he looked around this room filled with white gold radiance and a high potency of Existence- along with the hundreds of thrones that began to fill up with unique entities each with their own Systems of Existence!

All of them...would be Entities Noah could begin analyzing as if he met them in the arena and was able to devour weavings of their Authority, it may just be sufficient enough for the Atlas of Existence to replicate them.
Half of them stemmed from the Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Lineage, and others held different varieties of humanoid forms as Noah observed them closely.
In the far corners of this room, he also observed the figures of the Imperium Autarch and Eonic Uterra on their own thrones.

Uniquely, whether due to his distinction being known by the Commonwealth or by other means, the golden haired Imperium Autarch was smiling and talking with two female Royal Existential Omniversal Simians and someone who seemed to be from the Existential Omniversal Orcanium Whale Lineage- her hair shimmering with blue flames.
They surrounded him in a languid conversation as the Omniversal Ankyra of this Omniverse seemed to be under close watch- with the Commonwealth placing a focus on him due to his importance.
And the Imperium Autarch played along.
The Eonic Uterra, on the other hand, was shrouded by darkness as he seemed to be brooding and watching all those around with care.
Just as Noah's gaze was passing over others...
|I heard you were the native with unique Panaceas of Existence. Might you be interested in a trade? I'm always curious about the products of the weavings of Existence in other Omniverses.|
A feminine voice came out calmly as only he could hear it, his eyes turning to his right as an Entity floated towards him with utmost grace.
Dark hair and dazzling blue eyes, with a white battle dress wrapping around her curves.
Wondrously, Noah felt like he recognized her existence.
But the most astounding of all was her power.
It was enough to make Noah frown as this being...gave a simple curtsy while voicing out with her intent once more.
|Artemisia, of Omniverse 149. And a past Champion of the Gladiators' Arena.|
How he recognized her.
She was one of the many statues lining up the surroundings of the massive expanse of the Arena within the center of this Wheel of Weavings!
Noah nodded towards her while replying.
|Osmont, of the current Omniverse. Future Champion of the Gladiators' Arena. What would you have for a trade?|

His words were dazzling ones as they caused Artemisia to place her hand on her lips while laughing softly, her figure coming closer as she waved her hands and formed a barrier of white light that seemed to isolate things just between them.
It only covered the throne Noah sat on and a few meters nearby as thereafter, Artemisia waved her hands to reveal pure white stones.
Stones.
Yet the essence they held was unfathomably pure and potent as she spoke while allowing a few to float towards Noah.

|Stones of Conviction. Other people call it belief, fealty, or faith- but it is something from my Omniverse that can be extracted from the purest weavings of those you rule over, and have them be condensed into these Stones of Conviction that can elevate your Existence greatly. I want to see how unique or different these are from the Panaceas of Existence you have.|

Noah received the dazzling white stones in his hands as his eyes shone, his own hands waving to bring about a few Quintessential Fruits of Existence that this Entity before him brought towards her with enthusiasm!
Fealty. Belief!
This was something he was already dabbling in, and he wondered if he could cause it to explode in importance with the Stones of Conviction he held in his hands right now.

The possibilities that could open up by understanding more about the Commonwealth began to show themselves already- the Entities stemming from different Omniverses already beginning to mix with each other as the results to come were unknown.

As Noah began to analyze the white stones before him, space fluctuated near his throne, and the figures of Piety, Sona, the Sanctus Autarch, and the rest of his people with the power of Autarchy appeared.
When they arrived, all they saw was his figure seated on a throne and an unfathomably powerful and graceful dark-haired woman floating before him.
They couldn't even see what the two of them exchanged as the power Artemisia held was that terrifying!
And just as everyone began to gather.
As different entities began to talk.
As others secretly exchanged ideas or items.
A voice boomed within this grandiose space filled with thrones and power!

chapters.title: Chapter 3198 Gladiators! III
paragraphs: A powerful voice boomed out across the stellar space filled with floating thrones and Entities burning with power.
Each one seemed to vibrate with Autarchical brilliance, but their heads and wills rose when this voice began to ring out from above.
|The enemies of Existence are becoming more complex in their workings, which leads the Commonwealth to expand its network and seek those who fight in favor of Life. In favor of Existence!|
WAA
The voice was teeming with an undeniable authority that could make the ears of a Paracosm Stage Entity ring, and it only became more pristine as it continued to echo out.

|To expand the reach of the Commonwealth and ensure the longevity of all Existence, those who distinguish themselves enough in the Gladiators' Arena this time will have the chance to be selected to become Protectors of the Commonwealth- Protectors of Existence!|
Boundless waves of interminable Authorities flared.
Artemisia raised her head as her blue eyes radiated immense sharpness, her fair hands twirling with the Quintessential Fruits of Existence with immense scrutiny while these words rang in her mind.
She wasn't the only one as many Gladiators here couldn't help but be surprised at this progression.
Protectors of the Commonwealth.
The vast majority of these beings were Royal Existential Omniversal Simians, with one having to look truly far to come across a Protector that didn't stem from this Lineage.
This was THE Lineage of the Commonwealth.
So to gain the opportunity to become a Protector...
The freedom that came with it! The position one could wield within the Commonwealth!
It was too appealing to not chase after.
|The Honor of all Gladiators remained radiant across the eons...and we wish you all luck in your Existential Battles in the Gladiators' Arena!|
The buzzing voice ended after delivering its heavy news.
As for the chance to become a Protector...

In front of Artemisia, Noah twirled the Stones of Conviction as after passing his Authority of the Laborer throughout them, he sent them across his existence and towards the Infinite Omniverse to be analyzed.
As for the chance to become a Protector...
'What better way to learn about the enemy and how to destroy them than to become one of them...'
His eyes shone with waves of brilliance at such a change that was akin to a butterfly effect brought about by his actions.
The single usage of a Weapon of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction had resulted in such drastic results, with Fat Monkey exceeding all possibilities in its first test!

Even now as all of this happened, The Infinite Omniverse had already begun the process of designing more Fat Monkeys and the possible variations of it that would be even more disastrous- with such a thing being more feasible with Noah's designation of Anti-Life.

|It seems like things will become a bit more interesting this time. Even with all of this, I would love to open up a channel of trade if we can both benefit. Your Panaceas of Existence for my Panaceas of Existence. What do you call yours?|
Artemisia burned with a glint of a pure white radiance as she asked, and Noah replied while putting the rest of the Stones of Conviction away.
|Quintessential Fruits of Existence. And I don't think there will be any harm in exchanging our Panaceas of Existence...|
There wouldn't be any harm.
And why would there be when the preliminary findings of these white stones were so brilliant?
In Noah's mind, much of what they could do was already broken down.

[Stone of Conviction]:: A product of complex weavings of existence made from the extracted fealty and dependence of billions of Entities. Even if it is lacking in any aspect, the one area where it is unmatched across the myriad waves of Existence lies in its purity. The purity of this product of Existence is extremely conducive in the natural growth of any System of Existence, with its purity allowing for usage at any stage of power. If used as a material for alchemy or forging, the products will have a high success chance and potency...
The Stones of Conviction were things that exceeded on the aspect of purity.
And this put them on the stage for many possibilities!
Artemisia smiled at such a reply as she waved her hand to materialize a pristine white chest.

|A Treasure Chest of Conviction. Within lies a Million Stones of Conviction. I wonder if you are able to make this exchange right now for starters? Our business relationship can continue thereafter as we see fit.|

A Million Stones of Conviction. There shouldn't have even been a question on whether Noah could match it as the rate at which the Infinite Omniverse and he produced Quintessential Fruits of Existence before Ruination proceeded to multiply all of them was unfathomable to others.

So he simply constructed a Treasure Chest while altering the weaving of space within it and filled it with a million Quintessential Fruits of Existence- waving his hands to bring it out shimmering with multicolored splendor as Artemisia smiled.
Both sides took their respective chests and put them away as the dark hair of Artemisia shone while the barrier she placed around them began to disappear.
|I look forward to a wonderful arrangement, and hope we are not pitted against each other too quickly in the Arena.|
She gave a quick nod to his people who appeared near his throne as she floated back to her own.
A past Champion.
Her power alone was a terrifying thing as there was still much to learn from her.
From the Atlas of Existence, an intent arose.
|Not enough contact or Devouring of the Authority of the Entity designated as Artemisia was made to provide a sufficient framework for her source of Existence.|
With any Entity he met.
With anyone sufficiently different from him!
He would seek to understand what Source of Existence they had as this was the key in elevating his strength ever higher.
The key in the progression of the Atlas of Existence that only had the First Mundi of Power active!

chapters.title: Chapter 3199 Gladiators! IV
paragraphs: His intent boomed out around him.

Sona, Henry, the Sanctus Autarch...all the strongest combatants of the Infinite Omniverse that were here felt his intent as they pulled out the Marks of the Gladiators he had given them and found their respective thrones.

When he spoke about the strongest combatants of the Infinite Omniverse, he didn't include and incorporate the Queens of the Infinite Omniverse who were currently with his other Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones- spending time with each other as not everybody had to wage war and face danger.
What was he working so hard for this whole time? Was it not to be with his loved ones and spend genuine time with them?

So his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist, Fables, or any myriad of other Clones would occasionally switch and rotate across the Aletheian Havens of the Infinite Omniverse- moving across its wonders with those he cared for the most.
He could have any Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone transition and take the spot of any of his bodies, so he had Quintessence currently taking the reins as the Gladiator.
And he waited.
He waited to enter the arena where he could actually be close to and have the excuse to devour the Authority of another Entity's System of Existence!
Within Noah's Natal Omniverse.
Far away from the construct of the Wheel of Weavings where the Commonwealth had as their base.
In a region filled with hazy auroras of red and white brilliance that only became larger and larger due to the ongoing effects of Existential Terraforming that were occurring from a far distance.
The figure of Protector Antonio could be seen as another Simian accompanied him, the white gold brilliance surrounding them being entirely too potent as the female Simian spoke to him.
"Protector Antonio...what sort of thing could have done that to Protector Commodus? Even now, they've barely managed to stop the unraveling of his existence."
The question was a stern one as this female Protector was looking at a few hundred Synthetic Existences wading through this area and light years ahead of them.

Synthetic Existences. Tools they constructed that were extremely useful in picking up the locations of the Worms of Existence that had undoubtedly gone into hiding mode with a slow accumulation of their Devouring of the Omniverse until they gained enough power.
In the early stages of the Infection when they were still Neonatal Worms of Existence- the utilization of the Synthetic Existences was paramount!
Protector Antonio was following along the progression of this task as the woman beside him simply joined in.
His gaze was just as stern as hers as he replied.

"We have the Anti-Existences seeking to end all of Existence that we fight and hold at bay, and then we have the scattered armies of Anti-Life that should have had their ranks fractured across the Omniverses. Yet now, their threat levels are starting to rise to be just as critical as these Worms. Whatever tool they developed to cause Protector Commodus to enter that state- they are tools that could unfurl the weavings of an entire Omniverse if made even more disastrous than they already are."
WAA!

"That is why...the number of people under us that we can deploy must increase. More Protectors. More limbs for the Commonwealth to move. And we cannot fail in this as nothing else stands between us and the imbalance of life and Existence itself."
His words were unfathomably firm.
They were the Bastion of Existence.
They protected others who may not even know it from threats they may never understand!
They did all of this not for glory or hubris, but for the protection of Existence itself.
The gaze of the female Simian was difficult.
Waner was her name. Protector was her distinction.
And yet...her gaze was unfocused at this moment as she spoke hesitantly.
"But...what of the possible weavings we were forbidden from ever freely mentioning? The weavings that the 99th Viceroy of the Commonwealth uttered out before he perished?"
HUUM!
Stellar words left her mouth as the moment they did so, Protector Antonio stopped gazing at the flow of the Synthetic Existences and came to lock his gaze onto her.
His expression was heavy as he replied.
"We do not talk about that. Those weavings were the weavings of a madman. Someone that should have never held the throne of Viceroy of the Commonwealth."
His face was clear.
He was warning her.
Do not speak.
Do not say anything further about this.
But as if possessed, Protector Waner uttered out with a hazy gaze of fear.
"The 99th Viceroy of the Commonwealth said he foresaw the Breaking of the Wheel of Existence. That it would be done through the hands of the Commonwealth itself! He sought to break us apart and-"
HUUM!
"Do not."
The body of Protector Antonio blazed with heavy, incandescent golden flames as he looked coldly toward Protector Waner.
"Do not speak of this. Understood?"
A clear threat was now within his words.
What the Mad Viceroy uttered before his death was not something for them to pay attention to.
The Viceroy that went mad and wanted the dissolution of the Commonwealth itself based on a bad dream!
"Waner, do you understand?"
Protector Antonio repeated himself again to the woman who seemed to be lost in her own thoughts.
Yet his words carrying profound waves of power shook her out of her reverie as she came to focus on him.

"Words like these can have you stripped of your Distinctions. Words about someone and something that has long since been banned from being spoken about. You are no longer that foolish girl I picked up who idolized heroes and villains. You are a Protector, and you must begin to act like it."
She was a Protector!
These powerful words resounded in her heart as she nodded grimly.

She would not think of it. She wouldn't think of the being who only held the grandest Distinctions when he was alive, ushering the Commonwealth into eons of prosperity. And yet towards the end of his life, he was granted the distinction of a Mad Viceroy.
All because he had uttered the disastrous words that he believed to truly paint the future weavings!
The Breaking of the Wheel.
Words that had nearly fractured the weavings of the Commonwealth itself before the Mad Viceroy was dispatched, and everything was laid to rest!

chapters.title: Chapter 3200 Eonic Brilliance! I
paragraphs: Protector Waner gazed at Antonio with a difficult gaze as he went back to managing the Synthetic Existences and look for the Worms of Existence infecting this Omniverse.
She was a Protector, yes.
She was no longer a foolish girl, yes!
But...
She also questioned.
The one distinguished Viceroy...what if, unlike what everyone wanted to believe, his words held a hint of truth.
What if, sometime in the future, the Commonwealth would truly be involved in the Breaking of the Wheel?
Why? Why did nobody want to even entertain the idea of this possibility?
She questioned and questioned again.
But there was no answer.
In the Wheel of Weavings.
Inside the Gladiators' Arena.

After some time, nearly all the thrones floating before the massive round table were filled, with intents constantly weaving around from different entities as they discussed the prospects of being made Protectors!
After some time...
HUUM!
The round table displaying an illusion of the golden Arena began to flicker and change.
It panned out as more and more of the Arena was seen, the massive statues of past Champions being seen at this moment as from all around, instruments began to play!
The low beat of a drum.
Melodic horns of victory and power!
They slowly began to pick up pace before moments later, they were joined by a massive shout of cheers.
Cheers.
Apart from the statues, the scene displayed throngs of millions upon millions of Entities cheering on seats that circled the massive Arena!
The figures of mainly Simians raised their hands while billowing out in exhilaration and excitement, and a booming voice echoed out alongside them.
|Citizens of the Commonwealth!|
WAA!
A cherry voice filled with power.
It was met with resounding cheers across the Gladiators' Arena as it continued.
|There are a great deal of worries as the Commonwealth fights for Existence, but we never let these worries bog us down as we make sure to celebrate when it counts!|
On the table, illusory scenes continued to flash as they finally panned to a single being floating above the golden Arena.
A Royal Existential Omniversal Simian with pure white fur and gold streaks across his chest.
His whole body emanated valor and battle as the beat of drums and horns booming out seemed to come from him!

|We celebrate, O Citizens of the Commonwealth, and on this glorious Celebration of Omniversal Discovery, the Commonwealth is proud to add a new Omniverse under our banner- an omniverse that from this day forth shall be deemed...Omniverse X- 999!|
Omniverse X- 999.
On the thrones observing all of this, Noah's eyes shone with interminable brilliance.
Their Omniverse had received a number.
His Natal Omniverse had officially been taken by others who stated that they discovered it, and they had now renamed it to what they wished!

|I am Nuntius Eshkeri, and I have been tasked with the glorious purpose of announcing the distinction of Omniverse X-999, as well as the even grander honor of introducing the presence of those who keep the Wheel turning.|
|On this day of the Celebration of Omniversal Discovery, we have been blessed with the presence...of the Viceroy of the Commonwealth!|
BOOM!
Within the domain Noah and the others were in.
Boundless waves of authority erupted as many Entities showed genuine shock.
They showed shock because of the rarity of what was currently occurring!
The Viceroy...the governing body of the Commonwealth was rarely seen across the Omniverses, only making appearances within special Omniverses over the years.
Was this Omniverse that special? That even the Viceroy made his presence here?!
On the table showing the illusory scene of Nuntius Eshkeri, his visage turned towards the front of the Arena where at this time, a golden sea unfurled.
A glorious golden sea that showed resplendent thrones on it- 9 thrones in total!
The central throne was slightly bigger than the rest as above it, a golden wheel spun while releasing waves of brilliance.
Not all the thrones were filled.
Beside the largest throne, the three thrones to the left and to the right were filled, leaving behind two empty ones!

On the central throne, a relatively young looking Simian could be seen seated, his face showing immeasurable grace and power as an unfathomably few could even manage to look at his image for longer than a second.
He was draped in golden garments, his figure that of a regal Simian with gold and purple fur.

His expression emanated boundless brilliance and benevolence as beside him, the other occupied thrones were seated with aged Royal Existential Omniversal Simians whose presence alone could press down on an entire Omniverse.
There was a woman to his right who was actually fully human, not an ounce of fur on her fair skin as a head full of golden white brilliance of hair draped past her shoulders.
Adorned in a white dress, her eyes were extremely sharp as they stared forth coldly.

To the left of the central throne, there was a Simian filled with silver white fur- an Entity that even the illusory screen couldn't show too well as Existence seemed to be constantly distorting around him.
This being.
The one on the central Throne.
The woman to his right.
And all the other unique Entities occupying the other thrones...Noah looked at all of them as he confirmed with certainty.
None of these beings were remotely within the bounds of Autarchy or anything equivalent to it.
Their power had long since exceeded this stage!
|We welcome and thank the 81st Viceroy of the Commonwealth for his presence. The Palatine of the Commonwealth. The Cardinal of the Wheel! The Heir of the First Exalted Simian...Viceroy Gilgamesh!|
OOOOH!
Unfathomably profound shouts of valor and joy echoed out.
Seated on the throne, the young looking Simian waved his hand with grace and honor.
The Palatine of the Commonwealth.
The Cardinal of the Wheel.
The Heir to the First Exalted Simian!
His Distinctions were many.
His power was unfathomable.
His presence here today...marked the beginning of something glorious as all of the Gladiators' Arena was shaking from his mere appearance!
