chapters.title: Chapter 3201 Eonic Brilliance! II
paragraphs: At the forefront of the Gladiators' Arena.
Basked with a sea of golden brilliance under them, nine thrones floated with unfathomable serenity.
On the Central Throne, the Heir to the First Exalted Simian waved his hands to the millions of masses seated all around the Arena.
Among the masses, the weakest ones were at the Sequor Stage as they ranged all the way to Paracosm- with a few dozen auras of Autarchical Equivalent Entities seated in special areas of the Arena!
With the spotlight on these grandiose Thrones, the voice of Nuntius Eshkeri continued to bombard outwards.

|With the Grace of the Heir to the First Exalted Simian, we shall kick off this Celebration of Omniversal Discovery with battles of Existence that have everything at stake- the Victors and renowned Gladiators having the chance to be chosen as Protectors of the Commonwealth!|
OOOH!
A blaze of cheers and valor.
A cacophony of noises reverberated throughout as Nuntius Eshkeri wrapped up his introduction.
|For this, we will welcome the first Gladiators and kick things off! From Omniverse X- 456, Prime Citizen Dexus shall go against Prime Citizen Mikah from Omniverse X- 433!|
Within the Domain filled with floating thrones, two lit up brightly as in a randomized fashion, two Gladiators were chosen.

The thrones they sat on began to vibrate with a spatial light as they looked across and locked gazes, their figures being teleported out of this space as they reappeared thousands of miles away from each other atop the golden sands of the Arena.
On the table all thrones floated on, the scenes of these beings on the Arena flourished and enlarged as things were going to kick off.
In the skies, Nuntius Eshkeri turned back towards the Nine Golden Thrones as he bowed towards them and spoke with reverence.
|If Viceroy Gilgamesh will give us the grace to begin...|
The grace to begin.

The magisterial entity filled with an Unknown charm and power on the central Throne smiled as his hand swung down, booming voices roaring out within the Gladiators' Arena as on the golden sand, colorless authority began to burn.
Back on the Nine Thrones.
"What a clown show this is. We already have details on everyone under us as we already know who among them we will choose as the new Protectors. Did I really have to show myself for this?"
The voice of the Viceroy emanated out calmly as he uttered words others would be shocked to hear.

Those seated on the thrones beside him didn't show any falter of emotions on their faces as the human woman smiled while speaking out, her white dress and golden white hair making her seem like an eonic celestial from the wildest fantasy.
Her beauty was something very few could even imagine as her voice was even more so.
"An Emperor should always take the time to show his presence to his subjects, my son, lest they forget or don't even know who rules over them."
Her son.
The mother of Viceroy Gilgamesh.
That was the identity of this pristine woman beside him!
Viceroy Gilgamesh scowled at her words as he replied.
"It is enough that I know I rule over them. I am the Viceroy. I have the Authority over the Commonwealth. Why must I pose a façade?"
Why must he not show who he was to the people? Why did he have to paint and keep a certain image?!
The Mother of the Viceroy looked to the thrones around her as she was about to advise her son again when...
"Do you remember any of the Viceroys that came before you?"
HUUM!
A thick voice echoed out.
One that even caused the Mother of the Viceroy to change her gaze as it came from the other throne beside her son.
There, a man advanced in age could be seen as his figure was robust, with his body adorned in an armor that shone with multicolored brilliance m.
An Armor renowned in the Commonwealth as it was known by the distinction of The Omniversal Carapace!
Something rumored to have been forged with the backbone of a dying Omniverse.
The man who wore it held features of a Royal Existential Omniversal Simian, his fur being radiant white as his face was that of utmost regality.
The Viceroy of the Commonwealth held many titles, while this man held a single one.
|The Sword of the Commonwealth|.
An utterly terrifying Entity as when one looked at the positioning of the thrones, they may wonder if the order was wrong.
Because the power that this one being silently emanated...entirely outclassed nearly all others seated on these thrones.
Such a being calmly asked the Viceroy if he remembered any of the Viceroys that came before him.
Viceroy Gilgamesh's gaze became sour as he turned to face this Entity who didn't even look at him as he didn't reply.
But this being continued.

"It may be hard to recall, with the last one being your father. But he lies dead somewhere- just like all the Viceroys before you. The highest mortality rate in the Commonwealth is that of Viceroys because of the duty it represents."
WAA!

"So you will put up a façade when told to do so. You will play your role when told to do so. There are many Viceroys that came before you, and there will be those that come after you. Do you understand?"
Immense silence followed.
The golden eyes of Viceroy Gilgamesh burned with countless splendor, but he didn't erupt or reply as he now only looked ahead.
A simple conversation.
But it showed a glimpse of the complex weavings of power of the Commonwealth as even a glimpse of their figureheads....showed that power did not simply burn with the seat of the Viceroy.
There were more complex weavings at work that others couldn't even imagine!
In the Arena.
Only seconds had passed, and yet the crowds were roaring out with fervor as on the golden sands of the Arena, the man from Omniverse X- 433 was standing over the one from Omniverse X- 456.
Above him, thousands of eyes were swirling with a hypnotic light- a light that was so potent that it put their enemy under their control before the battle could even unfold.
|An astounding victory for a very quick first match! Victory goes to Prime Citizen Mikah from Omniverse X- 433!|
WOO!

The announcer that was Nuntius Eshkeri bellowed out with fervor from above as the victor raised his fist up in the air- his body and the body of the defeated being wrapped by a spatial light thereafter as they disappeared.
|This next one is unique as one side, we have a combatant from this newly Discovered Omniverse X- 999, Prime Citizen Imperium! On the other side, we have Prime Citizen Entah from Omniverse X- 889!|
Brilliance flourished.
And soon after, atop the golden sand...the figures of the Imperium Autarch and a man shrouded in a crimson robe appeared!

On the table all thrones floated on, the scenes of these beings on the Arena flourished and enlarged as things were going to kick off.
In the skies, Nuntius Eshkeri turned back towards the Nine Golden Thrones as he bowed towards them and spoke with reverence.
|If Viceroy Gilgamesh will give us the grace to begin...|
The grace to begin.

The magisterial entity filled with an Unknown charm and power on the central Throne smiled as his hand swung down, booming voices roaring out within the Gladiators' Arena as on the golden sand, colorless authority began to burn.
Back on the Nine Thrones.
"What a clown show this is.
We already have details on everyone under us as we already know who among them we will choose as the new Protectors.
Did I really have to show myself for this?"
The voice of the Viceroy emanated out calmly as he uttered words others would be shocked to hear.

Those seated on the thrones beside him didn't show any falter of emotions on their faces as the human woman smiled while speaking out, her white dress and golden white hair making her seem like an eonic celestial from the wildest fantasy.
Her beauty was something very few could even imagine as her voice was even more so.
"An Emperor should always take the time to show his presence to his subjects, my son, lest they forget or don't even know who rules over them."
Her son.
The mother of Viceroy Gilgamesh.
That was the identity of this pristine woman beside him!
Viceroy Gilgamesh scowled at her words as he replied.
"It is enough that I know I rule over them.
I am the Viceroy.
I have the Authority over the Commonwealth.
Why must I pose a façade?"
Why must he not show who he was to the people?
Why did he have to paint and keep a certain image?!
The Mother of the Viceroy looked to the thrones around her as she was about to advise her son again when...
"Do you remember any of the Viceroys that came before you?"
HUUM!
A thick voice echoed out.
One that even caused the Mother of the Viceroy to change her gaze as it came from the other throne beside her son.
There, a man advanced in age could be seen as his figure was robust, with his body adorned in an armor that shone with multicolored brilliance m.
An Armor renowned in the Commonwealth as it was known by the distinction of The Omniversal Carapace!
Something rumored to have been forged with the backbone of a dying Omniverse.
The man who wore it held features of a Royal Existential Omniversal Simian, his fur being radiant white as his face was that of utmost regality.
The Viceroy of the Commonwealth held many titles, while this man held a single one.
|The Sword of the Commonwealth|.
An utterly terrifying Entity as when one looked at the positioning of the thrones, they may wonder if the order was wrong.
Because the power that this one being silently emanated...entirely outclassed nearly all others seated on these thrones.
Such a being calmly asked the Viceroy if he remembered any of the Viceroys that came before him.
Viceroy Gilgamesh's gaze became sour as he turned to face this Entity who didn't even look at him as he didn't reply.
But this being continued.
"It may be hard to recall, with the last one being your father.
But he lies dead somewhere- just like all the Viceroys before you.
The highest mortality rate in the Commonwealth is that of Viceroys because of the duty it represents."
WAA!
"So you will put up a façade when told to do so.
You will play your role when told to do so.
There are many Viceroys that came before you, and there will be those that come after you.
Do you understand?"
Immense silence followed.
The golden eyes of Viceroy Gilgamesh burned with countless splendor, but he didn't erupt or reply as he now only looked ahead.
A simple conversation.
But it showed a glimpse of the complex weavings of power of the Commonwealth as even a glimpse of their figureheads....showed that power did not simply burn with the seat of the Viceroy.
There were more complex weavings at work that others couldn't even imagine!
In the Arena.
Only seconds had passed, and yet the crowds were roaring out with fervor as on the golden sands of the Arena, the man from Omniverse X- 433 was standing over the one from Omniverse X- 456.
Above him, thousands of eyes were swirling with a hypnotic light- a light that was so potent that it put their enemy under their control before the battle could even unfold.
|An astounding victory for a very quick first match!
Victory goes to Prime Citizen Mikah from Omniverse X- 433!|
WOO!

The announcer that was Nuntius Eshkeri bellowed out with fervor from above as the victor raised his fist up in the air- his body and the body of the defeated being wrapped by a spatial light thereafter as they disappeared.
|This next one is unique as one side, we have a combatant from this newly Discovered Omniverse X- 999, Prime Citizen Imperium!
On the other side, we have Prime Citizen Entah from Omniverse X- 889!|
Brilliance flourished.
And soon after, atop the golden sand...the figures of the Imperium Autarch and a man shrouded in a crimson robe appeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 3202 Eonic Brilliance! III
paragraphs: On an arena being watched with the eyes of countless powerful individuals.
The figure of the Imperium Autarch appeared with stupendous grace and beauty as he seemed like an Entity outside of a painting.
When one thought of a hero. When one thought of a chosen entity who would rise to save his people.
His golden hair and eyes, his disposition...this being held it all!
Standing on the golden sands of the Arena that seemed sturdier than Planes of Existence, Imperium stared at his enemy from Omniverse X- 889.
And he asked calmly.
"Entah...what might your System of Existence be?"
Casual words.
Words that the crimson robed man with dark hair heard and smiled, his body beginning to burn into streams of flames that flowed upwards to open countless portals.
"I am a Spiritualist. I've lived for eons contracting Spirits under my banner, their strength flowing through me as in an instant..."
HUUM!
Around him, massive illusory figures of different mythical animals began to appear.
A Nine Horned Unicorn. A DragoPhoenix. A Three Headed Turtle!
One after another, each one bathed in colorless flames.
When they added up to 9 Spirits in total, the region around the Spiritualist burned with Infernal brilliance as he smiled.
"What of you, Little Ankyra? What can you do?"
Words filled with mockery.
And Imperium smiled as he began to take steps forward.
"I play with the laws and concepts that make up our surrounding Existence."
BZZT!
As he began to walk, the space above them trembled- colorless brilliance gushing out like a sea as he continued.

"Take the concept of Aitiologia. It encompasses many things within this omniverse as its basics deal with cause and effect. I can look at the weavings of your Existence, Spiritualist, and question the link you have formed with your Spirits."

"I question the consequences of your actions of subjugating these Spirits...And I enhance these possible consequences. I distort the Causality of the forceful bond you have formed and bring forward only a single possibility..."
The gaze of the Spiritualist rapidly changed.

A colorless Omniversal Authority had permeated the surrounding's Existence that caused his Spirits to roar out, their eyes quickly losing their stable light as, after a few roars, they shook their heads while turning their gazes below them.
At the man that bound them.

The Spiritualist gazed up with incredulity as his control over his Spirits faltered, and he didn't regain it quickly enough as in the next moment, all the Spirits he had summoned dove towards him to rip him apart.
Silence prevailed before moments later...
OOOH!
Roars of immense joy and excitement echoed out across the Arena.
Imperium had expertly and efficiently only utilized a single powerful Omniversal Authority, and he turned the force of his own enemy against himself in a show of grace and power.
Above, the voice of Nuntius Eshkeri roared out with valor.
|A smooth victory for the Omniversal Ankyra of this newly Discovered Omniverse!|

Golden brilliance spread out as a spatial light covered Imperium, his figure being teleported away as on the Arena, the Existence of a Spiritualist had been devoured cleanly by his own Autarchical Spirits that roared out with madness towards the surroundings- intent on going on a rampage and attacking others.
But the Simian Visage of Nuntius Eshkeri gazed down coldly and tapped his fingers.
From above, drops of golden rain fell.
The moment they came in contact with the Autarchical Spirits, they roared out as they felt their existence beginning to be extinguished!
Thousands of droplets rained down as within moments, not a glimmer of the Spirits remained.
|Next...!|
And the booming voice of Nuntius Eshkeri continued as the matches of the Gladiators continued on!
One after another.
Matches that showcased the power of unique Sources of Existence unfolded under the eyes of many, Noah watching all of it with a sharp gaze as after Imperium, dozens of other matches went on.
Noah's mind was on many things, but one of the foremost was the image he had saved in his mind of the Nine Thrones that were briefly shown to them.
The Thrones that held the Viceroy of the Commonwealth.
Was he truly the core power of the Imperium?
At a single first glance, he could see that none of the beings on the mostly filled Nine Thrones were not within the Autarchical Equivalent Stage.
But he couldn't say for sure if the seat of the Viceroy represented the utmost power of the Commonwealth!
Subconsciously, his eyes were drawn towards the Cold and calm gaze of a man beside the throne of the Viceroy.
His mind could see him there. His eyes could see him there. And yet it was also like this being didn't exist.
This glimpse of the possible leadership of the Commonwealth was critical as he didn't know when the next time would be, but just as he was lost in his thoughts...
|This next one is another unique combatant from this newly Discovered Omniverse X- 999, Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont On the other side, we have Prime Citizen Adaman from Omniverse X- 112!|
His name was uttered out.
His throne began to shine as around him, other Gladiators drew sharp breaths.
This matchup...did not seem entirely fair.
The numbers of the Omniverses mattered as the lower they were, the earlier they were in being discovered by the Commonwealth.
It was a basic rule that more likely than not, those from earlier Omniverses held much more power.
It wasn't always true, but it was held to be true for the vast majority of instances!
And Adaman of Omniverse X-112...was a man known by a few here.
Silent prayers were made as in the next moment, Noah's figure appeared on the golden sands of the Arena.
His figure drew sharp breaths from many, the female entities within the thrones of the audience cheering out as his visage of tremendous beauty showed itself.
His colorless Wings stretched out behind his back and his feet as he looked like a celestial entity coming down to dish out judgment!

chapters.title: Chapter 3203 Eonic Brilliance! IV
paragraphs: A white battle robe wrapped around him as his enemy...was a burly man with his chest laid bare.
Dark hair danced wildly to his shoulders as his visage was frighteningly sculpted.
Black briefs covered his lower half, his visage humanoid as he smiled and spoke towards Noah.
"The first guy from your Omniverse was curious what his enemy's System of Existence was, so I'll tell you mine..."
The entity raised his hands as Existence faltered and trembled with his mere raise.

"In my Omniverse, everyone is born with Attribute Values that we can designate to specific aspects of our Existence. All of the Attribute Values I've collected over the eons...have gone to the Aspect of Existence easiest to raise- my body. And over time...it has become impenetrable"
HUUM!
The very weavings of Existence trembled.
With a flicker of his feet, this being disappeared.

An instant later, he was already above Noah- his fist thundering down his head as he could already see the scene of this head bursting like a watermelon- The Existence of this being soon after that dissipating!
But...
"Interesting..."
Noah's head turned up at the fist thundering down as his Eyes of Deorcnysse spun.
And all light faded in the next instant as if a light illuminating Existence was flicked off!
Light across the whole arena!
The only place where light couldn't even come close to being absorbed was around Nuntius Eshkeri and the dazzling Nine Thrones in the far distance.

In this darkness, a singularity of light bloomed above Noah's head as it turned into an unfathomable beam of light that radiated everything upwards, the enemy above him being flung out as he steadied himself in the space above!
His visage remained unblemished.
Within the Autarchical Equivalent Stage, this Entity far exceeded the power of Entities like the Faesinged Queen or Sunwinged Leprachanus.
But Noah still had not collected enough data to set up a staging of power within the Autarchical level- something he sought to do as he fought and observed more fights with beings of this stage!

He expected that at some point within these battles, he would have enough clarity to properly outline the Autarchical Stage and where he stood on it compared to others- and even such a staging system applicable across different Systems of Existence.
But first...
"Since you pride your body the most, let me reciprocate."
No weavings of concepts.
He simply tapped into his First Mundi of Power as silently, the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence flowed over his body.

An authority that had already been terrifying, but it was further enhanced when multiple concepts relating to Natural Laws and Decreta were taken to the level of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities.
When he was designated as Anti-Life and all concepts dealing with the end received significant boons!

All of it only strengthened this authority as he had it come out in the form of dancing white flames that covered his body, and he then tapped his feet on the golden sand below as he instantly appeared before his opponent in the space above, his hand thundering out.
Adaman was only just barely capable of reacting, his gaze becoming stern as he blocked this fist coming with both hands!
CRACK!
His impenetrable body.
On this day, the palms on his hands felt a tremendous impact as the skin on them actually cracked, blood beginning to leak out as Adaman gazed forward incredulously!
Yet the man who had breached his defenses actually showed disappointment in his eyes as he shook his head while disappearing.
"Not sufficiently different enough."
WAP!
Not sufficient different enough.
This was the last thing Adaman heard before the figure bathed in white flames disappeared, his senses only tingling to let him know something was coming from above.
By the time he tried to dodge, he felt another strike from the side, below him, and above him again as his enemy moved at speeds he couldn't match!
So the only thing unfolding next were horrific indentation of fists appearing on the supposedly impenetrable body of Adaman, his figure becoming deformed as after a second...
SHAA!
Noah reappeared in front of him once more as he uttered out.
"Fatality."
His colorless wings fluttered.
"Alchemical Processing."
Causality twisted and distorted.

Around the heavily injured Adaman whose very existence was shaken to the core with every attack Noah had thrown, a colorless Cauldron instantly manifested- his figure contained entirely within as the last thought he had was...
"What the f-"
HUUM!

His existence was then interrupted, displaced, and refined within an instant as within the Cauldron, everything that made this terrifying Autarchical Equivalent Entity was somehow ground down to a single colorless pill!
A pill that flew out of the dissipating cauldron and became devoured by Noah right away.
|A new Source of Existence is being analyzed.|
|The System of Existence of Attribute Value Allocation is being analyzed.|
|The newly discovered System of Existence is not complex enough to be placed in a Mundi of its own and will be assimilated into the First Mundi of Power.|
Unbeknownst to others, an array of prompts came before his eyes while roars of cheers echoed out across the Arena.
The booming voice of Nuntius Eshkeri echoed out.
|Yet another victory for the Natives of this Omniverse! Are they unstoppable?!|
OOOOH!
Cheers and roars echoed out amidst such a reality.
As a spatial light began to wrap around him, Noah gazed around at the cruel reality that was showing through the gaps of the Commonwealth.

In the Arena, Gladiators could finish the battle without decimating the Existence of others, but if one did entirely destroy the existence of their opponent...this received even more cheers as there were no consequences.
Destruction was craved by those watching.
Destruction was permitted by those officiating as Nuntius Eshkeri did not bat an eye, only proceeding with the next battle!
It showed just how cruel the next day was about to be as depending on how many people were like Noah...a great deal of Autarchical Equivalent Entities were about to fall!

chapters.title: Chapter 3204 The Quantification of Autarchy! I
paragraphs: The Gladiators' Arena.
Its golden sands gradually became painted with crimson-gold blood that glimmered with Existence.
The Royal Existential Omniversal Simians on the thrones of the audiences roared with fervor at the battles that showed the weavings of the very peak of Existence.
The Entities of other Omniversal Lineages- Citizens of the Commonwealth from a myriad of Omniverses, all had the same feeling of valor and glee as many Gladiators came and went.
Others finished their battles amicably, while many more were brutal as the opponent had their existence entirely shredded, destroyed, or devoured.
At this moment.
"You are a child! I can see it in your Existence! You dare stand before me who has lived for millions of years?!"

The roar of a massive Existential Omniversal Octopoda echoed out as thousands of tentacles unfurled, but from above...massive golden Pillars of Destiny surrounded by arcs of colorless brilliance thundered down and locked every tentacle in place.
Floating above the golden sands, Henry Osmont clasped his hands on his chest as he uttered out.
"The Destiny of your Existence has been written in stone."
Utilizing the thin strands of the Authority of the Laborer accessed from his father, Henry rewrote the Destiny of an Autarchical Equivalent Stage Entity to something he deemed.
And the Destiny of this Existential Omniversal Octopoda was to be devoured by the Pillars of Destiny surrounding it as its whole Existence would be an offering towards his Father!

Every strand of his attack carried the Authority of the Laborer- it meant that the Will and Intent of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor was observing everything as if he were on the battlefield himself.
His Father.
Below the golden sands of the Gladiators' Arena, in the enclosed space with floating thrones around a circular table, many prompts were floating in front of Noah.

|Enough analysis has been made with multiple subjects exhibiting the Autarchical Equivalent Stage to formulate a fairly accurate distinction of power within this Stage, applicable to all Sources of Existence.|

A lot of samples were observed by Noah personally, from when Henry and others had their matches, and as he simply continued to silently analyze all the Autarchical Equivalent existences in this domain.
And after careful consideration and analysis, a mostly accurate quantification of the power of Autarchical Existences was made!

|Initial entry into the Autarchical Stage allows an Entity to utilize this apex authority of Existence commonly displayed with a colorless hue in a process that alters their Existence entirely. This enactment is akin to the building of a foundation that allows them to easily alter their surrounding Existence in absolute ways that cannot be overcome unless someone of similar power is present. This is the Autarchical Existence Foundation Stage, or simply the subject is a Foundation Autarch.|

|After enough time passes with the respective System of Existence continuing to enhance and elevate the level of the Autarchical Existence, they enter a vast Stage where they accumulate more and more Autarchical Authority in their existence- their Existence undergoing constant changes in this period as their usage of the colorless authority becomes much more complex. This is the Autarchical Existence Accumulation Stage, or simply the subject is an Accumulation Autarch.|

|Lastly, the stage where most of the observed Protectors of the Commonwealth seem to be in- the last Stage of Autarchy before a comprehensive jump is made towards another realm entirely, and the last defined stage under the umbrella of the Existential Dominium Realm. At this stage, the manner and usage of Autarchical Authority is one that could easily overcome anyone below it, with their outlook on Existence expressed and ensured heavily as they cannot be easily erased even with another Entity at the same stage. This is the Autarchical Existence Apogee, or simply the subject is an Apogee Autarch.|
Three levels of Autarchy!
This was how Noah outlined a simple quantifying of the Entities he came across.
A Foundation Autarch, an Accumulation Autarch, and lastly- an Apogee Autarch!
The vast majority were Foundation Autarchs.
Henry. Sona. Piety.
The Entity that he decimated first in the Arena, Adaman, was someone within the early rungs as an Accumulation Autarch.
And then there were Entities like Protector Antonio.
Unfathomable in their power as Noah knew he couldn't eradicate them just yet.
Entities such as him were Apogee Autarchs as their brilliance was undeniable.
And they stood just below the next Realm of Power.
One that when Noah looked at the illusions of the terrifying figures seated on the Nine Thrones, he made a simple analysis.
'The next realm of power if one is capable and lucky enough to exceed Autarchy of the Existential Dominium Realm...'
|The Omniversal Realm has been selected as the distinction for the next stage of power succeeding the Existential Dominium Realm.|
Omniversal.
The Entities that were far out of grasp for the current him.
The upper echelons of the Commonwealth!
He could only theorize regarding this stage as at this moment, his own power was still growing as it could be grouped in the Accumulation Autarch Stage.
With him though, there was always the factor of discrepancy.
Unlike others, he didn't just have a single System of Existence- with the Assimilated Systems of Existence so far scaling his Atlas heavily and unpredictably!
It was why even at this moment...a massive Existential Omniversal Octopoda was smashed to bits with the radiant Pillars of Destiny.
From above, the Nuntius Eshkeri roared out as always.
|Victor- Henry! The Natives of this Omniverse remain undefeated! Who would it take to stop their relentless advancement?!|
A bellow of showmanship echoed out from above, but in front of Noah's eyes- a brand new set of prompts came down.
|The Source of Existence of the Existential Omniversal Octopoda has been analyzed and is not sufficiently different enough to be placed in its own Mundi of Power.|
|The System of Existence of Aquatinium is being assimilated into the First Mundi of Power.|
Uniquely, he had yet to come across even a single System that was fully analyzed to be deemed sufficiently different.
He knew one of them to be under the banner of the powerful Simian Protectors, but their analysis wouldn't be done unless he had one decimated before him.
But this whole time, every System of Existence he came across was not deemed sufficiently different as he wondered...when would something unique actually appear?

chapters.title: Chapter 3205 The Quantification of Autarchy! II
paragraphs: Nuntius Eshkeri gazed down below as his white gold fur blazed with brilliance.
He initiated the command to send the owner of the Mark of the Gladiator who had just won- Henry, back towards his Throne of Waiting as in his mind, he was communicating with someone else.

'How about we take things up a notch? We can't have the natives continue with an over inflated ego...assimilating them into the Commonwealth will be that much harder. For the next one, let's beat them to the point of death while sparing them at the end, okay?'
He sent out such an intent privately as after he received a reply of affirmation, he smiled brightly as he amplified his voice across the Arena and bellowed out.
|By a stroke of fate, we have yet another match lined up back to back that has a native of this Omniverse! Will they continue their glorious streak and etch their names in the sands of this Arena?!|
Brilliance flashed.
Nuntius Eshkeri glanced down below the Arena as if he could see across all layers, his pupils dancing with majesty as he came to lock onto a singular figure.
Uniquely, this figure seemed to also be staring up at him as the smile of Nuntius Eshkeri became even deeper!
'Adding the tag of Emperor next to your name? Gazing at everything as if it were beneath you? Haha, how about we expand your perspective just a little bit? On how vast these Omniverses are?'
As if they could see each other across the heavy walls of the Wheel of Existence.
Nuntius Eshkeri smiled and bellowed out.
|This next one is a returning combatant from this newly Discovered Omniverse X- 999, Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont! On the other side...we have Prime Citizen Zimo from Omniverse X-25|
WAA!
A wave of silence was ushered in after the announcement.
But it only lasted ever so briefly before...
OOOH!
The booms of excitement spread out all around.
Even the audience could feel it.
A bloodbath was coming!
Omniverse X-25.
A very early Omniverse to be discovered as a few knowledgeable beings smacked their lips in shock at such a choice.
And yet in the next moment, the visage of the winged Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont appeared calmly above the golden sands of the Arena.
Opposite him...
HUUM!
Was a man who seemed advanced in age, and yet also filled with boundless vitality.
Adorned in an obsidian robe, he had a head full of dark hair and eyes with pure white pupils.
He gave off a sense of eeriness and wonder at the same time as in his hands was a simple white sword!
He gazed towards Noah with a sense of apathy and calmness as he voiced out.
"I've seen your actions. Your voracious thirst."
WAA!
He merely began to talk.
Yet immediately, the surrounding Existence became unstable while white points of singularities began to form.
"You devour every enemy you come across as you take the easy way up. Or so you think. What you misinterpret about Existence is that the more you take from others...the less you actually have."
"I will instill this lesson unto you, Osmont. I am Zimo, a follower of the Tao of Ginnungagap, or what you may know as Primordial Chaos."
HUUM!
Incandescent brilliance unfurled from this being as he raised his sword calmly!
Around him, dense numbers of white singularities that seemed to contain the unfathomable light of beginnings and endings bloomed.
Opposite him, Noah's gaze was actually getting brighter and brighter even amidst sensing waves of potent danger, and this was because of one reason and one reason alone!
|A Source of Existence that potentially holds high complexity has begun to be analyzed.|
A possibility came before him.
One that he quickly wanted to grasp onto as very quickly, more prompts cascaded down!
|The enemy target known as Zimo is judged to be at the absolute peak as an Accumulation Autarch.|
Somebody who was at the cusp of the stage of power that most Protectors of the Imperium were at!
It was a heavy level of power to face as it would be a test of how far his Atlas of Existence had reached.
It would also be a test for something else that was being designed since the first experiment of Fat Monkey.
With bright eyes observing the waves of power ahead, he sent his intent out to a far distance.
|Is the production of the Second Generation Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction at a stage for viable usage?|
His intent asked.
And of course, it was directed to the Infinite Omniverse that had an array of fantastical weavings in the works!
In the depths of the Aletheian Haven of Entropy.
The Manifestation of a woman filled with multicolored radiance handed a small point of singularity the size of a grain of sand carefully to someone opposite her.
A humanoid figure adorned in a crimson gold battle dress that was none other than Ruination!

Feeling Noah's intent, the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse nodded succinctly as she watched the singularity she handed to Ruination vibrate in her hands- a crimson brilliance wrapping around it before the single singularity became ten singularities instantly.

|The Production of Miniature versions of Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction has entered medium scaling. The first series are named Singularities of Unraveling as they can be deployed to display their effects in a contained aspect of Existence- whether this be in terms of a specific distance or targeted towards a specific concept. Their activation only requires a spark of the Authority of the Laborer. |
A newer version of the Fat Monkey that didn't have such widespread effects of destruction as the first one that ruined an entire Eonic Omniverse Record.

But ones that were more specific and targeted- something that Noah was even bold enough to deploy right now before the eyes of the Commonwealth as they wouldn't even be able to connect their capabilities to what he had done to the powerful protector in the Wasser Eonic Omniverse Record.
Their purpose was a singular one.
The instant negation and unraveling of their targeted weavings of Existence- making them entirely useless no matter which powerhouse they belonged to.
And what better test subject could there be than someone nearing the Apogee Autarch level?
Within shining eyes ready for anything to come, Noah's command came down once more.
|Send half of all produced Singularities of Unraveling over. Record and analyze the effect of every single one.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3206 Complexity I
paragraphs: An enemy filled with power and waves of confidence appeared before him!
Someone that after wading through so many dredges of beings who didn't have a sufficiently complex system of Existence, he appeared like a shining beacon of light.
Zimo.
Just what were the intricacies behind his System of Existence?
He had stated that he was a Follower of the Tao of Ginnungagap- or something termed the Primordial Chaos!

"You space out at such a time, Osmont. A product of your upbringing and messy constitution of Existence. Let me give you an example of the purity of Existence in comparison to the messy products of Existence you and your people followed the path of."
HUUM!
His voice was light as around half of the Arena, dazzling white singularities had filled all space like drops of suspended rain.
At such a time, this being raised his sword above his head...and then swung down in a slow motion.

Yet with this single swing, all the formed white singularities in the surroundings disappeared and became absorbed into the sword, an inescapable sword light with unfathomable white brilliance instantly arriving before Noah!
Above him, his Innate Infinite Quintessential Bloodline Halo of Lumen spun with fluorescence.

His colorless wings were expanded wide and gushing waves of colorless brilliance- the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence flowing out endlessly as his hands rose to grasp the sword light thundering down!
BOOM!

A heavy impact unlike any other observed before in prior matches echoed out, Existence fracturing as if spider webs were expanding outwards, and the visage of Noah was pushed down from the skies until his feet hit the golden sands of the Arena- the white sword light still pressing down and seeking to cut its target!
In the distance, Zimo watched on calmly as he began to take steps forward, his voice echoing it.
"That is an authority of absolute purity. Those who can withstand it can be given praise, but you will find that unlike other authorities, you cannot profane this. You cannot devour it."

The Invictus Dominium Wings flared out with boundless dominance, the authority of the Laborer clashing with the opposing authority as Noah affirmed he could only oppose it and reach an endless tug of war after that.
It was formidable- and a good area to study and understand!
But here was where the most recent research of the Infinite Omniverse came in.
The Singularities of Unraveling.
Miniaturized versions of Fat Monkey that had a singular purpose of Unraveling Existence of its set target.
At this moment, Noah set the target to be this unfathomable white sword light- his hand releasing a Singularity of Unraveling as a spark of the Authority of the Laborer flowed into it.
WAA!
Brilliance erupted as it seemed like under the blazing pure white sword light, a flash of darkness had appeared.

And this flash of darkness was so heavy and undeniable that it began to scatter apart the white brilliance, the situation reversing so rapidly that the heavy strike that seemed like it would even cut the golden sands of the Arena soon was broken apart and broken down to particulates of white light!
It was too fast.
The figure of Zimo paused in the distance and became stern.

Surrounded by particles of white light that were blasted with the unraveling light of his Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction, Noah looked like a disruptor of Existence itself as he spoke towards Zimo calmly.
"Anything can be broken down. Even your purest light of authority."
WAA!
As he spoke to Zimo, his existence was picking up the unraveling shreds of white light as truly, he couldn't absorb or devour it.
But as the Weaver of Existence, he could still analyze it as he was coming to shocking conclusions!
|The so called authority of the Tao of Ginnungagap has the factor of Existential Undeniability due to mainly being outside the scope of Existence.|
|Under the guise of purity, it is an amalgamation of Existence and an Unidentified Complex Authority theorized to not belong to any possible viable Omniverse due to its differences.|
He found the Source of complexity.
What made the System of Existence this being was using sufficiently different from what he had come across so far!
|The Unidentified Complex Authority is placed under scrutiny while everything else is discarded.|
|More samples of this Unidentified Complex Authority are required before it can be replicated and understood.|
The path forward was clear.

As the heavy sword light glimmering with purity was dispersed and broken down, Noah rose from the sands of the golden arena as his palm faced the skies, a ball of colorless flames beginning to form on his palm as he smiled towards the stern beings in the distance!
"And when it comes to purity, I've come to find over the years that those who preach purity the most...actually turn out to be the dirtiest of creatures."
His words caused the eyes of Zimo to flash with a wild light of power as who could exceed the provocation capabilities of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor?!
As he spoke, bundles of colorless balls of fire formed all around him as at their center, a single Singularity of Unraveling lay.

Threads of the Authority of the Laborer surged all around them as they began to spin, the temperature of the surroundings rising to unprecedented levels as these fireballs shot out like a hail of bullets towards Zimo- the follower of the Tao of Ginnungagap!
"For hypocrites like you, I've found that burning by flames is a particularly good way to die."

Every word he uttered out was like a sharp needle on the visage of Zimo as his gaze turned utterly cold and apathetic, his sword turning its sharp point downwards as it sunk down and disappeared into nothingness.

An instantly later, streams of iridescent white brilliance that looked like celestial rivers of pure white light bloomed all around Zimo- these rivers smashing towards the speeding colorless fireballs as a heavy battle ensued!

Threads of the Authority of the Laborer surged all around them as they began to spin, the temperature of the surroundings rising to unprecedented levels as these fireballs shot out like a hail of bullets towards Zimo- the follower of the Tao of Ginnungagap!
"For hypocrites like you, I've found that burning by flames is a particularly good way to die."

Every word he uttered out was like a sharp needle on the visage of Zimo as his gaze turned utterly cold and apathetic, his sword turning its sharp point downwards as it sunk down and disappeared into nothingness.

An instantly later, streams of iridescent white brilliance that looked like celestial rivers of pure white light bloomed all around Zimo- these rivers smashing towards the speeding colorless fireballs as a heavy battle ensued!

chapters.title: Chapter 3207 Complexity II
paragraphs: Colorless balls of fire.
Pure white rivers of an amalgamation of an Existential Authority and an Unidentified Complex Authority!
The moment of impact...
PAH!
Was a stunning one as the moment the colorless fireballs smashed onto the seething white rivers of brilliance, these rivers were scattered as they were broken apart!

An unseen suction force then flickered from the tendrils of the Authority of the Laborer within the scattering fireballs as they devoured the scattered pieces of these white rivers, and this process repeated itself!
|The weavings of the Unidentified Complex Authority are being analyzed.|
|The Origin of the Unidentified Complex Authority is being analyzed.|
|The so called Tao of Ginnungagap is being analyzed.|
What exactly was it.
A Tao.
It could be looked at as the Way of something.
This Zimo had said it himself.
He was a Follower of the Tao of Ginnungagap.
Naturally, the next question was....who exactly or what exactly is this Ginnungagap? What he referred to as Primordial Chaos?
Any meaning derived from it was relating to something outside the scope of Existence! Something that would have been there even before the myriad of Omniverses were.
How grand were the implications of such a thing?
So Noah wanted to know.
Amidst the booming impacts of colorless fireballs and countless blooming rivers of pure white brilliance, he bellowed out.
|Show me!|
HUUM!
|Show me this so called purity!|
The formation of the colorless balls of flames around him turned up a whole octave.

They formed around Noah and shot out like mere glimmers of brilliance, their barrage dissipating and unraveling all pristine rivers of pure brilliance that were surging around like massive tentacles as in between all of this- all scattered authority was devoured!

The expression of Zimo became colder and colder as time passed, no longer handing out any words of wisdom as his white eyes radiated pure white light- the illusion of a massive sword forming above that would strike down towards his enemy.
But right at this moment.
SAA!
A colorless fireball flittered through the gaps of tendrils of massive White rivers and actually appeared before the visage of Zimo.
His hand naturally rose to intercept it as...
PAH!
The impact was a soft one.
A glow of white brilliance covered his palm, but it was dispersed and unraveled in an instant- threads of an authority Zimo in no way understood piercing his palm and spreading across his limb.
It should have simply been an injury.
His cold gaze was ready to treat it as such!
And yet in the next instant, his injured hand pulsed.
The amalgamation of the two authorities Noah had discovered being utilized by Zimo were naturally disrupted and unraveled, but this time...it was inside the body of Zimo!
And such a thing...carried drastic consequences that even Noah didn't know would unfold.
The moment the closely interlinked and fused authorities of this Entity were unraveled, it acted like an infection.
From pulsing hand, it spread to his shoulder and then onto his chest!
The gaze of Zimo rapidly lost its calmness as shock paved its way in, his whole Existence focusing on the unity of his two Authorities once more as at such a time.
PAH!
Another colorless fireball made its way through and smashed direction on the abdomen of Zimo.
The weavings of an Existential Authority and an Unidentified Complex Authority were irreversibly disrupted - this disruption now centered on Zimo's body as it spread everywhere.

His face became entirely ashen at such a development as he turned his gaze and looked across the Arena, locking onto the eyes of Noah who seemed to be looking at everything unfolding with great interest!
|You...motherfuc-|
BOOOM!
A shocking chain reaction unfolded.

The unraveling of the two authorities of Zimo caused a spark of rejection, the Unidentified Complex Authority taking over and erupting out with fervor as it actually sucked in all surrounding weavings of existence!
The extremely pure and white authority surrounding Zimo instantly became discolored and turned pure black.
The illusionary white sword from above instantly changed and expanded, changing into the form of a structure instead!
The body of Zimo folded inwards- everything about him being devoured as an instant later, deeply obsidian tentacles erupted where he used to be.
The rivers of pure white light in the surroundings became entirely black, with Existence being devoured all around as an utterly terrifying aura blared out!
Up above, the visage of Nuntius Eshkeri showed an expression of shock as before Noah's eyes, a preliminary analysis was done.
|The Unidentified Complex Authority has been discerned to be of entirely different Origins of Existence not stemming from the weavings of viable Omniverses.|
|The Unidentified Complex Authority has been granted the distinction of an Outerversal Authority.|
|Further analysis shows that this Outerversal Authority belongs to the Outerversal Morphon- Ginnungagap.|
|Above, the Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon- Ginnungagap, is being formed. Once complete, an Outerversal Entity will be capable of descending into the bounds of this Omniverse.|
HOONG!
A booming sound as if sounding a horn of the end echoed out.

Where the illusion of a white sword used to be, a massive obsidian shrine was being constructed as all surrounding Existence was devoured, thousands of slick, grotesque, and interminable tentacles swirling underneath it!
Where the figure of Zimo used to be, tens of thousands of obsidian tentacles squeezed out and spread all around.
Noah looked at all of this with immense fascination as from above, the visage of Nuntius Eshkeri bellowed out as his face became exceedingly cold.
|A Profanity of Existence! An Agent of Anti-Life!|
BOOM!
His simian figure instantly erupted with brilliance as he became adorned in majestic armaments that pulsed with grandeur.
The moment he voiced out, multiple other figures flashed and appeared in the skies as each of them pulsed with the Authority of an Apogee Autarch!
Their gazes were grim as they moved quickly, their faces filled with tremendous urgency.
And there was reason for urgency.
Because in the next moment, a pulse of obsidian brilliance flashed from the Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon- Ginnungagap!
It radiated waves of obsidian light all across the Arena, the golden sand below becoming tainted as this blast already towards the stands of the audience rapidly.
It already covered Noah's figure that was surrounded by tendrils of the Authority of the Laborer, everything occurring being analyzed as prompts cascaded out!
|The Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon has been utilized.|
|In the surrounding area affected by the Declaration, weavings of Existence are denied and rejected.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3208 Profane! I
paragraphs: A declaration was laid down as a shockingly powerful enemy suddenly appeared!
From the follower of the Tao of Ginnungagap that was wrapped in the weavings of purity, there was actually a hidden agent of what Nuntius Eshkeri referred to as an Agent of Anti-Life.
Everything about his existence was concealed and stable, and the only reason everything became unveiled was because of a single man's actions.
The unraveling of Existence allowed what was hidden behind to unfold, and the grandeur of the Outerversal Morphon- Ginnungagap, made its appearance.
In the blacked sands of the Arena.
Noah's figure was taking everything in as unbelievably, his Atlas of Existence remained bright.
The Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon stated that weavings of Existence in the surroundings were denied and rejected.
And yet, the Authority of the Laborer of Existence still swirled with brilliance as at this moment, Authority was not being drawn into the First Mundi of Power.
On his Atlas, a second circle had begun to buzz with profound radiance!
|The Second Mundi of Power is setting up the foundations of a complex System of Existence.|
|The Source of Existence of Outerversal Descent is being reconstructed within the Atlas of Existence|
The System of Existence from the entity known as Zimo was broken down to be that of Outerversal Descent.
Something far outside the scope of his Omniverse or other Omniverses had latched onto him, and his entire existence was made to follow this Source!
As Noah felt its weavings be constructed, his brilliant mind saw a single paramount issue.
|The System of Outerversal Descent requires for one to latch onto the influence of an Outerversal Morphon.|
Yes.
This System of Existence was sufficiently different and complex because it was something that had the equivalent of borrowing power from something far more grandiose.
Something far more powerful that didn't even stem from the Omniverse or any of the myriad of Omniverses- but something outside.
Outerversal.
If this was the case, then why would the Atlas of Existence still look at it as a viable Source of Existence to replicate?

Noah had no Outerversal Morphon he could draw Power from, and even if he had the chance to do so, he wouldn't draw Power from even the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap that had its shrine budding ahead of him.

This was because he could see the state of someone else who drew power from an Outerversal Entity and what had just occurred when their weavings of Existence were rejected to cause a disruption of their perfect equilibrium!
It was not a bond of equality.
It was more so of an enslavement.
And he did not wish to be enslaved under anyone for the sake of power!
The Atlas of Existence was a part of himself as it knew this, so...
|The System of Existence of Outerversal Descent requires the influence of an Outerversal Morphon to be viable in elevating your power.|

|The Owner of the Atlas of Existence will not be bound to another for the sake of power, so for the successful construction of the System of Existence of Outerversal Descent, part of yourself will have to be converged into an Outerversal Seed and sent along the observed pathways that the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap utilized to descend, but in reverse.|

|It is an action filled with uncertainties, and a large portion of your authority and likely the Authority of the Infinite Omniverse will be required to increase the chances of success. If successful, there will be a budding version of you as an Outerversal Morphon- this version of you acting as the Source for the System of Existence of Outerversal Descent. A successful result holds unknown results and an unfathomable potential for even more power. Shall we proceed?|
A prompt burning with crimson gold radiance.
A prompt asking for permission to do something that would require a great deal of investment, but the results could be something outside of Noah's wildest dreams!
So with Quintessence and brilliance overflowing in his eyes, he gave an affirmation.
|Proceed.|
BOOM!
Instantly, 80% of all his current reserves of the Authority of the Laborer were pulled upon.

Through his inseparable connection with the Infinite Omniverse, a heavy tug was felt as the Extremity Vein began to pulse and seethed with authority- a bean of cylindrical brilliance shooting out and disappearing towards the very peak of Aletheian Havens!
The Authority of a young budding Omniverse was utilized- all of it flowing towards Noah in a show of unfathomable might.

All the grandiose Aletheian Havens he had constructed and the brilliance of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities swirling within them pulsed, streams of authority flowing through them and directly into him.
All of it would only further increase the chances of success of an unfathomable action that went forward fully at this moment.
|The Observed Pathways utilized by the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap is being followed.|
|A collection of your existence filled to the brim with your own authority and the Authorities of the Infinite Omniverse had set off.|
At this moment.

Noah felt like more than half of himself separated from him, taking with it an unbelievable amount of authority as it disappeared into the fissures of nothingness that were spreading all around with the Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap!
And then...there was only silence.
A collection of his existence filled to the brim with boundless waves of authority.
An Outerversal Seed.
It was an outlandish idea that was only made possible by the Atlas of Existence and the assistance of the Infinite Omniverse.
The help of a young Omniverse. And the design of something entirely too fantastical for others to even dream of.
All of it culminated in a part of himself feeling cut off of all sensation as it traversed on a road it didn't know would lead anywhere.
A road that was only stipulated as the pathway that an Outerversal Morphon took to descend.
It was akin to seeing a paved road that right into the cover of trees, not knowing entirely where it led and how it curved for who knew how many miles.
It was akin to following such a path of uncertainty as if he veered off track...
BZZT!
A heavy impact smashed into him as he felt like he hit a patch, his Seed being redirected as 10% of the authority of the Infinite Omniverse protecting him was used up!
This journey...was not bound to be an easy one.

chapters.title: Chapter 3209 Profane! II
paragraphs: He followed a pathway that he didn't know the end of nor the true direction of.
Ever so often...
BZZT!
As if he came upon a fork in the road, he grazed something that rapidly ate up the Authority protecting him before he veered forward in another direction.
Every time something like this occurred, the heavy waves of authority protecting him were reduced greatly!
If he didn't arrive where he should arrive before the Authorities protecting him were used up...this whole venture would be deemed a failure.
And the other part of himself may not even know it.
In the Gladiators' Arena that was currently tainted with an obsidian hue.

At the center of the grandiose Nine Thrones, the visage of the Viceroy rose up with a stern expression as in front of him, a thin of golden light prevented the expansion of the Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap from ever getting close to them.
"For a vile creature to actually appear when one of my bodies is nearby..."
His figure began to vibrate with a heavy authority.
And yet before it could be expressed...
"Sit down."
WAA!
The man with levels of power far exceeding everyone else seated beside the Viceroy uttered out calmly.
The Sword of the Commonwealth actually spoke in such a way to the Viceroy of the Commonwealth!

Viceroy Gilgamesh did not look towards this being as he kept his eyes locked onto the rapidly spreading tentacles and Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap that was becoming ever so real, his voice veiling its anger as it spoke out calmly.
"What lies before us is an enemy of the Commonwealth. Is it not my job to protect the Commonwealth?"
One of the foremost enemies of the Commonwealth was right before them.
Did they not need to eradicate it right away?!

"Your job is to do what you are told. And for now, you will wait. Let them taste the despair and hopelessness. Let them know the enemy they face and how outclassed they are against it. Let them seek for someone to save them as when you appear, it has to be at their lowest moments. This is how you gain loyalty."
The voice of the Sword of the Commonwealth was filled with undeniable control and majesty as even the one taking the seat of the Viceroy could not deny it!
Beside him, the Mother of the Viceroy sat with sharp eyes- the rest of the Entities within the Omniversal Stage of power doing the same thing.
They watched as down below, a hellish landscape was unfolding as an unnatural enemy made itself ever present.

Everything was tainted with a revolting obsidian light as on the millions of thrones where Citizens of the Commonwealth stood, they felt their very Existence shutting down as they couldn't muster an ounce of their Authority.
They could only stare in shock and horror as from the center of the Arena, countless tentacles stretched out and enlarged as if a terrifying creature that would devour everything was coming out!
And they knew in the depths of their heart that the moment these tentacles reached them, they would be devoured entirely.

The only solace they had was that above the murky sands of the Arena, Protectors had appeared as their bodies glowed with a golden brilliance- their Existence actually still capable of burning brightly amidst a Declaration that denied Existence itself!
But even they didn't seem like they had what it took to stop what was coming entirely.

And amidst all of this panic, one man remained immensely close to the unfolding tendrils of unfolding darkness, his Wings stretched out as they flapped- his figure moving across the space where Existence itself was being devoured as he evaded the erupting tentacles of grotesque brilliance.
His eyes were closed as he let the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence protect him.

Only half of what he used to remain here as the Second Mundi of Power was pulsing rapidly at this moment, gathering all threads of the System of Existence of Outerversal Descent to ensure stability when something utterly profound succeeded!
When.
Not if.
For he could not fail in this endeavor- the cost would be too great!
But in the midst of all of this.
What he was seeing and sensing at this moment...he sent it across his Lineage- towards those most powerful.
|These are the enemies and entities we are coming across in this expanding playing field.|

Along with his words, images, and scenes showing the Worms of Existence, Protectors of the Commonwealth, and even the scene of the monstrosity currently playing out at this very moment were all expressed across his Lineage.

|There are those on the side of Existence, those on the side of Anti-Existence, and those on the side of Anti-Life. There are enemies as weak as they can be, to those exceeding the stages of the Existential Dominium Realm and stepping into the Omniversal Realm. All of these things...we are only just beginning to observe them. Be ready. And be prepared for what is to come!|
WAA!
His son heard his words as his eyes shone with sharpness.
Sona heard them.
The Sanctus Autarch heard them!

Many of his people were given information about just what was occurring around them and what was coming in the future, as they seemed to be touching upon a level of power where they had to move with extreme care.
They weren't the only ones
The Infinite Omniverse was receiving feedback and analyzing everything Noah was experiencing- even more closely than anyone else.
The Infinite Omniverse.
Its capabilities and potential were only just beginning to unfold.
Its distinction was that of a Young Omniverse.
What did it mean for an Omniverse to be sentient? For an Omniverse to be capable of moving freely with direction and purpose?

What it could do... it felt like it was only touching the tip of a very long iceberg as what it had done with Noah just now- the amount of authority it had access to and utilized to send part of himself to a place they knew nothing about...this was it beginning to explore the daring things it could now do.
The Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction was another part, the Signature of Existence it was sending out was another...and there should be much more!
Slowly, its true utilities would be unveiled.
But the most critical thing at this moment was to wait and see.
Wait for the result of their actions and see if the Second Mundi of Power would be successful in gaining a brand new System of Existence!

Ever so often...
BZZT!
As if he came upon a fork in the road, he grazed something that rapidly ate up the Authority protecting him before he veered forward in another direction.
Every time something like this occurred, the heavy waves of authority protecting him were reduced greatly!
If he didn't arrive where he should arrive before the Authorities protecting him were used up...this whole venture would be deemed a failure.
And the other part of himself may not even know it.
In the Gladiators' Arena that was currently tainted with an obsidian hue.

At the center of the grandiose Nine Thrones, the visage of the Viceroy rose up with a stern expression as in front of him, a thin of golden light prevented the expansion of the Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap from ever getting close to them.
"For a vile creature to actually appear when one of my bodies is nearby..."
His figure began to vibrate with a heavy authority.
And yet before it could be expressed...
"Sit down."
WAA!
The man with levels of power far exceeding everyone else seated beside the Viceroy uttered out calmly.
The Sword of the Commonwealth actually spoke in such a way to the Viceroy of the Commonwealth!

Viceroy Gilgamesh did not look towards this being as he kept his eyes locked onto the rapidly spreading tentacles and Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap that was becoming ever so real, his voice veiling its anger as it spoke out calmly.
"What lies before us is an enemy of the Commonwealth.
Is it not my job to protect the Commonwealth?"
One of the foremost enemies of the Commonwealth was right before them.
Did they not need to eradicate it right away?!
"Your job is to do what you are told.
And for now, you will wait.
Let them taste the despair and hopelessness.
Let them know the enemy they face and how outclassed they are against it.
Let them seek for someone to save them as when you appear, it has to be at their lowest moments.
This is how you gain loyalty."
The voice of the Sword of the Commonwealth was filled with undeniable control and majesty as even the one taking the seat of the Viceroy could not deny it!
Beside him, the Mother of the Viceroy sat with sharp eyes- the rest of the Entities within the Omniversal Stage of power doing the same thing.
They watched as down below, a hellish landscape was unfolding as an unnatural enemy made itself ever present.

Everything was tainted with a revolting obsidian light as on the millions of thrones where Citizens of the Commonwealth stood, they felt their very Existence shutting down as they couldn't muster an ounce of their Authority.
They could only stare in shock and horror as from the center of the Arena, countless tentacles stretched out and enlarged as if a terrifying creature that would devour everything was coming out!
And they knew in the depths of their heart that the moment these tentacles reached them, they would be devoured entirely.

The only solace they had was that above the murky sands of the Arena, Protectors had appeared as their bodies glowed with a golden brilliance- their Existence actually still capable of burning brightly amidst a Declaration that denied Existence itself!
But even they didn't seem like they had what it took to stop what was coming entirely.

And amidst all of this panic, one man remained immensely close to the unfolding tendrils of unfolding darkness, his Wings stretched out as they flapped- his figure moving across the space where Existence itself was being devoured as he evaded the erupting tentacles of grotesque brilliance.
His eyes were closed as he let the Authority of the Laborer of the Atlas of Existence protect him.

Only half of what he used to remain here as the Second Mundi of Power was pulsing rapidly at this moment, gathering all threads of the System of Existence of Outerversal Descent to ensure stability when something utterly profound succeeded!
When.
Not if.
For he could not fail in this endeavor- the cost would be too great!
But in the midst of all of this.
What he was seeing and sensing at this moment...he sent it across his Lineage- towards those most powerful.
|These are the enemies and entities we are coming across in this expanding playing field.|

Along with his words, images, and scenes showing the Worms of Existence, Protectors of the Commonwealth, and even the scene of the monstrosity currently playing out at this very moment were all expressed across his Lineage.
|There are those on the side of Existence, those on the side of Anti-Existence, and those on the side of Anti-Life.
There are enemies as weak as they can be, to those exceeding the stages of the Existential Dominium Realm and stepping into the Omniversal Realm.
All of these things...we are only just beginning to observe them.
Be ready.
And be prepared for what is to come!|
WAA!
His son heard his words as his eyes shone with sharpness.
Sona heard them.
The Sanctus Autarch heard them!

Many of his people were given information about just what was occurring around them and what was coming in the future, as they seemed to be touching upon a level of power where they had to move with extreme care.
They weren't the only ones
The Infinite Omniverse was receiving feedback and analyzing everything Noah was experiencing- even more closely than anyone else.
The Infinite Omniverse.
Its capabilities and potential were only just beginning to unfold.
Its distinction was that of a Young Omniverse.
What did it mean for an Omniverse to be sentient?
For an Omniverse to be capable of moving freely with direction and purpose?

What it could do... it felt like it was only touching the tip of a very long iceberg as what it had done with Noah just now- the amount of authority it had access to and utilized to send part of himself to a place they knew nothing about...this was it beginning to explore the daring things it could now do.
The Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction was another part, the Signature of Existence it was sending out was another...and there should be much more!
Slowly, its true utilities would be unveiled.
But the most critical thing at this moment was to wait and see.
Wait for the result of their actions and see if the Second Mundi of Power would be successful in gaining a brand new System of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3210 A Moment in Time
paragraphs: Inside of the Infinite Omniverse.
Within the Aletheian Haven of Dreams.
Out of the many Aletheian Havens out there, it was Dreams and Helios that Noah and his people found themselves frequenting the most.
Dreams held a certain sense of awe as with a little input of their own imagination, the surroundings would take on this shape and continue to change how they wished.

At this moment, in a small portion of the Aletheian Haven, Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Dreams was sitting on the edge of a golden waterfall, the waters passing by below his feet and thundering down below.
When one looked at them, one would notice the concentration of the water within the river extending from the waterfall rapidly increasing while the river itself continued to enlarge and expand.
And if one looked closer to the surroundings, everything else was also expanding as the process of Existential Terraforming continued unabated!
"It's truly marvelous..."
Beside Noah on the golden waterfall.
The figure of the golden haired Dr. Hall could be seen, his white coat adorned on his body as he observed this process along with Noah.

In the Infinite Omniverse, there were very few who could genuinely say they were a friend to the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor who lorded over these vast lands, but there were still some who managed to be themselves around him and form a stable friendship even with the complex relationship that made him seem grander than life.
For Dr. Hall, his love for understanding the profundities of Existence and all the wonders out there made it so that he would frequently come and talk with Noah.

Over the days in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain and even more days in the Var El Eonic Omniverse Record, Dr. Hall only found himself more and more around Noah as more wonders unfolded all around them.
Wonders of possibilities. This was how their interests aligned!
Dr. Hall looked above them to an incandescent gold sky as he continued.

"I sensed the concentrations of all viable forms of energy dip in this place and in all the places my other Clones are into inside the Infinite Omniverse...what is doing now that requires so much energy? Can I assume it is half of all the Authority that was collected within the Infinite Omniverse?"
He asked because he was curious.
And Noah smiled and nodded in a reply.

"Over half of all the authority of the Infinite Omniverse. But it was all for my purposes. The images I just showed you all across the Lineage- this one deals closer to the new enemies we've just come across. The Outerversal Morphons. I'm trying to go to the same place they are in, to do something they're currently doing."
The words caused Dr. Hall's eyes to widen with golden light, his glasses pushed up as countless thoughts buzzed inside of him.

Among the many people inside the Infinite Omniverse, he was spreading his reach out far and wide in regards to health and wellness, with many of his Practices and Business stretched across the different Aletheian Havens.
Anything new, he loved to understand and see if he could use.
But this concept of Outerversal Morphons...just seemed too grand.
"What will that make you as an individual? If you succeed, would you still be considered a native of this Omniverse, or an Outerversal Entity outside of it? Which distinction trumps the other?"
What exactly would Noah be?
At such a question, even he smiled as he didn't know!
Far from the positions of Noah and Dr. Hall.
Inside the Aletheian Haven of Helios.
The figure of Sona sat on a sandy gold beach, her body adorned in a yellow gold swimsuit that showed much of her radiant skin and icy green gold hair that drifted below her shoulders.

She sat on the beach and stared out into a golden sea burning with flames of helios, and yet they held a rejuvenating effect for anyone swimming within it as the figures of Emilliana and other Sanctus Princesses were freely swimming inside of it currently- taking what seemed to be a long overdue vacation after fighting wars for so long.
On Sona's head, Bubbles was bouncing happily in his blue slime form, while Little Caculatan shone with an obsidian gold radiance as its round furry body rested on Sona's lap.
Her eyes gazed ahead as she seemed to be thinking of far too many things.
"You haven't gotten used to it? Sitting back and letting Noah do everything?"
From behind, the blessed figure of Barbatos came by- her small but curvaceous visage adorned in a black two piece.
Her beauty only seemed to be getting more refined as she held in her hands two skewers of Dragon Meat grilled in the fires of Helios!

Behind them on this beach, the figure of Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Helios could be seen standing before burning flames of helios that roasted meat, his Son beside him learning the Extremity of cooking.
To their left and right, numerous figures could be seen as Erikson's bronze body was sunbathing in his proper beach attire, and Ayame and Lilith were seated nearby talking.

Even closer to Noah, the figures of Adelaide, Katelyn, Eowyn, and all the other Queens of the Infinite Omniverse could be seen seated on golden beach chairs surrounding an extended vertical table that held an overabundance of Quintessential Fruits of Existence and grilled meat from the most exotic fantastical animals.
At the head of the table, they all surrounded and happily talked to the figure of Amelia Osmost- their Mother-in-law!
Apart from them, the figures of Kazuhiko, Emperor Penguin, and many others could be seen doing their own things across this golden beach.
All of this was happening in the background and more as Barbatos came to sit beside Sona and offered her one of the skewers in her hands.
Towards her question, Sona could only shake her head while accepting the skewer and taking a bite.
"It's not even that. I had these grand plans of an Initiative, and even when I think about it now, that doesn't seem to be it. It's just..."
A sense of frustration was on her face as she didn't seem to be able to put into words what she was feeling.
Barbatos smiled towards her as she spoke like she understood.

"Do you feel a sense of disconnect? Like you shouldn't be here doing this? Relaxing while it feels like out there, the whole world- well I guess Omniverse now; while it feels like the whole Omniverse is burning?"
The words from Barbatos caused Sona to go entirely silent as the Necromancer of Existence smiled with gorgeous brilliance.

"What I've come to learn over the months and years is that there is never a time when the outside Worlds, Cosmos, Existential Domains, or Omniverses aren't burning. But that can't stop us from enjoying the simple joys of life. Should we be serious and worried all the time? Ponder in silence for whatever is to come? I would tell you to put your trust in Noah and just be there for him when he needs you. Until then, enjoy yourself. The Fruits of his labor inside this endless Infinite Omniverse. And of course, don't forget the Dual Cultivation sessions..."
She laughed while stating her last sentence, her figure rising as she patted Bubbles above Sona's head- turning back to where the party was brightest as she left behind words of advice.
No sooner had she left did another figure appear beside Sona, this being none other than the Sanctus Autarch.
She was on the more moderate side as she had not gotten used to things fully just yet, and she was adorned in a light green robe while on the beach as she looked somewhat out of place.
But when she looked at the Queen Mothers nearby and the Sanctus Princesses and Dragon Knights in the water, she felt a sense of security she hadn't felt in a long time as she came to sit beside Sona.
She didn't have to say anything.
One old.
One young.
Two women sat on the beach inside a grandiose Aletheian Haven of Helios, their emotions similar as all around them, Entities from different walks of life took a moment to just breathe and relax.
In difficult times, moments like these were rare to come, but were often times the most important.
