chapters.title: Chapter 3211 Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias! I
paragraphs: On the same golden beach within a corner of the Aletheian Haven of Helios.
Standing In front of the Grill of Helios that lashed out tongues of golden flames, Noah was putting the Extremity of Cooking to full use as he waited for the results of a heavy investment.

Until now, all feeling and sensation had been cut off from the other part of him traversing across an Unknown path that the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap had taken, so he didn't know whether it was still on its way, or already entirely destroyed!
But he didn't place too much emphasis on it as he continued to take care of things he could control.
Being present with this Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Helios with his family in the midst of all of this was something he could do.
To his right, his son could be seen with blue swimming trunks, his built figure showing the toned muscles that all the men had on this golden beach.

In his hands, two chalices containing the squired juices of Quintessential Fruits of Existence could be seen- two golden plates in front of him as he came to grab finished pieces of the dragon cutlets his father was grilling!
"Rare, medium, or well done?"
His father asked him with a nudge as Henry smiled while bringing the floating plates forward.
"Rare for me, well done for her. If she sees any red on the meat, it'll stay on the plate. And she's too shy to ever send anything back to you."

As Henry spoke, he was looking towards an area of the beach where a young woman could be seen sitting on a blue beach chair- her figure adorned in a white sundress as her blue hair calmly waved in the wind.
A young woman from Atlantis.

Last time, Noah had told Henry to be honest regarding who he was as this young woman he had a relationship with didn't know about his illustrious identity as the Son of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor!

He had taken the next step and revealed all of this as it would have overwhelmed any common woman, but this young woman with a royal mermaid Lineage from Atlantis held a stronger soul than most as she was slowly introduced to the family.
Noah smiled as he placed pieces of meat radiating golden oils on the plate they were put on, potent life force brimming within them as he filled the plate of well done dragon cutlets a bit more.
"We'll have a more private affair soon. A small banquet. Bring her and introduce her to everyone officially there."
He spoke calm words to his son- a Foundation Autarch, and this being actually nodded with nervousness as he walked towards a Young woman on the beach with vibrant plates in tow!
It was a simple glimpse into the slightly normal side of Entities with power that could distort destinies and Existence itself.
Noah reflected on this scene and the many still playing out across this golden beach of helios as this was it.
Part of the happiness that he was protecting.
This was why in the face of any larger than life enemies or mysteries.
In the face of the Commonwealth, Concepts of Anti-Life and Anti-Existence, and now even the concept of Outerversal Morphons. He didn't falter in the face of any of this as he kept on moving forward.
Until the day came when he had seen all the wonders and scales of power.
Until the day came when he could sit back and not have to worry about an Apocalypse, or a being stronger than him by many levels appearing and dictating how his life would be from there onward.
If and when such a time ever came, he would sit back and enjoy retirement as a farmer.

But until then...the brilliance and Fable of the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor would continue to spread out far and wide, his tendrils of influence seeking to now stretch across Omniverses as he prepared for the integration and slow dissemination of the Commonwealth!
The Commonwealth that was on full display of its attitude and standards at this moment as in the Wheel of Weavings.

In the Gladiators' Arena, where a Shrine of an Outerversal Morphon was becoming ever so real, its Declaration caused a sense of powerlessness on all weavings of Existence as obsidian tendrils erupted out to devour anything they came across!
It was an unexpected situation, yes, but there were many powerful entities of the Commonwealth here.
Noah remembered the Nine Thrones holding entities who very likely exceeded the Existential Dominium Realm and were within the bounds of the Omniversal Realm!
Yet they did not make a move.
Was it to inspire a sense of fear? Show others how hopeless they were against these powerful enemies?
SAA!

Noah cut through breaking weavings of Existence as he dodged thousands of sleek obsidian tentacles that only increased in number, his gaze going towards the distant seats of the audience as there, tentacles were about to reach as those who couldn't even muster up a semblance of their Authority would perish en masse!
Would the Commonwealth truly go as far as allowing for deaths of their Citizens before stepping in?
Just as this thought flowed from Noah.
HUUM!
A brilliant golden light shone from above and began to constrict the undeniable obsidian Declaration that was spreading out.
When Noah saw this golden light, his eyes couldn't help but constricted as it wasn't like any familiar light of authority he had come across!
It was encompassing. It was solid and without any gaps. What is sought to accomplish would be achieved with surety.
It was...Omniversal.
It pressed down from all directions as the expanding Declaration of an Outerversal Morphon actually began to shrink!
Not an Outerversal Morphon- but the infinitesimally small glimpse of the power of an Outerversal Morphon that had begun to seep out of the shell that used to be Zimo.

But at the center of the golden light pressing down on the Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap, the image of a grandiose Simian showed itself with unfathomable glory- his visage amplified and expressed to all!
Almost as if it was a show.

Not an Outerversal Morphon- but the infinitesimally small glimpse of the power of an Outerversal Morphon that had begun to seep out of the shell that used to be Zimo.

But at the center of the golden light pressing down on the Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap, the image of a grandiose Simian showed itself with unfathomable glory- his visage amplified and expressed to all!
Almost as if it was a show.

chapters.title: Chapter 3212 Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias! II
paragraphs: A show.

This was how Noah could best describe it as a titanic illusory image of none other than the Viceroy of the Commonwealth was displayed far above, his hand pressing down radiating the golden light that was stopping the advancement of the Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap!
Golden brilliance enveloped everything around the Gladiators' Arena as the obsidian domain became constricted and smaller.

It was being pushed back towards the center of the Arena where the Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon was enlarging with grandiosity, the thrones of the audiences finally being taken out of what seemed an endless age of darkness where they were all about to be massacred in.
The Citizens of the Commonwealth that visited Omniverse X-999 raised their hands up to the visage of brilliance that saved them.
Towards their Viceroy!

Feats of his brilliance here would undoubtedly be spread to the other Omniverses that the Commonwealth oversaw- his brilliance that was going against the influence of an Outerversal Entity personally!
|Profane!|
His appearance bellowed out towards the obsidian Declaration as it wriggled as if it were an animal.
The seething golden brilliance converged together above as it shockingly took on the form...of a Wheel.

A golden wheel of interminable brilliance as it looked like a collection of many small circles contained in one massive circle - their center point showing another illusory image of the Viceroy seated in a meditative position as, at this moment, this wheel began to slowly spin.
HUUM!
A slow spin.
Yet the moment this spinning of the Wheel began, an unimaginably heavy pressure thundered down that reduced the size of the Declaration of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap by half.
At the center of the Arena, the rising Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap that was gradually becoming more real cracked and became more illusory.
And the Wheel continued to spin.
As if it were grinding down something.
As if with every turn the wheel made, an inviolable weaving of power came down.
When it completed a full turn...
CRACK!
The illusory Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap was cracked as the Declaration that had turned the golden sands dark was fully constricted mere miles around the Shrine!
The tentacles that were spreading out with shocking fervor and devouring everything screeched as if they had met their natural enemy before they began to shrivel and fade away into nothingness.
The singularity that was spitting out the emergence of the weavings of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap shrieked upwards towards the Wheel.
From it, a massive obsidian pupil opened along with an overlap of thousands of massive tentacles!
The pupil seemed to be etching its gaze with the entity stopping its entry, locking its gaze above as the apathetic expression of Viceroy Gilgamesh looked down.
And under him, the golden Wheel turned once more.

As it was about to complete the turn, it seemed to be meeting resistance- but this small point of resistance faded away the moment that Viceroy Gilgamesh pressed his foot down, the rings within his wheels pulsing at the turn was completed!
RIIP!
The sound of something being ripped apart echoed out as gloriously, the Shrine of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap was ripped apart as it folded into itself.
As if everything about it was being compressed and erased!
The myriad of obsidian tentacles that were spreading out were compressed into a fading singularity as in an instant...
All Sources even emanating traces of the Authority of the Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap was eradicated.
Above, the image of the Viceroy was the only thing that remained.
Unfettered.
Brilliant.
Omniversal!

The golden Wheel he had called out only turned twice before the enemy was eradicated, the Royal Existential Omniversal Simians in the thrones of the audience instantly dropping to their knees while they raised their hands towards their Viceroy!
They raised their hands to him as they wanted to express their fervor. Their loyalty. Their awe and respect to the Viceroy of the Commonwealth.

Down below on the golden sands, Noah gazed up at the massive intricate golden Wheel that Viceroy Gilgamesh recovered with a wave of his hand, his gaze looking imperious as he looked over the masses, his voice echoing out.
"This is who we are fighting against."
WAA!

"We do what we do day in and day out to ensure that Existence is protected. That life is protected. The glory of the Commonwealth will continue to spread to all corners of known and unknown Omniverses as we ensure that none will fall to our enemies!"
A heartfelt speech!
One that the citizens of the Commonwealth heard and resonated with their hearts, their hands lifted up as they bellowed out in affirmation!
"OOOH!"
"Glory to the Commonwealth!"
"Long live the Commonwealth!"
"Long live the Viceroy!"
"Long live!"
An abundance of shouts of valor and honor.
Noah observed it all on the sands of the Arena as the visage of Nuntius Eshkeri floated down to stand before him.
Other Protectors floated in the space above as they looked respectfully towards the figure of the Viceroy, and only when he began to disappear did they begin to move.
Nuntius Eshkeri's expression was solemn as he spoke while walking toward Noah, his brilliant monkey tail behind him pulsing with golden arcs of light.

|Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont, you were able to unveil an Agent of Anti-Life today and prevent them from entering deeper ranks of the Commonwealth- this already distinguishes you as someone who does the job of a Protector. Thus, it is deemed for your status to be elevated to become a true Protector of the Commonwealth!|
There was supposed to be an evaluation of the Gladiators as they battled each other in the Arena for a chance to become Protectors of the Commonwealth.
Something that came to be because a Protector was greatly hurt in an Eonic Omniverse Record!
And now, another incident occurred where someone who was part of the Commonwealth actually turned out to be an Agent of Anti-Life, and Noah incidentally revealed this.
And as a result...the position of a Protector was now being offered to him.
Cause and effect.
Noah looked at the visage of Nuntius Eshkeri looking at him with stern brilliance as his eyes curved into a devilish smile!

chapters.title: Chapter 3213 Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias! III
paragraphs: The Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Nuntius Eshkeri gazed towards Noah with a stern gaze, his body still simmering with golden brilliance.
Opposite him, Noah gave a light nod while retreating all waves of authority unto himself.
"If it is deemed so, then I will take on the role of a Protector of the Commonwealth."

His voice held no grandiose authority as he replied, but Nuntius Eshkeri nodded with solemnness as he came beside him and raised his hand while amplifying his voice towards the rousing Arena that still had their hands raised in the air.

|From the ranks of this recently discovered Omniverse, the first entity who shall join the ranks of new Protectors after this grand Celebration of Omniversal Discovery is none other than Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont!|
WAA!
A moment to show utter awe and wonder.

|As the one to unveil an Agent of Anti-Life among us, his actions are those of a role model to follow as from this day forth, from the ashes of Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont...comes the rise of Protector Osmont! A brethren of the Royal Existential Omniversal Simians, a Defender of the Commonwealth!|
A Protector of the Commonwealth.

A grandiose title as with the simple motion of raising Noah's hand in the air, Nuntius Eshkeri actually dared to discern Noah's body as a form of assurance that he didn't have any threads of Anti-Life within him!
Noah felt the intrusive authority of this Apogee Autarch as of course, it wasn't able to discover anything about the Atlas of Existence nor the Authority of the Laborer, and instead...
|A new authority stemming from a uniquely different Source of Existence has sought to analyze your weavings.|
He instead gained a glimpse of another wonder as he looked towards Nuntius Eshkeri and smiled.
He was having a hard time finding a sufficiently different System of Existence these past days, and yet in the span of minutes, he came across two.
This Apogee Autarch saw Noah's gaze but didn't care, his intent coming out only for Noah to hear at this moment.
|That was a preliminary test to ensure that your Existence is pure. I will transport you to an area where you will be received and proceed as a Protector. From here onward...we will be colleagues.|
HUUM!
A burst of golden brilliance came with his words and wrapped around Noah's body, his voice now echoing out to everyone as the newly ordained Protector disappeared.

|As the fruits of the Commonwealth, we will not fear and let this incident interrupt our rituals- so how about we continue to showcase the strength of the Commonwealth with more battles on this Arena?!|
OOOH!
The crowd cheered for more blood as the threat to their lives that had just been taken care of had all but been forgotten.
Below the Arena, the throne where Prime Citizen Emperor Osmont used to be was all but empty.
In the distance, seated on his throne, The Imperium Autarch and the Eonic Uterra locked gazes with each other as out of the three of them- one had managed to make the jump and become a Protector!
Who else would follow?
Across weavings of things not capable of being fully understood at this moment.
Part of Noah's Existence was traversing across an Unknown road that he didn't know the end of nor the direction through it.
No vision.
No feeling.
Nothing.
He would occasionally smash into an obstruction before he was steered forward as the Authority protecting him lessened more and more.
The Authority of a young Omniverse that had been expanding itself constantly with the process of Existential Terraforming!
BZZT!
His body felt like it grazed past a high frequency oscillation of something that ripped apart Existence itself as another portion of authority was shaved away.
Within him, his Authorities were burning with everything they had.
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist steers any possible weavings to ensure your survival and success as befitting a Protagonist.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence states there can only be a single Quintessential result!|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy feels like the path being traveled is one that leads to the most basal and earliest form of chaos.|
|Entropy seeks the freedom of utmost chaos. No direction. No expectation. No reaction. Let the path being formed be the one of true and unfettered entropy.|
Freedom of chaos.
The moment this prompt came, Noah felt an inkling of a sensation that this might be the answer!
He felt his existence visibly relax.
And he went with the flow.

No sooner did he do so, his existence once more smashed into an interference that felt like a wall on the road he was on, and as per precious times, he would direct himself away from this interference to return to the road itself.
But this time, he didn't take any action.
He just went with the flow.
BZZT!
The Authority of the Infinite Omniverse protecting him rapidly decreased as it went towards critical levels!
But she still did nothing.
BOOM!
And so, the interference smashed into him fully without any sense of protection as everything about him disappeared!
He was bounced around.

He still couldn't feel or sense anything as the interference he ran into exponentially increased, the Authority protecting him falling into dangerous levels as very soon, his Outerversal Seed that had yet to sprout would be unveiled and decimated!
And yet...he still did nothing.
|Entropy burns with exhilaration.|
A flash of a prompt.
And thereafter...
PAH!
The last defenses of Noah's Existence were shredded apart by an interference as it seemed like the only path thereafter was erasure.
From all around, a prickling sensation surrounded him as they would decimate him right away!
And he still did nothing.
And so, the interference smashed into him fully without any sense of protection as everything about him disappeared!
Failure.
Or so it should be as every part of Noah seemingly flashed out of Existence instantly, his consciousness fading entirely.
And yet another instant later...
SHAA!
As if his consciousness was waking up from a long slumber.
It could have truly been an instant, or it could have been millions of years.
He couldn't say for sure.
The only thing he could say with surety...was the sensation he currently felt.
The most apt description he had for it...was like he was being born!

chapters.title: Chapter 3214 Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias! IV
paragraphs: He was being born!
He was being born...but who was he exactly?
This question came quickly and rapidly, but it didn't have a full answer as a sense of Distortion and cloudiness permeated all around.
Within the depths of his beings, he could feel small voices trying to rise up.
Each one tried to overcome another in an effort to reach him, but they were too faint.
Their reach in this place was so, so small.
But these tiny voices didn't give up as they acted like jolts of electricity that were constantly trying to unearth something.
First was the question of what.
He seemed to make out himself as if he was a budding singularity. A mass of extremely dense energies constantly twisting, contracting and expanding.
A mass full of power that he couldn't yet understand!
But this mass was coming to fruition...where exactly? When?
He thought of looking at his surroundings, but realized there was only darkness.
The absolute lack of light.
Apart from himself, he couldn't see anything.
More and more of himself was budding and becoming more concentrated, the power contained within himself feeling tremendously full and significant as it told him he could do anything!
So he wanted to answer the first question he had.
Who he was.
The small voices he could barely hear within him rose in a cacophony of noises.
He was...
He was...!
Osm...!
Ozm...!
HUUM!
His existence fully formed. Interminable waves of crimson obsidian radiance flashed out.
His identity unveiled itself!
He was...
"Ozymandias!"
"I am...the Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias!"
A deep and guttural voice that seemed like it was echoing out of the very depths of countless endings.
It was a voice that seemed to know innately that it was an Outerversal Morphon- that this was its first identity!
The name that came after that seemed to be from a long distant memory as the voice that uttered it out held a hint of melancholy.
One filled with resonance and Distinctions of unfathomable origins, one that seemed to be trying to remember.
What exactly was he trying to remember?
In the midst of this question, another voice shockingly echoed out as it was filled with depth and ancientness.
"What you are is loud, Young One."
Another voice.
Was he not alone?
He tried to look around, but he could see nothing apart from the lack of light around him.
"You cannot even see, and yet are raucous enough to have already developed an ego? Take things a step at a time, Young One."
The ancient voice came out again.
This time, it felt kinder and filled with understanding as Ozymandias asked cautiously.
"How...do I see?"
Something that was simplicity itself, and yet seemingly impossible at the same time.
"To see in this place, you must properly outline your form. Your Outerverse. Only when you have substance can you begin to see."
Ozymandias heard these words as he looked within the depths of himself and pondered, the small voices that had been trying to rise up making a cacophony of noises at this moment as he repeated.
Form.
Substance.
Ozymandias heard these words as he looked within the depths of himself and pondered, the small voices that had been trying to rise up making a cacophony of noises at this moment as he repeated.
"A form..."
HUUM!
A blast of a unique authority erupted with him at the center.
He knew this authority.
He was born with it.
It was a type of Innate, undeveloped, and young authority. It was his Outerversal Morphon Authority!
It erupted out as it released humming droning sounds, wrapping around his body as it began to form into something else.
And the form that was coming to fruition...he could see it.
A base trunk formed first as it seemed to be made from trillions of tentacles stacked on top of each other.
These tentacles glimmered with a stellar purple blue hue- each one made from millions of budding singularities as it looked entirely otherworldly.
Moments later, four limbs exploded out, the amalgamation of tentacles forming what Ozymandias knew to be hands and feet.
Then, another trillion tentacles erupted from behind as they were covered by a crimson obsidian light, these tentacles forming into wings of utter horror as at their center- a pupil opened for each!
An eye on the center of each wing.
The eyes held rings of nine pupils uniquely connected to each other as they gave off heart throbbing unease and power.
They blinked.
BZZT!
And trillions more tentacles bloomed behind that formed into Halos!
Rings of tentacles came together, burning with crimson obsidian stellar radiance as they formed into nine Halos that successively became larger the further away they were from him.
A stellar purple blue body, crimson obsidian wings, nine halos of crimson obsidian radiance, and his head...only had two glowing singularities on his face.
Nothing else.
These singularities blinked as within them, threads of countless tentacles throbbed. Countless tendrils of weavings.
But when they all came together and he could see his exemplary form...
He also became capable of seeing around him.
An expanse of shimmering obsidian darkness stretching out endlessly.
And in the middle of all of this...
"Can you see now, Young One?"
The deep and ancient voice that had been talking with him this whole time.
He saw it.
He saw him.
Someone. Something that was horrifically millions of times larger than he was.
In front of it, he seemed like a mere speck of dust.
It was round, carrying the features of an eye, with trillions of titanic tentacles wriggling in all directions on the rims of this eye.
It pulsed with deep stellar purple radiance as its pupil was a massive triangular collection of brilliant purple light with a circular singularity at its center!
The massive pupil seemed to smile as it looked at Ozymandias.
"Are you out of words now, Young One?"
Ozymandias looked at this massive entity in awe as his own deep voice echoed out.
"Who are you?"
His ego had formed as he had spoken about who he was.
But what about this Entity before him that was millions of times larger in size alone?
The mere vibrations of his voice caused the surrounding shimmering obsidian darkness to vibrate as his triangular pupil pulsed.
"I am the Outerversal Morphon Phulax. The Observer of Old and Young."

The small voices he could barely hear within him rose in a cacophony of noises.
He was...
He was...!
Osm...!
Ozm...!
HUUM!
His existence fully formed.
Interminable waves of crimson obsidian radiance flashed out.
His identity unveiled itself!
He was...
"Ozymandias!"
"I am...the Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias!"
A deep and guttural voice that seemed like it was echoing out of the very depths of countless endings.
It was a voice that seemed to know innately that it was an Outerversal Morphon- that this was its first identity!
The name that came after that seemed to be from a long distant memory as the voice that uttered it out held a hint of melancholy.
One filled with resonance and Distinctions of unfathomable origins, one that seemed to be trying to remember.
What exactly was he trying to remember?
In the midst of this question, another voice shockingly echoed out as it was filled with depth and ancientness.
"What you are is loud, Young One."
Another voice.
Was he not alone?
He tried to look around, but he could see nothing apart from the lack of light around him.
"You cannot even see, and yet are raucous enough to have already developed an ego?
Take things a step at a time, Young One."
The ancient voice came out again.
This time, it felt kinder and filled with understanding as Ozymandias asked cautiously.
"How...do I see?"
Something that was simplicity itself, and yet seemingly impossible at the same time.
"To see in this place, you must properly outline your form.
Your Outerverse.
Only when you have substance can you begin to see."
Ozymandias heard these words as he looked within the depths of himself and pondered, the small voices that had been trying to rise up making a cacophony of noises at this moment as he repeated.
Form.
Substance.
Ozymandias heard these words as he looked within the depths of himself and pondered, the small voices that had been trying to rise up making a cacophony of noises at this moment as he repeated.
"A form..."
HUUM!
A blast of a unique authority erupted with him at the center.
He knew this authority.
He was born with it.
It was a type of Innate, undeveloped, and young authority.
It was his Outerversal Morphon Authority!
It erupted out as it released humming droning sounds, wrapping around his body as it began to form into something else.
And the form that was coming to fruition...he could see it.
A base trunk formed first as it seemed to be made from trillions of tentacles stacked on top of each other.
These tentacles glimmered with a stellar purple blue hue- each one made from millions of budding singularities as it looked entirely otherworldly.
Moments later, four limbs exploded out, the amalgamation of tentacles forming what Ozymandias knew to be hands and feet.
Then, another trillion tentacles erupted from behind as they were covered by a crimson obsidian light, these tentacles forming into wings of utter horror as at their center- a pupil opened for each!
An eye on the center of each wing.
The eyes held rings of nine pupils uniquely connected to each other as they gave off heart throbbing unease and power.
They blinked.
BZZT!
And trillions more tentacles bloomed behind that formed into Halos!
Rings of tentacles came together, burning with crimson obsidian stellar radiance as they formed into nine Halos that successively became larger the further away they were from him.
A stellar purple blue body, crimson obsidian wings, nine halos of crimson obsidian radiance, and his head...only had two glowing singularities on his face.
Nothing else.
These singularities blinked as within them, threads of countless tentacles throbbed.
Countless tendrils of weavings.
But when they all came together and he could see his exemplary form...
He also became capable of seeing around him.
An expanse of shimmering obsidian darkness stretching out endlessly.
And in the middle of all of this...
"Can you see now, Young One?"
The deep and ancient voice that had been talking with him this whole time.
He saw it.
He saw him.
Someone.
Something that was horrifically millions of times larger than he was.
In front of it, he seemed like a mere speck of dust.
It was round, carrying the features of an eye, with trillions of titanic tentacles wriggling in all directions on the rims of this eye.
It pulsed with deep stellar purple radiance as its pupil was a massive triangular collection of brilliant purple light with a circular singularity at its center!
The massive pupil seemed to smile as it looked at Ozymandias.
"Are you out of words now, Young One?"
Ozymandias looked at this massive entity in awe as his own deep voice echoed out.
"Who are you?"
His ego had formed as he had spoken about who he was.
But what about this Entity before him that was millions of times larger in size alone?
The mere vibrations of his voice caused the surrounding shimmering obsidian darkness to vibrate as his triangular pupil pulsed.
"I am the Outerversal Morphon Phulax.
The Observer of Old and Young."

chapters.title: Chapter 3215 Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias! V
paragraphs: Outerversal Morphon Phulax.
A being with a circular form, a massive eye millions of times bigger than Ozymandias, with countless tentacles stretching all around its rims as its pupil was triangular in nature!
At this moment, within the center of the triangular pupil where a blazing singularity lay, Ozymandias naturally felt its gaze locked onto him.
And he had many questions.
As if this creature knew this to be the case, its deep voice echoed out again.
"You have just come to be, so many things must be confusing for you. You know who you are innately, but you don't know anything else. What is it that you wish to know?"
The voice was immaculately heavy as it seemed tinged with amusement.
It could say many things, but it purposefully chose its words to urge Ozymandias himself the freedom of what he wanted to know!
And Ozymandias looked within the depths of himself.
His stellar purple blue body and crimson obsidian wings.
The nine halos of crimson obsidian radiance behind his wings and his head that only had two glowing singularities.
And the barely discernible voices he could almost hear. With all of this, what exactly would be the first thing he wanted to ask?
A tremendous need filled him and burned within his very being, this need transforming into a question that he blurted out an instant later.
"What is my purpose?"
A question that caused the Outerversal Morphon Phulax to squint its triangular pupil into a smile came out, and his reply was just as heavy.

"You have no purpose. You have just been born in the Megalos Beyond as your existence has no meaning. Over the cycles, I have seen Young Ones like you appear again and again as the first thing all of you innately seek...is your purpose. I will tell you now that as an Outerversal Morphon, you can choose your own purpose- and this will in turn shape your existence."
He could choose his own purpose.
But...what could he possibly want when he had just been born?
Inside of him, the buzzing voices were only becoming louder and louder as they continued to try and tell him something to no avail.
His purpose.
How could he possibly find his purpose?
"A way to help you, Young One, is for you to expand your perspective. A way for Outerversal Morphons to expand their perspectives is none other than going fishing."
What?
"Fishing?" Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias repeated this word that represented an action that didn't entirely feel like the norm.
But why was it not the norm? For something that was just born, why would there be any prejudices on what was the norm or not the norm within him?
As his thoughts were rising, Outerversal Morphon Phulax replied with brilliance.

"Yes, fishing. It is a way for Outerversal Morphons to be connected to all things within the Megalos Beyond and outside of it. It is our Innate capability to take a part of ourselves and stretch it like an endless string across the Megalos Beyond, and we then wait for something to bite. The instant something bites, we gain access. We gain information, and we gain control over the Source of Existence we have managed to fish."

"Those that take the bait and dangle on the strings we cast out are known as our Delegatus. If you go fishing and are able to catch any Delgatus, your vision will be expanded. You will see what is out there in the Megalos Beyond, and this can aid in informing you of your purpose."

The words were unique ones to hear as Ozymandias mulled them over, but within the center point of the Nine halos floating behind his wings, a thin tentacle began to form and extend behind him through the other nine rings gloriously.
Almost as if forming into an endless fishing line.
The Observer of Old and Young saw this scene as the millions of tentacles around it pulsed, its ancient voice echoing out.

"Try and find your first Delegatus. They will link you to your first Source of Existence as the more you gain, the stronger you become. One day, you may even grow to be as big as me. It may take eons before you get even one, so do not be too hasty. Cast out your line, O Young Ozymandias."
HUUM!
Words of encouragement that Aldo felt like words that could never be denied.

The pupils on the wings of Ozymandias pulsed as the string forming in the center of his Halos rapidly lengthened as he moved with intuition, this string beginning to fall down behind him as a line was cast!
At this time, moments after being born, The Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias cast out a line of connection across the Megalos Beyond as he sought for something to bite on!
The Observer of Old and Young nodded at this scene as he was about to pull away when suddenly, its tendrils wriggled as its massive pupil turned towards a certain direction.
There, the expanse of shimmering stellar obsidian darkness flickered and distorted before an equally massive visage of another Outerversal Morphon appeared.

It was a titanic worm-like Outerversal Morphon whose entire cylindrical body was filled with countless wriggling tentacles coming together, its end showing an opening that unfurled to reveal millions of spiked teeth set in circular directions.
At the center of all of these teeth was a fair face with two eyes, a nose, and a mouth present as such a face currently looked towards the Observers of Old and Young with a smile.

This being wasn't alone beside her, someone who was thousands of times smaller than her floated serenity, her form being discernible as it glowed with pure white brilliance in the midst of all this darkness!

Being humanoid in nature, the form seemed to be an amalgamation of pure white illusory tentacles that even stretched out to form white wings behind her back, her face merely showing a form of beauty and grace as only two dark singularities blinked in the center of all this brilliance.
Yet the moment she appeared, everything was illuminated with unfathomable clarity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3216 Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias! VI
paragraphs: "Esteemed Phulax, I have come to show you something quite literally brilliant."
From the worm like Outerversal Morphon with millions of jagged teeth and a fair face at the very center, a sweet voice echoed out that drew near.

"Oh? It is a surprise to see you after all these cycles, Tabatha. Your appearance is due to the Young Light Morphon here? As rare as they are, it shouldn't be the only reason for your appearance here."
The deep voice of Outerversal Morphon Phulax echoed out in reply as Outerversal Morphon Tabatha and the one referred to as a Young Light Morphon drew nearer!

"Not just that, Esteemed Phulax. This one was born not too long ago as I guided them in the ritual of Alieia. And within a Hundredth of a Megachronos, she had actually managed to bind her first Delegatus!"
Words that caused even the Observer of Old and Young to look up in surprise.
A Hundredth of the Megachronos.
A unit of time within the Megalos Beyond that represented a fairly short period of time.
For a rare Morphon to bind their first Delegatus within such a short period of time...this was definitely something worthy of note as this Outerversal Morphon was worth being looked at!
"And-...oh?"
Outerversal Morphon Tabatha was about to continue, but the Young Light Morphon tugged on the sides of its wriggling skin made out of countless tentacles.
When Outerversal Morphon Tabatha turned her gaze, she saw that the Young Light Morphon was pointing towards a small dot in front of Outerversal Morphon Phulax.

A small dot that, in comparison to the Observer of Old and Young, was akin to a grain of sand based on their sheer size, with even Tabatha and the Young Light Morphon only being somewhat bigger in comparison.
But one could almost miss this Entity based on his size, and yet the Young Light Morphon had discovered something that Outerversal Morphon Tabatha and the Observer of Old and Young had missed!

The visage of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias was there, a string falling out from the center of nine halos behind him and stretching down endlessly across the Megalos Beyond below them, but right now...it was shining with gorgeous purple blue radiance and pulsing back and forth.
It was a sign.
"I didn't know you also had another Young Morphon here carrying out their first Alieia. I-"
HUUM!
The tendrils of Outerversal Morphon Phulax buzzed as a terrifying pressure instantly descended to cover everything.
A pressure that stifled the words of the worm like Outerversal Morphon Tabatha.
A pressure that focused on the visage of Ozymandias as truly, his string that he had cast out across the Megalos Beyond...was tout and heavy.
It was shining with brilliance as this was a sign...that he had managed to locate a Delegatus and was undergoing the process of binding at this very moment!
But!
"It has not even been a Millionth of a Megachronos since he was born..."
The deep voice of Outerversal Morphon Phulax echoed out with ancient shock and wonder.
His words caused the Outerversal Morphon Tabatha and Young Light Morphon to freeze as at this moment, all eyes were on Ozymandias!
The moment a line was cast out across the Megalos Beyond.
Alieia.
The process of an Outerversal Morphon casting out a part of themselves across the weavings of countless weavings.
Across the Megalos Beyond.

Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias had the words of the Observer of Old and Young ringing out in his mind as he knew it could take an uncountable passage of time before he would be able to find anything, but he was patient.
And yet, the moment he cast out his line, he came to realize that it...seemed to be shooting straight toward a certain direction.
As if it already had a predetermined pathway it was honing into!
Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias was puzzled by this, but it allowed things to unfold as they were.
The voices within his depths were getting ever louder.
Ever clearer.
But they still seemed too far away.
He utilized the innate capabilities of an Outerversal Morphon to cross the Megalos Beyond, his weavings crossing pathways he never knew existed as moments later...
PAH!
A should akin to a shell being pierced echoed out.
He instantly knew he was out of the Megalos Beyond and in a different space, but he couldn't freely move in this different space unless he had an anchor!
Unless he had something belonging to this space contain a part of him as he acclimated over time.
Even as these thoughts buzzed within Ozymandias, he was surprised to find that his cast line continued shooting out with purpose and direction as if it knew exactly where to go.
It arrived at a certain Omniverse.
It then arrived within an Omniverse inside this Omniverse!
The line then crossed glorious Aletheian Havens and weavings of unfathomable brilliance before arriving above a certain someone.
A multicolored throne connected to countless threads of multicolored lines floated behind him, his figure standing up at this moment as if he had been waiting.
His head was raised high as the cast out line of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias...smashed straight into him with Quintessential radiance.
BOOOM!
The line became tout and straight as if it could never be broken.
Purple blue stellar brilliance gushed and began to travel up this line, carrying with it interminable waves of knowledge and memories.
Across uncountable weavings, the voices within the depths of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias became gloriously clear.
He knew these voices.
Voices of Entropy and Manadynamics.
Voices of Tyranny and of the Protagonist!
The Voice of Quintessence.
They all arose with clarity at this moment as the cogs of countless wheels began to turn, radiance stretching out for uncountable distances as a man found himself!
|The weavings of Outerversal Descent burn with interminable brilliance.|
Voiced began to resume their normal workings within Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias as at this moment, he recognized himself deeply.
He was Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias.
He was also...Noah Osmont!

chapters.title: Chapter 3217 Outerversal Descent! I
paragraphs: One's identity was always a critical factor in who they were.
And identity...was always warped into the very psyche of a being.
Their core.
At this moment, the core of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias was jolted awake and remembered everything about his identity, but at the same time...he still retained what he knew himself as!
The Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias in the distant Megalos Beyond would remain Ozymandias, even though he knew he was Noah.
And at this moment, the initial purpose for carrying out this grand experiment that cost the Infinite Omniverse over half of its authority...was achieved in full effect.
Within the depths of the Infinite Omniverse.

Noah's figure was anchored in place by a string of purple blue brilliance that shot straight into his Atlas of Existence, the Second Mundi of Power spinning with mad fervor as the Source for its power was located!
|The only source of Existence for the Second Mundi of Power has been identified and locked in|
|No other possible Source of Existence can be assimilated into the Second Mundi of Power regardless of any similarity or uniqueness.|

Two prompts flashed as they let it be known that due to how complex and complete the Source of Existence of the Outerversal Descent was, nothing else could ever be added into the Second Mundi of Power.

This was how tremendous this Power was as from the extended string that led to the Megalos Beyond, a flood of interminable power of an Outerversal Morphon flowed out and filled the Second Mundi of Power!
|The System of Existence of Outerversal Descent has been successfully established, a constant Source of Existence generating across an unknown continuum from Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias to you.|
A complex and simple idea at the same time.
But simply.
Noah's Atlas of Existence began to rotate all Nine Mundis of Existence, its core beginning to gush out the Authority of the Laborer with extremely pure concentration and power.
It was a direct correlation to the waves of Outerversal Authority of Ozymandias flowing into the Second Mundi of Power!
And this correlation caused Noah's overall Authority to rise immensely in the stage of an Accumulation Autarch.
He was surging towards becoming a genuine Apogee Autarch- the level of most Protectors of the Commonwealth!
At the same time this process began.
HUUM!
The Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse appeared beside Noah.

Her hair shone with all the colors of Aletheian Havens of this Omniverse, her body wrapped by a veil of all Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities as she locked her gaze onto the unseen string connecting to Noah.
The string- the line leading up across immeasurable distances towards the Megalos Beyond.
What...exactly was the Megalos Beyond? Where was it in comparison to the Infinite Omniverse? To other Omniverses?
Why were the Outerversal Morphons considered enemies of the Commonwealth- what exactly was the answer to the question that Outerversal Morphon Phulax had posed to Ozymandias?!
The Infinite Omniverse sought to know.
Noah sought to know.
Their connection pulsed with resonance as Noah's voice echoed out while he closed his eyes to feel all the subtle changes.
"Do it."
Words of affirmation.
And a moment later, the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse raised her hand and grasped the tout line leading towards the Megalos Beyond.
Everything trembled.
Thereafter, gushing waves of Outerversal Authority began to surge into the Infinite Omniverse.
They wanted answers. So they charged ahead and took actions that may just provide them!
Within the Wheel of Weavings.
Another body of Nuntius Eshkeri greeted Noah's winged figure that was teleported into a unique domain.

A domain that had a massive golden portal at its center, a white walkway connected to the Wheel of Weavings leading to this portal as this walkway stemmed from the white walls of the Wheel of Weavings.
This was the very center of the Wheel of Weavings.

The surrounding space stretched out for light years as massive vessels floated in the surroundings, and the auras of multiple Autarchical Existences surrounded this space as their gazes covered every single spot!

|The distinction of a Protector is a unique one. Its appointment will not be completed in a newly discovered Omniverse with a lot of things still under construction. For your actions and honor, you will be given advanced privilege to head towards the Omniverse X-9, or more commonly known as...the Omniverse of the Protectors.|
The other body of Nuntius Eshkeri emanated such an intent as he beckoned Noah towards an ovoid golden vessel that burned with white flames.
His Simian visage turned around as it neared the rectangular opening guarded by two Foundation Autarchs , and he welcomed Noah in.

|In the Omniverse of the Protectors, you will undergo your official appointment to join us as our brethren. This Wayward Omniversal Vessel is already marked with the coordinates as after passing across the Omniversal Portal, it will take you on the pathway directly to this destination. Any questions at all for me before your departure?|
A calm smile on his glorious monkey like visage.
And Noah only shook his head while reciprocating this smile and stepping into the Wayward Omniversal Vessel, his words echoing out.
"No. We shall see each other again soon, Brother Nuntius Eshkeri."
A flash of brilliance.
And Nuntius Eshkeri nodded as the massive doors of unknown materials of this vessel closed- the white flames around it beginning to vibrate as it moved.
|Sooner than you know, Brother Osmont. Sooner than you know.|
With a glimmer of white flames, the Wayward Omniversal Vessel began to move towards the golden portal.
Inside of it, two gorgeous female Foundation Autarchs walked side by side to Noah as they went towards the depths of this vessel.

"The trip to the Omniverse of the Protectors will take a few hours minimum, or over a day depending on any possible dangers we come across. We have many things for the Unofficial Protector to enjoy within this vessel, and of course...don't be afraid to ask anything of us. Anything at all."

Their core.

|No other possible Source of Existence can be assimilated into the Second Mundi of Power regardless of any similarity or uniqueness.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3218 Outerversal Descent! II
paragraphs: Their fur was covered with white and black brilliance as they spoke, the curves of their figures magnified as they smiled towards him!
As existences whose very souls had achieved Autarchy, their beauty was at the peak of any others in existence.
Noah looked at them with interest as he spread his will across this vessel and replied.
"Let's see the refreshments and food before anything else. And you can tell me more about the Omniverse of the Protectors we are going to."
"Of course, this way..."
He was led deeper into the Vessel that was on its way to leave his Natal Omniverse.
A heavy and profound step forward for him.
At the same time all of this was occurring, another body of his in the Infinite Omniverse was accepting the entry of terrifying waves of Outerversal Authority, but nobody over here sensed anything.
It was a time for many changes and entry into new places.
The Megalos Beyond.
And now, a journey towards another Omniverse!
All of it was surreal as Noah felt like he was just getting started!
And this feeling was all the more surreal when the memories of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias flowed into him.
Memories of the Observer of Old and Young- Outerversal Morphon Phulax!
How powerful was this being whose size was millions of times larger than him?
If size was truly a comparison to power, then as far as he had currently come...there was still a long way to go!
And when it came to power, Noah was very closely experiencing a very unique weaving of power at this time.
He kept it isolated to the body within the Infinite Omniverse.
The coursing power of an Outerversal Morphon, as well as the Distinctions that came with its workings!
The fact that with the System of Existence of Outerversal Descent, he had become a Delegatus of another version of himself within the Megalos Beyond.
But what did this truly signify?
The answers...lay in the Source itself.
Where the version of himself that was the Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias was born!
The answers...lay in the Source itself.
Where the version of himself that was the Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias was born!
Within the Megalos Beyond.
A titanic eye gazed at the tout pulsing line stemming from Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias glowing purple and blue silently as its own millions of tendrils floated serenely with grace and majesty.
A successful search, selection, and binding of a Delegatus outside of the Megalos Beyond in the span of less than a Millionth of a Megachronos.
Something like this may not hold any meaning for others or carry tremendous significance to those with a different type of knowledge.
The question was...the manner in which the newly born Outerversal Morphon achieved this feat.
The weavings of the Observer of Old and Young spread out as it stopped the voice of Outerversal Morphon Tabatha and the silent gaze of the Young Light Morphon.
It wanted to observe.

Surrounded by stellar obsidian radiance, the eyes of the wings of the Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias pulsed as they reveled in the feedback of authority across the singular fishing line he had cast which connected to another part of himself.
Even though Outerversal Authority was flowing down into it, the size and power of Ozymandias here actually scaled upwards as well!
Even though he was giving Outerversal Authority away, there was an overall net benefit to the existence of Ozymandias itself.
It was a unique feedback and reality as it caused him to question.
What was an Outerversal Morphon?
How could their power be defined?
When Ozymandias looked at this closely, the first thing he noted was the high threshold of power for these beings.
At birth, they already exceeded the power of any average Autarch.
At birth!
They didn't have to go through any of the tedious initial steps on the path of power, nor spend eons or millions of years to get here.
This begged the question of just how many there were across this Megalos Beyond.
And in terms of their power...could it truly be augmented and increased the more Delegatus they obtained?
When such daring truth regarding Outerversal Morphons danced in his mind, Ozymandias didn't sit still.

The Nine halos behind him began to spin as at their very center, one thin tentacle after another began to form into a string- into fishing lines that exited the center of the last Halo and were cast down across the Megalos Beyond!
They streaked down with beauty and horror as they seemed like tentacles seeking to latch onto the very weavings of Existence themselves.
And no sooner had they been cast down across the Megalos Beyond...
HUUM!
They began to shine with brilliant purple blue hue one after another.
Meaning every cast tentacle.
Every cast fishing line.
Each one had found a Delegatus almost as quickly as they were cast!

Of course, every single one went directly towards the Infinite Omniverse as after he himself was branded as his own Delegatus, Noah wanted to test the extent of power and uniqueness of this Outerversal Authority as he directed the lines of connection to those who were already connected to him through his Lineage.
Finding them from the Megalos Beyond was the easiest thing.
He knew where every single one had their main bodies within the Infinite Omniverse as he started his tests with the Enders of Existence.
Hyperion was the first as his draconic elephantine eyes blazed with complex brilliance- feeling this new power from the depths of his Lineage as he didn't reject it.
The lines of connection then proceeded towards other Enders of Existence as their Legions were vast!
After them, there were Legions of Illusory Weavings and Records of Entities from eons past.
Each was moving about freely before moments later, a line of connection came down and changed everything.
Within the Megalos Beyond, Ozymandias now had thousands of tout lines cast down from the center of his halos, his body being encased in brilliance as he began to enlarge rapidly.
As he did this.
The tentacles of the Observer of Old and Young buzzed.
The worm like visage of Outerversal Morphon Tabatha...began to tremble as her voice was barely heard.
"The sign! The sign! When the day comes that a newly born Morphon will bind Existence the moment they seek it! O Great Phulax, the sign!"
One particular Outerversal Morphon was going mad as she watched the nigh simultaneous casting and binding of Delegatus with Noah's actions...

chapters.title: Chapter 3219 A Sign! I
paragraphs: A sign.
These were the ravings of a powerful Outerversal Morphon as she observed the casting of lines and instant luminosity thereafter that indicated an extremely rapid process of Alieia!
An extremely rapid process of wading one's weavings across the Megalos Beyond into other parts of Existence and somehow being able to locate and bind a Delegatus right away.
How else could this be explained?
In the vast knowledge of the Outerversal Morphon Tabatha, there was a shred of ancient words that many Morphons that had lived over the cycles knew.
It was so shocking to the Outerversal Morphon that she only gazed on in shock while repeating herself.
"The sign...when a newly born Morphon will bind Existence freely the moment they deemed it. The sign...!"
She recalled what it all meant as she seemed to be in a trance.

And the entity she was looking at, the one causing her to repeat her words like a broken record....he also seemed to be in a trance as more and more tentacles transformed into endless strings that were cast down.
Moments later, these strings shone with a glorious luster as the size of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias only increased exponentially.
How could such a phenomenon be explained by the Outerversal Morphons?

Were they supposed to suddenly think that somehow, the Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias before them was actually a part of an existence who ruled over an entire young Omniverse, his Lineage spread out to quintillions upon quintillions of beings that he was connected to all across the Aletheian Havens of this Omniverse?

Were they supposed to make a jump and think that somehow, such a being had reverse engineered a pathway into the Megalos Beyond after watching the entry of Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap, and this was what led to the current reality?
Such thoughts would be utterly outlandish to make any jump towards as of course, the first and only thought in their minds was something they knew for many cycles now.
Legends spread across the Outerversal Morphon.
As Outerversal Morphon Tabatha repeated herself again and again, the Young Light Morphon glowed brightly as she weaved her authority to interrupt while asking.
"Great Mother Tabatha, what does such a Sign mean?"
What did this sign mean?
The words woke Outerversal Morphon Tabatha out of her reverie as her wormlike figure buzzed while she echoed out.

"A sign that for better or worse, the Megalos Beyond is about to change. It has been said that when such a Sign presents itself, it means the instrument of the final destruction or the final expansion of the Megalos Beyond across all of Existence will have been born!"
Heavy words filled with oddities echoed out as the Young Light Morphon squinted her singularities while asking carefully.
"So...is he the instrument that will bring about destruction or expansion?"
Her words were straightforward.
But the visage of Outerversal Morphon Tabatha was not as straightforward as her many jagged teeth swirled with twists and turns.

"Many Morphon across the cycles disagreed and argued about this as it was never explicitly stated. It is unknown as the Origin of the Instrument was never clarified! But what is clear is this sign that is unfolding right before us."
Words that didn't make things any easier to understand echoed out as the Young Light Morphon watched the ongoing scene carefully.
She then came across a critical issue that she turned to Outerversal Morphon Tabatha and asked innocently.
"Great Mother Tabatha, who spoke of these signs initially? Why were they not asked to clarify?"
A simple question.
But it was one that caused the worm like visage of Tabatha to vibrate as she uttered out as if she were in a trance.
"That ancient being...has disappeared since then. They-"
"Hush now."
HUUM!
The booming and thick voice of the Observer of Old and Young echoed out as Outerversal Morphon Tabatha became quiet.

The tendrils of his millions of tentacles had inadvertently covered everything around them- and they only came to a realization now as they realized everything around them was covered by the wriggling tentacles of the Outerversal Morphon Phulax as if they were endlessly twisting snakes.
"You have spoken out a great deal and likely alerted others. Alas, that is how it was always meant to be."
His deep voice held power and misery, weakness and contentment, and even more in between as it was truly complex.
But it was solid and without any doubts as it continued.
"Let the child finish what he is doing. We will see then."
The child.

The Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias who continued to cast out strings across the Megalos Beyond at this moment- all these strings crossing thin gaps left open by the Observer of Old and Young as they stretched out across Existence!
In another area across the vastness of the Megalos Beyond.

An Entity of approximate size to the Observer of Old and Young had millions of lines cast down to the Megalos Beyond, her gaze filled with ancient brilliance as she had three crimson eyes shaped like nine pointed stars.
These eyes were attached to a massive visage that had the upper half of a humanoid entity, and a lower half that seemed to be a long trunk extending into countless roots across the Megalos Beyond!
These roots pulsed at this moment as some of them captured in distinct weavings that could only be picked up by those with unique dispositions and power across the Megalos Beyond.
|The Sign!|
|Bind Existence the moment they seek it! The sign!|
Words that should have in no way reached such a vast distance did so.
The weavings of terrifying authorities that were always keeping a look out for anything to do with certain subjects picked it up.

It was so terrifying that it could be something occurring an infinitely far distance within the Megalos Beyond, and yet if certain authorities were set up to pick something relating to a specific issue...so long as something related to it arose, those who set up these authorities would know!
At this moment, heavy words spread that caused the countless roots of this massive Outerversal Morphon to flutter.
Her three eyes burned with brilliance and began to spin.
It wasn't entirely clear what she was about to do, but what thing was abundantly clear.
Certain words were uttered.
And these certain words had begun to, ever so slowly, permeate across the Megalos Beyond!

Certain words were uttered.
And these certain words had begun to, ever so slowly, permeate across the Megalos Beyond!

chapters.title: Chapter 3220 A Sign! II
paragraphs: Across the Megalos Beyond.
Regions of unfathomable distance and power waded across.
Myriads of tentacles seethed with ever confounding brilliance.
In yet another region of such a place, a mass of obsidian tentacles by the millions seethed as they were very familiar.

They were the tentacles of none other than the banished Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap who had one of his most prized Delegatus lost due to a sudden unraveling of his existence that caused his power to leak out as he sought to use the opportunity to do something bold.
Something only possible with a few of his Delegatus that he had raised to a high level of power!
But it was all for naught.
His Delegatus was wasted while his entry was stopped before making significant gains.
At times like these, it wanted significant gains.
It-
|The Sign!|
Its countless mass of tentacles wriggled and arose.

There were so many that the form of Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap could not be entirely made out, but these tentacles picked up something from a far distance within the Megalos Beyond as they began to buzz with activity.
The Sign.
What they spoke out in the distant past cycles- weavings of possibilities.

When Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap remembered the words of that being everyone idolized- the being that disappeared to never be found many cycles ago...his tentacles began to crackle with obsidian brilliance!
That entity was many things.
A liar was not one of them.
If from what they mentioned cycles ago would come was actually appearing now...
|It cannot be allowed.|
HUUM!
His voice dripped of brutality and ancientness as this mentality of his was made many cycles ago.
A possible instrument for the destruction or expansion of the Megalos Beyond.
Even if it was only a possibility, why take the risk when it came to the Megalos Beyond?
And if it turned out he wasn't the instrument or the words of that person never came to be, then it was just that.
The countless tentacles began to move.
|No signs.|
There were many more things that person said.
Some that only a select few, in addition to Outerversal Morphon Ginnungagap, knew!
They could not be allowed to come to fruition.
So...
|The erasure of any possible instruments is paramount.|
A daring Declaration was made.
And one of the oldest Outerversal Morphons within the Megalos Beyond began to move!
How could the sensation be described?
With every string he cast.

With every fishing line he threw out that came to connect with the people that he was already connected to, he felt like he was giving a part of himself away, and yet this part was given back, plus a whole lot more.
|The weavings of Outerversal Descent and the workings of this System of Existence are slowly being discerned.|

|The input of Existence from an Outerversal Morphon and onto any selected Existence is cycled before the Outerversal Authority naturally multiplies and is returned in an amplified form back to the Outerversal Morphon.|
A unique point in the workings of the Outerversal Morphon.
They didn't actually lose anything in this process, and they gained even more from it.
Arriving at such a point, Noah came to a critical decision.
In the Infinite Omniverse, his voice echoed out.
"How is the continuity of Existential Terraforming?"

|The size and breadth of Existence of the Aletheian Havens have so far more than tripled, with the process slowed down while seas of Mana act as an anchor to stabilize everything. Once a determined stable safety factor has been ascertained, Terraforming will resume again fully.|
He was answered succinctly as there was one last thing to confirm.
"Any negative effects to the Outerversal Authority flowing into the Infinite Omniverse?"

The Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse had grasped onto the thread that came all the way from the Megalos Beyond as waves of Outerversal Authority had gushed out from it and into the Infinite Omniverse itself.
But what did this do?
| A view of it would be much more astute.|
Part of his consciousness was taken elsewhere.
He saw a portion of the vibrant halcyon sands of the Dream Aletheian Haven.
But in one area, these sands shone with a vibrant stellar obsidian hue reminiscent to the stellar obsidian brilliance of the Megalos Beyond!

|Preliminary tests show a high rate of conversion of the surrounding existence along with a rapid addition to the overall landmass of the Infinite Omniverse, and no negative effects have been discovered so far.|
It may actually be feasible.
So Noah nodded and made up his mind as his voice echoed out again.
"Analyze all possible contingencies and prepare to receive a direct link from Ozymandias to the Infinite Omniverse."
A shocking step.
How was the Infinite Omniverse to grow and advance?
Existential Terraforming was one of them even with its instability that was solved by using Noah as an anchor.
But thereafter, was it going to devour and assimilate other Omniverses?
As of this moment, the answer was no!

What was happening instead, was the introduction to the Megalos Beyond as for the expansion of the Infinite Omniverse, the possibility of its expansion containing a semblance of the vastness of the Megalos Beyond came to be.
And this possibility only came to be because of Noah's entry into the Megalos Beyond!
What would its full effects be? What would the Infinite Omniverse become in the future if its constructs had weavings of the Megalos Beyond within it?
Nobody could say for sure.
But since its Master gave the command...
|I will prepare everything, Master.|
The Infinite Omniverse followed and started the weavings of a grandiose project!

Far from the Infinite Omniverse, tracing up the countless lines of connections that were dropping from the Megalos Beyond- the weavings of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias felt all changes with pristine details.
He also felt the many changes to his own body and surroundings of the area he was in within the Megalos Beyond.
Along with the ravings of the one known as Outerversal Morphon Tabatha!

chapters.title: Chapter 3221 Purpose! I
paragraphs: Within the brilliance of the Megalos Beyond.
A massive eye with a triangular pupil stretched out millions of tentacles to cover everything in this area.
Enclosed within was a titanic worm like Outerversal Morphon, a Young Light Morphon, and the recently born Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias, whose body was enlarging at a rapid pace.
The ravings of Outerversal Morphon Tabatha were also heard by Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias amidst his brilliance.
Ravings of the Sign.
So after thousands of tentacles were cast down across the Megalos Beyond from him as he successfully bound many Enders of Existence as Delegates, he took a pause.

He waited for the computations and analysis from the Infinite Omniverse on what would happen if he carried out a grand ordeal and observed his own changes as well as those receiving tendrils of Outerversal Authority within the Infinite Omniverse.
His singularities that took the place of his eyes on his head blinked as he gazed around as if he were waking from a reverie, the eyes on the wings behind his back being even more brilliant!
As he gazed around, so did those who had been watching him this whole time further scrutinize him.
The voice of the Observer of Old and Young was the first one to ring out towards him as he came to.
"What is your purpose, Young One?"
His purpose.
The Observer of Old and Young had told him before that after performing Alieia multiple times and expanding his knowledge of Existence, his purpose would gradually form.
So he had seen.
Thousands of lines were cast down as he bound multiple Delegatus and attained their memories, hopes, dreams, and livelihoods for as long as they had lived!
How did this inform his purpose?
Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias gazed deeply into the burning triangular pupil, weavings of tendrils of Outerversal Authority seething around him as he spoke with surety.
"My purpose...is the Megalos Beyond!"
Thousands of lines were cast down as he bound multiple Delegatus and attained their memories, hopes, dreams, and livelihoods for as long as they had lived!
BOOM!
How did this inform his purpose?
The surrounding stellar obsidian space shook with brilliance.
Off to the side, the worm like body of Outerversal Morphon Tabatha shook even more as she began raving again!
"Ah! The sign! The sign!"
Reality pulsed and distorted after a simple sentence was uttered.

Noah spoke of it daringly as truly, after entering this Megalos Beyond, he wanted to see how much more expansive it was compared to the vast array of Omniverses, and with the aid of the Infinite Omniverse...he may even be capable of taking the breadth and power of this Megalos Beyond!
It was all to fulfill his own greed.
His own overarching need for power that others wouldn't ever come close to matching.
But how would it be interpreted by these Entities who seemed to already have preset prophecies that they were associating with him when he had nothing to do with them?
The massive visage of the Observer of Old and Young seemingly let out a sigh before its thick voice reverberated out.
"A clear purpose. One that is exactly the same as that Entity many cycles ago. "
The reason for the ravings of Outerversal Morphon Tabatha.
She had begun again as her beliefs were only confirmed further when Ozymandias revealed his purpose that actually turned out to be the same as that Entity all those cycles ago!

The tendrils of Outerversal Morphon Phulax wrapped around and protected everything currently to ensure to weavings of words were picked up and stretched out across the Megalos Beyond, his ancient voice leaking out again as his gaze remained on Ozymandias.

"I observe the old and young, Ozymandias. I have personally seen the births of millions of Outerversal Morphons over the cycles as most times, I end things with observance. Other times, I do more than this. When I come across those with a unique purpose, I aid them. You...have a unique purpose and are currently surrounded by lore that will make it very difficult for you to live past even a single cycle."

"Whether this lore relates to you truly or not cannot be said with surety, but it has now been linked to you regardless. Not much can be kept secret within the Megalos Beyond, much less something that relates to this that many sensitive beings already set up securities to hear about it any time it is mentioned across the Megalos Beyond. So, Young One, will you take my aid as we ascertain certain lore and Fables from many cycles ago?"
The aid of Outerversal Morphon Phulax.
A terrifying entity that is still millions of times larger than Ozymandias, with a level of power unknown in its stature across the Megalos Beyond.
So of course, the wings of Ozymandias pulsed with brilliance as he nodded with contemplation.
A choice was made.
Outerversal Morphon Phulax gazed at Noah with scrutiny before tendrils of obsidian lightning flashed across its body, its massive size beginning to shrink.
"Take on the smallest and weakest form you can take. What we are about to do requires a level of stealth to ensure it goes smoothly."
The smallest and weakest form.

The massive body of the Observer of Old and Young, which was larger than even Domains of Existence, shrank down tremendously as countless tentacles retreated into a small singularity, this singularity taking on a humanoid form.
The smallest. The weakest possible form.
It wasn't known what the Observer of Old and Young based this on, but he transformed into the image of an old man with tan skin that shone with a bronze luster.

Messy dark and white hair covered his head as he seemed hunched over, his hand thrusting out to weave millions of tentacles into a walking stick that he grasped and hit the pointed end on the space below him.
BOOM!
A circular obsidian wave of light shot out that began to cover all of the surrounding space- twisting and disrupting everything as if all their tracks were being covered.

Ozymandias himself looked at this scene as his body became smaller, the visible threads of thousands that sank across the Megalos Beyond disappearing as his authority allowed them to be visible or entirely invisible!
