chapters.title: Chapter 3222 Purpose! II
paragraphs: The wings and nine halos of crimson obsidian brilliance behind him retracted into his body.

Purple and blue stellar brilliance flashed as he became shrouded in a purple robe that seemed to be made out of stars, his facial features becoming more defined as he gained more than just singularities for eyes.

His skin still gave off an otherworldly feeling as it held a paint as if he was forged from millions of shattered Cosmos- with his image almost melding with the obsidian stellar brilliance all around the Megalos Beyond!

Behind him, the figures of a shrewd woman adorned in a black dress and a pointed hat appeared, her fair face filled with wrinkles that would remind one of the segmentation of worms as her eyes his immeasurable brilliance.

Beside her, a young woman with white light radiating in her surroundings floated, her visage adorned with a white dress as she held a profound sense of beauty and eyes that seemed filled with insatiable curiosity!
With the visage of an old man with a cane leading at the front, Ozymandias in the middle, and Teo Outerversal Morphons in humanoid forms following from behind...

"Let us go. There are many we must make contact with and gather the support of if you are to last even a single cycle in these Megalos Beyond. Whether you have any connection to the one mentioned in long forgotten Fables or not...will be ascertained in time."
The old man took a step forward.
And their surroundings instantly distorted as the stellar obsidian space below twisted and formed into a disk that carried all of them.
From behind, the wrinkly visage of the old woman stared at Ozymandias as if she were looking at an object of taboo, her voice coming out in hushed tones as she asked.
"Great Phulax, where do you have in mind to even go?"
Across the Megalos Beyond, where and who would they go to?
The Observer of Old and Young remained placid as the stellar obsidian disk below them began to move, his voice steady and filled with depth as he replied.

"The Clan that Entity stemmed from. They should have records more comprehensive than anyone else, and if there even stands a chance that the time their Predecessor talked about has come...they will not hesitate to throw their weight behind the Sign."
In the corner of his eyes, he gazed at Ozymandias as he sighed internally.
Something so recently born and now, it would be thrust into the center of Fables that it may have nothing to do with.
'Poor thing.'
This was the thought of Outerversal Morphon Phulax as he went forward, their figures warping across the Megalos Beyond and heading towards a specific destination.
Even though Phulax felt empathic at the woes and dangers to come to this Young One, he still went forward regardless as this was his job.
He was the Observer of Old and Young, and he embarked on a journey that even he didn't know what ending it could have!
Far, far from the distant Megalos Beyond.
A vessel tore across the weavings of Existence and Non-existence- with tumultuous storms capable of shredding even a Foundation Autarch raging outside of it.
But inside, calmness and wonder were all that could be found.

Within, the figure of Noah was seated on a large white throne, a curved transparent circular screen showing him the deadly storms of Existence and Non-existence raging outside as the vessel powered on.

"Made from the materials found on a unique Omniverse and the carapace of the Worms of Existence, this Vessel can cross unfettered from one Omniverse and into the next with ease. You'll come across the Forgers of the Commonwealth who design constructs like this and the Wheel of Weavings sooner rather than later.

Besides Noah, two female Simians gazed towards him with glazed eyes as none of their seductive efforts had succeeded, with Noah only asking for more information regarding the Commonwealth and nothing else as his devilish apathy only made a challenge for these Simians seem more enticing!

But their efforts were bound to end in failure as in the next moment, the vessel began to pulse and radiated waves of authority while the scene of storms around them faded, an encompassing multicolored radiance pulsing out from all around as a major jump was made.
BZZZT!
The flow of weavings rapidly changed.
And Noah's own weavings alerted him first even before the surrounding reality constructed itself all around.
|The weavings of another Omniverse have been discovered.|
Space twisted and re-established itself.
As if lights had been turned on, stellar rays of verdant brilliance stretched out as far as the eyes could see.
In the surroundings, the allure of an endless void filled with vibrant stellar green roots appeared, these roots stretching out for light years.

The vessel floated silently as it went towards a construct seemingly made from nature- a construct that looked like a flower with incandescent verdant petals the size of Domains of Existence shining with glory.
Other Vessels could be seen floating around this space, along with auras of Many Teracosm and Paracosm Entities!

In the far distance, the massive construct of another Wheel of Weavings could be seen- its structure taking on the same verdant hue of the surroundings as it seemed different in color but exactly the same in structure like the Wheel of Weavings within Noah's Natal Omniverse.
Apart from it, other constructs were stretching out in between the ever present verdant roots that seemingly filled all of this Omniverse!
The vessel went towards the center of one of the nearby verdant petals of the massive flower the size of an Existential Domain, approaching a flat space where other vessels were stationed.
At the very front of this area, three Apogee Autarchs floated with their hands behind their backs as they gazed towards the vessel that Noah was flying in with.
"We welcome you to the Omniverse of the Protectors. The Omniverse where the sharpest swords of the Commonwealth are forged- Omniverse X-9!"
The female Simians beside him spoke in synchrony as Noah appeared in another Omniverse for the first time.

But inside, calmness and wonder were all that could be found.

Within, the figure of Noah was seated on a large white throne, a curved transparent circular screen showing him the deadly storms of Existence and Non-existence raging outside as the vessel powered on.
"Made from the materials found on a unique Omniverse and the carapace of the Worms of Existence, this Vessel can cross unfettered from one Omniverse and into the next with ease.
You'll come across the Forgers of the Commonwealth who design constructs like this and the Wheel of Weavings sooner rather than later.

Besides Noah, two female Simians gazed towards him with glazed eyes as none of their seductive efforts had succeeded, with Noah only asking for more information regarding the Commonwealth and nothing else as his devilish apathy only made a challenge for these Simians seem more enticing!

But their efforts were bound to end in failure as in the next moment, the vessel began to pulse and radiated waves of authority while the scene of storms around them faded, an encompassing multicolored radiance pulsing out from all around as a major jump was made.
BZZZT!
The flow of weavings rapidly changed.
And Noah's own weavings alerted him first even before the surrounding reality constructed itself all around.
|The weavings of another Omniverse have been discovered.|
Space twisted and re-established itself.
As if lights had been turned on, stellar rays of verdant brilliance stretched out as far as the eyes could see.
In the surroundings, the allure of an endless void filled with vibrant stellar green roots appeared, these roots stretching out for light years.

The vessel floated silently as it went towards a construct seemingly made from nature- a construct that looked like a flower with incandescent verdant petals the size of Domains of Existence shining with glory.
Other Vessels could be seen floating around this space, along with auras of Many Teracosm and Paracosm Entities!

In the far distance, the massive construct of another Wheel of Weavings could be seen- its structure taking on the same verdant hue of the surroundings as it seemed different in color but exactly the same in structure like the Wheel of Weavings within Noah's Natal Omniverse.
Apart from it, other constructs were stretching out in between the ever present verdant roots that seemingly filled all of this Omniverse!
The vessel went towards the center of one of the nearby verdant petals of the massive flower the size of an Existential Domain, approaching a flat space where other vessels were stationed.
At the very front of this area, three Apogee Autarchs floated with their hands behind their backs as they gazed towards the vessel that Noah was flying in with.
"We welcome you to the Omniverse of the Protectors.
The Omniverse where the sharpest swords of the Commonwealth are forged- Omniverse X-9!"
The female Simians beside him spoke in synchrony as Noah appeared in another Omniverse for the first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 3223 Protector Osmont! I
paragraphs: Within the Omniverse of the Protectors.

Coming out of a vessel with two Foundation Autarchs in tow, Noah's will covered the few light years nearby as the fantastical structures and number of auras truly distinguished themselves, with one piece of important information presenting itself at this moment with clarity.
And that was the glimpse of the power of the Commonwealth.
They were within the Omniverse of the Protectors, and the one thing Noah observed after arriving here was the sheer number of powerful Entities at the Autarchical level of Existence!
His expression remained calm as he counted just the ones he could feel the auras of within the areas where one's will wasn't restricted, and he counted 1344.
1344 Autarchs!

Some were within the verdant Wheel of Weavings, others stretched out in some of the many unique constructs stretched out in the surroundings, and others were within this massive blooming flower with verdant petals.
This was a terrifying number that showed a glimpse of the power of the Commonwealth, and the surroundings of this place only added to the intrigue.

He didn't know how much Existential Terraforming had occurred, but the richness and potency of the surrounding Existence was so great that just by being in this space, one could feel their existence soothed.

Ahead of him, three Royal Existential Omniversal Simians stood with their hands behind their backs, their bodies emanating the powerful aura of Apogee Autarchs as the one in the center, a Simian with pure white fur all around, was the one to speak out. "Prime Citizen Osmont...who shall now take the steps to become Protector Osmont...welcome to the Omniverse of the Protectors."
A smile on the Simian facial features that seemed to hold a trace of seriousness. HUUM!
With a flicker of his hands, a white portal bloomed behind them.
The Apogee Autarchs proceeded to step into this portal, Noah following along as the two Simian females that had been escorting him this whole time bowed while staying behind.

His existence passed through the white portal fearlessly as he felt himself pulled towards the depths of this flower like construct, reality reconstructing itself around him rapidly as he appeared in a much smaller domain.
He gazed up to see cloudy skies as drops of rain drizzled on his face, each drop carrying with it tremendous Vitality and life force as it seemed to contain the pure Nectar of Existence itself!

His existence passed through the white portal fearlessly as he felt himself pulled towards the depths of this flower like construct, reality reconstructing itself around him rapidly as he appeared in a much smaller domain.
He gazed up to see cloudy skies as drops of rain drizzled on his face, each drop carrying with it tremendous Vitality and life force as it seemed to contain the pure Nectar of Existence itself!
Akin to the Fruits of Existence that could bloom within his Omniverse.
This rain itself seemed to be highly concentrated weavings of existence that were so pure that one could absorb them on their skin as they fell.
Around him, the drops of rain fell on lush grasslands, with colorful trees budding with unique fruits stretched out around small rising mountains.

The white portal placed him on a path filled with cobblestones that ascended towards a small mountain which everything was centered on, and one could see a small dilapidated house made from straws and mud.
The three Apogee Autarchs were already standing in front of this dilapidated cottage, their bodies bent in a bowing motion towards an old man who sat in front of a chessboard!
The old man gave a nod of recognition to them before he raised his head and smiled towards Noah's figure in the distance.

When Noah saw this being, his eyes shone with somberness as he came across an Entity not within the bounds of the Existential Dominium Realm- the uniqueness and pressure of this being placing him in the Omniversal Realm!
Noah took a step to appear before this Entity as unlike the Apogee Autarchs, he merely gave a nod of recognition.
An action that the Apogee Autarchs became stern at, but the old man only smiled and waved his hands as he invited Noah to sit on the mat opposite him.
"A new protector. A special one at that as you were capable of unveiling an Agent of Anti-Life. How were you able to do that, by the way?"
His voice vibrated with power.
He seemed disconnected from the surrounding reality as uniquely, this old man's disposition was entirely human without an ounce of the Simian fur.
Noah looked at this being and replied calmly.

"I made the same discovery as everyone else today. My authority attacked with the intent of disrupting and causing dissonance in the weavings of existence of my enemy. This...so called Agent of Anti-Life reacted so badly to my attack that it seemingly caused dissonance between him and whatever he was connected to."
Noah described the process of utilizing the miniaturized Fat Monkeys smoothly as the old man in front of him nodded while stroking his beard.
His fair skin glinted with brilliance, his dark and white hair messy as the simple white robes he wore made him look like a hermit from eons past.
"That simple thing you just described is precisely the type of talent needed at a time like this. Tell me, Osmont, what do you know on the subject of Anti-Life? Or Anti-Existence?"
The old man asked simply while moving a chess piece, and in their immediate surroundings, illusory screens flashed into existence that displayed fantastical scenes.
Noah looked at these scenes while shaking his head in a reply.
"Not much aside from what I saw today."
He lied easily as there was no mention of how at this moment, he could be considered someone belonging to the camp of Anti-Life more than anyone else!
The old man nodded at this as he began to explain the scenes playing out around them.

"Existence is vast. Vaster than any of us can ever imagine. We don't know the number of Omniverses out there, we don't know the possible number of existences- whether living or dead. There is a lot we do not know, but we do know about them routinely destroying weavings of existence en masse. We know of those who seek to destroy life in totality, and those who simply wish to deny Existence in totality."
As he spoke, the illusory screens showing titanic Worms of Existence and Outerversal Morphons became larger and even clearer!

chapters.title: Chapter 3224 Protector Osmont! II
paragraphs: The rain came down heavily, each drop passing through the illusory screens as everything nearby was filled with boundless weavings of existence.

One screen showed a massive segmented worm with wide open jaws that were Devouring the surrounding Omniverse- a dozen Royal Existential Omniversal Simians surrounding it and unleashing waves of brilliant attacks.

Another screen showed millions of crimson tentacles wrapping around clusters of Domains of Existence, an aura of decay spreading as a group of Draconians were caught within its grasp- their life quickly fading away as they were turned into mindless entities moments later that attacked their own people!
"They made designations for Anti-Life and Anti-Existence, but for me...it's really all the same."
The old man at the Omniversal Realm continued as the scenes shown on the illusory screens became all that more graphic.

One scene in particular showed an Entity that seemed like this old man before him adorned in a multicolored armor, with dozens of stacked circles radiating pure white lightning rotating around him as he released heavy blasts of power against an outline of a titanic Outerversal Morphon!
The white lightning joined together to form multiple Wheels that spun with interminable glory- grinding down thousands of tentacles with ferocity and valor.
The area around them was laid to waste as Noah actually saw the surroundings gain a tint of the stellar obsidian hue of the Megalos Beyond.

Countless tentacles surged out in anger and defiance as they continued to be burnt by white lightning, the multicolored armament on this being's body seemingly supporting him amidst the deteriorating existence as he actually managed to push back this Outerversal Morphon!

"The Worms of Existence are destructive and a tremendous threat, but at least their minds only have the thought of destruction as with many sacrifices over the eons, it is easy to face them. But these monstrosities of Anti-Life...their purpose does not seem to simply be destruction. They're more complex. Their reach goes far as across the Omniverses, they have already stained an Unknown number of Entities as their Agents. They offer strength and power, and many accept it without fully knowing the results that will come from it. They don't just destroy as they alter entire Omniverses to their will, and do things that most of us cannot analyze or understand. Outerversal Morphons, they call themselves. Outerversal...a term that if anyone tells you they can truly define, they don't know anything. To this day, I do not understand them. But, if there are more Protectors capable of identifying Agents of such beings..."
The old man moved his gaze from the chessboard before him and locked onto Noah.
All the things he had talked about were actually things that Noah knew very well, especially the idea of altering entire Omniverses to their wills!
The old man moved his gaze from the chessboard before him and locked onto Noah.
All the things he had talked about were actually things that Noah knew very well, especially the idea of altering entire Omniverses to their wills!

What he was trying to do right now as he looked at the possibility of binding his Infinite Omniverse under his identity of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias would undoubtedly have grand consequences in the future to come.
But he simply took in all the waves of information he received as he asked with inquisitiveness before this being continued his monologue.
"Who are you?"
A humanoid entity that Royal Existential Omniversal Simians bowed down to.
Someone who the newest recruits of the Protectors were taken to once arriving at the Omniverse of the Protectors!
This old man smiled at Noah's question as he shook his head.

"Just an old man that has been fighting for too long. You can call me Eudemus. You can call me The Old Protector. Some kids even play around and call me the Shield of the Commonwealth. But all I am is someone who has seen too many eons of battle and wishes to bring them to an end. Too many Omniverses have been destroyed, and too many lives have ended. And there is no victory in sight as truly, it had to end. Whether through peace. Whether through annihilation. Whatever way possible. Will you help me achieve that? If you can replicate what you did on that Arena and begin sniffing out Agents of Anti-Life across the myriad Omniverses, you will make great contributions to Existence itself. And of course, you can ask for anything your heart desires."
The Shield of the Commonwealth!

The Entity standing atop the myriad Protectors of the Commonwealth was actually not a Royal Existential Omniversal Simian, and he sought to add another Protector under his banner to further his aim of ending an endless war.
But the words he uttered were very crucial as they could provide vastly different results!
Whether through Peace or Annihilation, he wanted things to end.
Noah looked at this being and gave a light nod of affirmation.
"I will fight on behalf of Existence."
HUUM!
His words caused an eruption of power as they could mean any myriad of things depending on who listened to them.
He would fight on behalf of Existence. Not on behalf of the Commonwealth. Not on behalf of anybody else.
But on the side of Existence!
They could easily be taken the wrong way, but the Shield of the Commonwealth smiled as he waved his hands to reveal a floating sword between him and Noah.

"Good. You can now officially be deemed a Protector of the Commonwealth, and to show you what awaits in store should you perform in an exemplary manner...this is a piece of a shattered Omniverse that was forged into a sword. An Omniversal Armament. Familiarize yourself with it as it should help you bridge the power of most Protectors, and then you can get ready to be deployed to Omniverses rife with war and decimation. Maybe, just maybe...you could be a breath of change in this eon to come, Protector Osmont."
An Omniversal Armament!
The Shield of the Commonwealth, Eudemus, offered such a wonderful as the Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor was officially deemed a Protector of the Commonwealth!
|A Unique Armament has been discovered.|

Within Noah's mind, prompts had already begun to rise as his hand reached out to grasp the multicolored sword- his Distinctions as the Weaver moved rapidly as they sought to understand everything quickly!

chapters.title: Chapter 3225 Odessos, the Grave of the Great Beyonder! I
paragraphs: [Kusanagi, Omniversal Cleaver]:: A Product made from a carefully preserved portion of a shattered Omniverse. It holds potent weavings of Existence within it and the rank of an Average Omniversal Armament forged by A Blacksmith whose weavings resonate and emanate that of an Omniverse itself. With a small input of Existential Authority, Kusanagi will release ten times the output while adding in trace amounts of Omniversal Authority. With the input of Omniversal Authority, the true form of Kusanagi can be revealed- its edge sharp enough to cleave small parts of an Omniverse. By merely holding it, your circulation, generation, and Regeneration of Existential Authority increases by 1,000%. With every Existence put to rest with Kusanagi, you will accumulate Omniversal Rage Points that can be released as an instantaneous blast of Omniversal Rage all around you. The more Points accumulated before the release, the more potent the release will be...
A daring weapon!
Noah grasped it in his hands as instantly, his Atlas of Existence buzzed with activity.
Tendrils of multicolored brilliance surged from the sword and onto his hands, his Atlas of Existence that now had two Mundis of Power covered with brilliance spinning just a little bit faster.
This weapon alone and the entity who made it were both extremely distinguished as they harnessed the power of an Omniverse into an extremely small tool!

|The Omniversal Weapon, Kusanagi, has been fully analyzed. After being broken down, it is possible to mass produce Sword Type Omniversal Armaments like it from the Infinite Omniverse. Further analysis leads to the assertion that as of this moment, Omniversal Armaments can begin their design and planning for future production within the Infinite Omniverse.|
Others had Omniversal Armaments, yes.
But he had a genuine Omniverse under his belt as he could even attack an enemy with the terrifying weight and breadth of this Omniverse!

It was one of his strongest possible attacks that came at a great cost, but it gave him confidence against any Apogee Autarch, and also made him surge with a challenging light against any Omniversal Realm Entities he would come to meet as enemies.
Would they be able to withstand being smashed with the breadth of the entire Infinite Omniverse?

|The first weapon under design and planning in the Infinite Omniverse is one suited to you, making it easier and less costly to release the breadth of the Infinite Omniverse onto your enemies. After analysis, the modification of Ruination into an Innate Omniversal Armament has been deemed as the most opportune sequence to handle the load of the Infinite Omniverse and your own Authority.|
The voice of the Infinite Omniverse rang out in Noah's mind as many things began to be planned the moment he first came across an Omniversal Armament.
Eudemus smiled while nodding to the three Apogee Autarchs beside him.
"Take Protector Osmont to meet those within the newly established Equestris Protectors. After some acclimating, be ready for deployment at any time..."
The last set of words were spoken to Noah as he rose.

The drops of rain smashed onto the chessboard and cottage atop this small mountain as the concentration of Existence became all that much more potent, but he nodded towards the Shield of the Commonwealth and followed the three Apogee Autarchs that he found were looking at the weapon he was given with a sharp light!
Within moments, they disappeared into the same white portal they came from as only an old man was left in this unique domain.
The rain that fell on him was instantly absorbed into his skin as he had a shrewd smile, his eyes radiating a piercing light as he looked where Noah had disappeared from.
"Another one that I cannot see the future of...interesting!"
A few words.
After they were uttered, everything faded to oblivion.
Within Noah's Natal Omniverse.
Inside the Wheel of Weavings where the golden sands of the Gladiators Arena were seeing even more blood.

|Unbelievable! The Omniversal Ankyra of this Omniverse is standing toe to toe with a past champion from this very same Arena! He is single handedly taking back the glory after the successive losses his compatriots faced!|
As the matches within the Gladiators Arena continued, more powerful Autarchs came out as Piety, Lilith, and Kazuhiko were among the few who were already knocked out.
But one being continued to blaze with brilliance.
Imperium.
The Omniversal Ankyra of this Omniverse!
His golden hair flowed freely in the skies as he stood opposite an Apogee Autarch, his eyes burning with golden flames.
The stronger this Omniverse became. The more Existential Terraforming that continued. The more powerful he became!
What about this was not understood?!
Behind the Imperium Autarch, multiple Autarchical Omniversal Authorities floated grandly as he echoed out coldly.
"Come."
Causality, space, and even time were freely distorted at an Existential level- a heavy battle blooming! —
Within the Megalos Beyond.

Standing atop an obsidian disk, Ozymandias followed the lead of the Observer of Old and Young, while the figures of a Young Light Morphon and Outerversal Morphon Tabatha who continued to spare glances towards him every now and then.
But his dazzling face was that of extreme focus as the potent power of an Outerversal Morphon coursed through him.
This whole time, he sought to quantify the power of Outerversal Morphons.
What Outerversal Authority actually signified.
He knew that an Outerversal Entity at birth held the terrifying power of an Autarch, but this was too vague and not entirely accurate.
The physiology was too different. The weavings of existence were too distinct!
As an Outerversal Morphon, he understood this unique type of power the most as after acclimating with it and thoroughly breaking it down...
|The power of an Outerversal Morphon has been quantified and broken down.|
|The basis of power of an Outerversal Morphon consists of [Megalos Regnum], and [Outerversal Physiology].|
The basis of power of these terrifying beings wading across the Megalos Beyond was broken down into two parts!
Megalos Regnum and Outerversal Physiology!
Two parts that made the power of Outerversal Morphons whole...

sentences.text: [Kusanagi, Omniversal Cleaver]:: A Product made from a carefully preserved portion of a shattered Omniverse.
It holds potent weavings of Existence within it and the rank of an Average Omniversal Armament forged by A Blacksmith whose weavings resonate and emanate that of an Omniverse itself.
With a small input of Existential Authority, Kusanagi will release ten times the output while adding in trace amounts of Omniversal Authority.
With the input of Omniversal Authority, the true form of Kusanagi can be revealed- its edge sharp enough to cleave small parts of an Omniverse.
By merely holding it, your circulation, generation, and Regeneration of Existential Authority increases by 1,000%.
With every Existence put to rest with Kusanagi, you will accumulate Omniversal Rage Points that can be released as an instantaneous blast of Omniversal Rage all around you.
The more Points accumulated before the release, the more potent the release will be...
A daring weapon!
Noah grasped it in his hands as instantly, his Atlas of Existence buzzed with activity.
Tendrils of multicolored brilliance surged from the sword and onto his hands, his Atlas of Existence that now had two Mundis of Power covered with brilliance spinning just a little bit faster.
This weapon alone and the entity who made it were both extremely distinguished as they harnessed the power of an Omniverse into an extremely small tool!
|The Omniversal Weapon, Kusanagi, has been fully analyzed.
After being broken down, it is possible to mass produce Sword Type Omniversal Armaments like it from the Infinite Omniverse.
Further analysis leads to the assertion that as of this moment, Omniversal Armaments can begin their design and planning for future production within the Infinite Omniverse.|
Others had Omniversal Armaments, yes.
But he had a genuine Omniverse under his belt as he could even attack an enemy with the terrifying weight and breadth of this Omniverse!

It was one of his strongest possible attacks that came at a great cost, but it gave him confidence against any Apogee Autarch, and also made him surge with a challenging light against any Omniversal Realm Entities he would come to meet as enemies.
Would they be able to withstand being smashed with the breadth of the entire Infinite Omniverse?
|The first weapon under design and planning in the Infinite Omniverse is one suited to you, making it easier and less costly to release the breadth of the Infinite Omniverse onto your enemies.
After analysis, the modification of Ruination into an Innate Omniversal Armament has been deemed as the most opportune sequence to handle the load of the Infinite Omniverse and your own Authority.|
The voice of the Infinite Omniverse rang out in Noah's mind as many things began to be planned the moment he first came across an Omniversal Armament.
Eudemus smiled while nodding to the three Apogee Autarchs beside him.
"Take Protector Osmont to meet those within the newly established Equestris Protectors.
After some acclimating, be ready for deployment at any time..."
The last set of words were spoken to Noah as he rose.

The drops of rain smashed onto the chessboard and cottage atop this small mountain as the concentration of Existence became all that much more potent, but he nodded towards the Shield of the Commonwealth and followed the three Apogee Autarchs that he found were looking at the weapon he was given with a sharp light!
Within moments, they disappeared into the same white portal they came from as only an old man was left in this unique domain.
The rain that fell on him was instantly absorbed into his skin as he had a shrewd smile, his eyes radiating a piercing light as he looked where Noah had disappeared from.
"Another one that I cannot see the future of...interesting!"
A few words.
After they were uttered, everything faded to oblivion.
Within Noah's Natal Omniverse.
Inside the Wheel of Weavings where the golden sands of the Gladiators Arena were seeing even more blood.
|Unbelievable!
The Omniversal Ankyra of this Omniverse is standing toe to toe with a past champion from this very same Arena!
He is single handedly taking back the glory after the successive losses his compatriots faced!|
As the matches within the Gladiators Arena continued, more powerful Autarchs came out as Piety, Lilith, and Kazuhiko were among the few who were already knocked out.
But one being continued to blaze with brilliance.
Imperium.
The Omniversal Ankyra of this Omniverse!
His golden hair flowed freely in the skies as he stood opposite an Apogee Autarch, his eyes burning with golden flames.
The stronger this Omniverse became.
The more Existential Terraforming that continued.
The more powerful he became!
What about this was not understood?!
Behind the Imperium Autarch, multiple Autarchical Omniversal Authorities floated grandly as he echoed out coldly.
"Come."
Causality, space, and even time were freely distorted at an Existential level- a heavy battle blooming!
Within the Megalos Beyond.

Standing atop an obsidian disk, Ozymandias followed the lead of the Observer of Old and Young, while the figures of a Young Light Morphon and Outerversal Morphon Tabatha who continued to spare glances towards him every now and then.
But his dazzling face was that of extreme focus as the potent power of an Outerversal Morphon coursed through him.
This whole time, he sought to quantify the power of Outerversal Morphons.
What Outerversal Authority actually signified.
He knew that an Outerversal Entity at birth held the terrifying power of an Autarch, but this was too vague and not entirely accurate.
The physiology was too different.
The weavings of existence were too distinct!
As an Outerversal Morphon, he understood this unique type of power the most as after acclimating with it and thoroughly breaking it down...
|The power of an Outerversal Morphon has been quantified and broken down.|
|The basis of power of an Outerversal Morphon consists of [Megalos Regnum], and [Outerversal Physiology].|
The basis of power of these terrifying beings wading across the Megalos Beyond was broken down into two parts!
Megalos Regnum and Outerversal Physiology!
Two parts that made the power of Outerversal Morphons whole...

chapters.title: Chapter 3226 Odessos, the Grave of the Great Beyonder! II
paragraphs: [Megalos Regnum]:: A comprehensive quantification relating to the influence, reign, and achievements within the bounds of the Megalos Beyond. It is broken into numerical levels to distinguish how far one has advanced their Megalos Regnum, and how much further they have to go until the next demarcation of Regnum.

[Outerversal Physiology]:: A comprehensive quantification closely related to the number of Delegatus a Morphon has bound, along with a relation to the influence, reign, and achievements outside the bounds of the Megalos Beyond. It is broken down into numerical levels to distinguish how far one has advanced their Outerversal Physiology, and how much further they have to go until they elevate to the next level and undergo Outerversal Evolvere.
These were the two aspects that showed the power of an Outerversal Morphon, and Noah was currently just starting out as a newly born Morphon.
His will gazed at the quantification of this strength that could be displayed in his mind whenever he wished.
[Megalos Regnum Echelon 1 (10/100)]
[Outerversal Physiology Echelon 1 (95/100)]
A visualization of where he was currently at.

Of the two sources of power that made an Outerversal Morphon, Ozymandias was much more advanced with his Outerversal Physiology- nearly reaching the next Echelon of power due to the sheer number of Delegatus he bound, along with other factors he was still getting clarification on!
The Source of power of Megalos Regnum was much lower, with him just entering the Megalos Beyond as he didn't truly have any sort of reign or influence.

The only reason for the increased value of 10 was due to how events had unfolded with Outerversal Morphon Phulax and Tabatha- with him gaining their favor as they looked at what he was able to do as a Sign.
But, he now quantified and clearly knew the distinction of power of Outerversal Morphons. He now knew how to elevate it.
All that was left was for him to do what he did best- ascend past these levels of power with speed that would make others question their own Existence!
"We are here. And we luckily did not have any unforeseen forces stop us along the way."

Up front, the voice of Outerversal Morphon Phulax echoed out as the obsidian disk they were on that was rapidly distorting space slowed down, eventually coming to a stop near an area that shone with a distinct brilliance
Unlike the stellar obsidian hue covering the vast stretches of the Megalos Beyond, the area ahead of them had a translucent crimson barrier stretching out in all directions.
The barrier felt impenetrable even by the strongest Outerversal Morphon, or at the very least- Ozymandias felt that his current self could not pierce through this barrier freely if he wished!
Nothing could be seen beyond it, but the moment they came near, The Observer of Old and Young radiated his aura outwards.

An instant later, a portion of the barrier fluctuated as a circular singularity bloomed into an opening, and a titanic figure of an Entity with an elongated body and a stellar obsidian crimson head sticking out at the very top appeared.

On the head, no facial characteristics apart from two eyes that blazed with white light could be seen, this elongated being showing two limbs that closely resembled arms, with their lower body extending out and almost melding with the glory of the Megalos Beyond around them.
On one of the limbs resembling a hand, this Entity grasped a glowing crystal ball that seemed to be swirling with unfathomable waves of Existence within.
Their weavings came out in the form of an intent.
|O Great Phulax, this is a most welcomed surprise. Please, come in...|
The Observer of Old and Young seemed to hold a great status as they were invited into the opening of the stellar crimson translucent barrier.
Phulax gave a light nod as the disk they were on moved once more, with Ozymandias gazing at everything with sharp eyes as it was all under observation and analysis.
He had quantified and broken down the power of Outerversal Morphons into two aspects as he knew them about himself.
But now, he was analyzing and seeking to break down this quantification for the Outerversal Morphons around him!

Outerversal Morphon Phulax and Tabatha were far too powerful for him to get an accurate grasp, but the Young Light Morphon behind him was already nearing the last stages of analysis as he would see her progression within the first Echelon of Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum soon enough.
And now, they arrived at a place where even more samples revealed themselves for him!

He was bound to greatly increase his knowledge of Outerversal Morphons and the Megalos Beyond as after passing through the translucent crimson barrier, it felt like a brand new reality unfolded before his eyes.
|We welcome you back to Odessos, the Grave of the Great Beyonder, O Great Phulax.|
HUUM!
Waves of radiance unfolded.
The translucent barrier behind them closed as ahead, the fantastical brilliance of massive stellar crimson Pillars floating in space could be seen stretching out for light years.

Actually, even this was false as they weren't simply floating, with Ozymandias noticing a small incremental movement of these massive Pillars that seemed to be following the pull of an endlessly humongous organ that held many openings!
On top of the rotating Pillars, the aura of Outerversal Morphons similar to the one who had invited them in could be felt.
Each shone with differing stellar hues for their bodies, with their round heads only burning with two singularities for eyes as many of them turned towards their newly arriving figures.
But what was more astonishing was that Ozymandias could feel even more auras of Outerversal Morphons within the depths of the obsidian crimson organ surrounded by these massive Pillars of brilliance.
They had arrived in Odessos, the Grave of the Great Beyonder!
|Please, if you will follow me into the Heart of Misery. The Lady has heard of your arrival and welcomes you in.|
Into the Heart of Misery.
With steady steps, Ozymandias plunged into a Domain he knew very little about as a fantastical new reality unfolded around him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3227 Odessos, the Grave of the Great Beyonder! III
paragraphs: Odessos, the Grave of the Great Beyonder.
Inside the Heart of Misery.
In an area that shone with a radiant crimson brilliance, with the surroundings feeling like the interior of a pulsating artery or vein of something that was alive and well.

The lining of the surroundings was sleek and oddly slippery, but there was one central area that had budding rose petals on the floor. On these budding rose petals, two unique Outerversal Morphons could be seen.

The skin of the larger one shone with a deep stellar crimson hue as if she were carved from another part of the Megalos Beyond, her form being a cluster of pulsing tentacles that formed into two masses of circles connected by a singularity in between, while the skin of the smaller one shone with the exact glow of the obsidian stellar brilliance of the Megalos Beyond as she at times would nearly meld with the surroundings.
It was only due to the two blinding white singularities that represented her eyes on her head that one could make out her outline.

She held limbs and a form leaning more towards humanoid in nature, much of it covered with an obsidian garment as nothing within could be seen. But there were two tentacles sprouting from the top of her head and cascading past her shoulders that gave her a unique distinction.
The older entity spoke out with her intent as in her own way, she seemed to be gazing at the younger Outerversal Morphon with care.

|Out of all those born across the past cycles, you have the greatest purity and likeness to the Great Beyonder. Your purpose. Your weavings. The connection of your Physiology to the Megalos Beyond itself...all of it points to a greater purpose that I have been telling you to be ready for this whole time.|
The older voice spoke out with care.
And the Outerversal Morphon with the likeness of a humanoid form blinked with her singularities while nodding respectfully.
|Yes, Great Mother.|
The singularities lit up her face as even though she held no nose or mouth, her beauty was unfathomable to one's eyes.

|Mmm, that time may be coming. Whispers of a Sign have begun to spread as along with them...the Observer of Old and Young is making his way here. There are no coincidences. Watch carefully, and if you feel anything, let me know, O Aspasia.|
Aspasia.

This unique entity nodded her head as moments later, an area far ahead of them twisted before an opening was made on the sleek surface- the smooth muscular lining retracting as the figures of Outerversal Morphon Phulax, Tabatha, a Young Light Morphon, and Ozymandias made their entry while led by a native Outerversal Morphon of this Grave of the Great Beyonder!

As soon as he did his task of bringing them where they should be, this Morphon bowed while leaving. The Observer of Old and Young went forward freely with his hands behind his back, still in the form of an old man as he nodded towards the older Outerversal Morphon who took on the form of two circles connected by a singularity- almost adopting an infinity symbol!
"It has been some time, Great Mother." As he spoke, Phulax gave a quizzical gaze towards the visage of Aspasia beside this being.
|Far too long, Great Phulax. What brings you to our little Abode?|
What could make the Great Phulax move? Was it as she expected? Was it due to...
"I moved because of whispers. Because of the appearance of the one who can bind Existence instantly the moment they begin Alieia."
WAA!
Words that caused the Great Mother to tremble were uttered out as her tentacles expanded and contracted, a fervent light flashing on her as she asked.
|These whispers...have you seen the one in question yourself? Do you know where-|
Her intent came to a stop as the Observer of Old and Young raised his hand and pointed towards the brilliant stellar visage of Ozymandias.
"I've brought the one in question to you. I figured the devout followers of the Great Beyonder may be able to confirm things and shed some clarity more than anyone else."
The Great Mother was covered with a grander fervent light as she instantly warped to appear before Ozymandias.
His stellar brilliance.

The purple blue radiance on some parts of his skin, the crimson black stellar hue on others. His white singularities for eyes. The more she looked at him, the more mysterious he seemed as even with the profound pressure the Great Mother emanated, the singularities of this being didn't even flicker!
There wasn't even an ounce of fear.
'Could it truly be?'
Her many tentacles pulsed.
|Hello, Young One. Can you...show me?|
She voiced out towards Ozymandias.

Ozymandias who looked at this being and all the other Outerversal Morphon he came across as he continued to compile more data and information that would soon make an omniversal quantification of power more complete!
He could feel her expectations.
Her belief on something she had held onto for who knew how many cycles.
He had no problem playing on this misunderstanding!
With a light nod, his white singularities blinked and closed momentarily as behind him, nine Halos of tentacles flashed and began to swirl.
Within their very center...hundreds of threads of tentacles began to form.

Tentacles turned into fine threads as to the ever increasing shock of those watching, Ozymandias cast these hundreds of threads behind him- these threads crossing the sleek surface below them as if it didn't even exist and stretched down far towards the Megalos Beyond!
It was an astonishing scene as commonly, a single 'fishing line' would be cast before an Outerversal Morphon bound a Delegatus- with some even failing, while most took a long span of time.
But Ozymandias released hundreds of fine tentacles all at once.
And not even a moment after they were cast...
HUUUM!
They began to glow with a glorious purple blue glow one after another- night simultaneously as of the few hundred strings, not a single one was dull!
The visage of the Great Mother stumbled backwards in utter shock and elation!

chapters.title: Chapter 3228 Odessos, the Grave of the Great Beyonder! IV
paragraphs: The Observer of Old and Young became even more stern while Outerversal Morphon Tabatha began to whisper under her breath.
|The Sign...!|

Simultaneous casting and binding of Existence. No Outerversal Morphon could do this as when one who could do it appeared...the Great Beyonder had left behind many terrifying words when such a Sign came!
Amidst the shock of others, Ozymandias didn't stop.

Hundreds more tentacles formed into fine lines that were cast across the Megalos Beyond and straight towards his Infinite Omniverse, more and more Enders of Existence becoming bound to him even further as Delegatus!
He didn't stop because he could see the visible progress of his Outerversal Physiology.
At this moment, the process was tremendously close to elevating to the next Echelon!
It was...
[Outerversal Physiology Echelon 1 (99/100)]
It was almost there.
HUUM!
The glow of purple blue brilliance only intensified from him as the Great Mother stumbled back with even greater elation at the scene, her tentacles pulsing and beginning to radiate crazed laughter!
|Haha! After all this time! After all those cycles! O Great Beyonder! Are you watching this?!|

Her words radiated ancient frustration and longing, with Ozymandias shining with even grander brilliance before her as within moments, thousands of lines were cast down as they glowed with glory. Until...
BOOM!
The space above Ozymandias cracked.
From the crack, the weavings of the Megalos Beyond could be seen as their stellar obsidian brilliance turned into a malleable river at this moment.
"No way..." Outerversal Morphon Tabatha cursed under her breath at the scene.
"He was just born!"
She screamed out the stern reality in shock as this being that was just born...was actually undergoing his first Outerversal Sanctification.
|Your Outerversal Physiology has reached the maximum value and is currently undergoing an evolution of its Echelon.|
|The resource for the evolution of one's Echelon seems to be the weavings of the Megalos Beyond themselves.|
|The Value of your Megalos Regnum has increased by +2.|
|The Value of your Megalos Regnum has increased by +3...|
Many prompts flashed within the mind of Ozymandias as above him, it felt like the Megalos Beyond itself was filling up his existence as if it were a vessel.
The rivers of liquefied Megalos Beyond acted like a catalyst- like a fuel that burned and elevated the very physiology and authority of the Outerversal Morphon that was Ozymandias!
His body was compressed to become more compact, and at the same time, he knew that the maximum size he could take was increasing rapidly.
What he could do as an Outerversal Morphon was being expanded!
A large part of the obsidian stellar brilliance cascading into him flowed towards the center of his chest, something heavy blooming in such a place.
Akin to an engine being born.

His form became even more regal as after the Sanctification by the weavings of rivers of Megalos Beyond, his skin now fully carried a stellar obsidian tint, his white singularities being the only thing contrasting this brilliant darkness.
By the time he blinked, the details of his Physiology had changed in his mind.
[Outerversal Physiology Echelon 2 (1/10,000)]---[Outerversal Organs]

|Your Outerversal Physiology has attained a budding Outerversal Heart. With it, you begin to generate tremendous levels of pure Outerversal Authority that course across your existence, and the excess forms an Innate Outerversal Veil that masks and defends you against your enemies. The stronger your Outerversal Physiology becomes, the more Outerversal Organs will be formed, and the stronger already existing Outerversal Organs become.|
An elevation of an Echelon in terms of his Outerversal Physiology.
Due to elevation, he naturally unlocked the feature of Outerversal Organs as the level of power he wielded was steadily rising!
And this was only the beginning.
He had yet to bind the Infinite Omniverse as he was only waiting for all calculations to show absolutely no chance of errors or possible mistakes before he proceeded with it.
The only setback was the value needed before the next Echelon of Outerversal Physiology could elevate.

Reaching the cap of 100 of the first Echelon had taken tens of thousands of bound Delegatus, and he Innately sensed that accumulating this value the higher up he went would be more arduous, with the contribution of Delegatus aiding to its increase slowly reducing the higher up it went.
But he wasn't too worried about this.
There were quintillions of beings in his Infinite Omniverse. By the time he bound all of them, just where would he be in terms of his Physiology?
|Astonishing...|

As his transformation came to an end, the Great Mother came close to him as a dozen tentacles erupted from her that came inches away from his skin, but never fully touching him as if she didn't dare to.
In the distance, The Observer of Old and Young raised his brows as he voiced out calmly.
"Well, is he truly the Sign? And can it be inferred that he is the instrument of the final destruction or expansion of the Megalos Beyond?"
His words poured cold water over the austere surroundings as the Great Mother's tentacles became stern.
She looked with dissatisfaction towards Outerversal Morphon Phulax before she voiced out.

|The Words the Great Beyonder left before disappearing were many, and they all favored expansion and never before seen brilliance of the Megalos Beyond. And he...is undoubtedly the Sign that was promised all those cycles ago. As for whether he is the Instrument itself...|
The Great Mother stopped.
Her tentacles turned behind her, on the crimson red petals at the center of this Domain where a humanoid Outerversal Morphon with magisterial beauty had remained silent and calm this whole time.
|Little Aspasia here will be able to confirm for us. She holds the purest form of inheritance of the Great Beyonder, and carries their will inside her body. She will be able to confi-|
BOOOM!
An immeasurably heavy explosion carried by intense vibrations echoed out.
The gaze of the Great Mother became stern while the Observer of Old and Young sighed.
Moments later, the smooth muscular linings of this Domain once more opened as the Outerversal Morphon who had let the party of Ozymandias here came in and spoke with a bow!
|Great Mother, a few Heretical Morphons have gathered outside Beyonder's Boundary. They seek forceful entry to confirm whether we know anything regarding the Sign.|
There were those who believed in the words of the Great Beyonder with hope and valor.
And there were those who believed in them...but they were not filled with hope.
Based on what was at stake, they interpreted the words of the Beyonder in a different way.
The instrument that would bring destruction or expansion...they could erase it before it began budding as this would keep the state of the Megalos Beyond as it was!
The followers of the Great Beyonder referred to them as the Heretical Morphons...

chapters.title: Chapter 3229 A Following!
paragraphs: |Heretical Morphons...|
The Great Mother released her intent with a hum as one could Innately feel like her tentacles forming the body of an Infinity symbol were smiling on all angles.
Ever since Ozymandias ascertained the weavings of the Sign, her entire demeanor had changed as a reverential look of utmost belief took over her entire existence.

|Haha, any efforts they make will be obsolete. Once the Sign appears, everything that comes after cannot be stopped. The future that the Great Beyonder painted...will undoubtedly unfold in a glorious direction.|
She spoke with such confidence and valor that the Outerversal Morphon who was acting as the messenger paused and blinked before he continued.
|But Great Mother...dozens of Heretical Morphons have already gathered. Some of them with the Distinctions of [Great] just like you. They...|
|They will struggle endlessly, but what is meant to pass...| The Great Mother spoke reverentially as tendrils left her body to caress the obsidian radiance radiating from Ozymandias.

|Child...there are many things that are coming. If I can give you any advice- it is that you must trust yourself absolutely. You should still be forming your purpose as you are told that you are a Sign, and even possibly the Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of. Can you humor an old thing like me and trust in the possibility of this? Can you shed light on who you are?|
She asked earnestly.
Ozymandias looked at this Entity who seemed to have found something she had been looking for all her life, sighing internally as he knew that he wasn't some promised chosen or instrument.
But it seemed...his path of power could be streamlined if he took on this identity!
After all, part of the power of an Outerversal Morphon was the Megalos Regnum.
The influence and achievements within the Megalos Beyond.
If he rose to become some grand instrument that terrifying Entities looked for or feared...this would naturally aid in his influence and achievements!
So he looked at the Great Mother and spoke out calmly with his intent. |I am Ozymandias, and my purpose is the Megalos Beyond itself. In this, I have no doubt.|
Simple words. And yet...
|Ah...| The Great Mother vibrated with euphoria as her intent echoed out.
His purpose was the Megalos Beyond itself. Did this not conform with the Instrument that would expand the Megalos Beyond in a way nobody could even imagine?!
The weavings of the Great Mother became even more potent as she began to direct things commandingly.

|Little Aspasia, we will leave you to ascertain with surety the distinction of Ozymandias. Since he is for sure the Sign, from this day forth, he shall be distinguished as the Dream of the Beyonder- the Young Master of the Grave of the Great Beyonder!|
BOOM!
A grandiose distinction.
The moment it came, Noah's body radiated with obsidian luminescence as many prompts arose!
|You have gained the distinction of the Dream of the Beyonder.|
|Your influence within a concentrated area of the Megalos Beyond has risen greatly.|
|The Value of your Megalos Regnum has increased by +80...|
|The Value of your Megalos Regnum has increased by +200...|
|The Value of your Megalos Regnum has increased by +950...|
|The Value of your Megalos Regnum has exceeded the limits of the first Echelon.|
Limitations were broken.
Above, space was cut open once more as incandescent rivers of the Megalos Beyond gushed onto Ozymandias.
[Megalos Regnum Echelon 2 (2,360/10,000)]---[Megalos Willpower]
He stepped on another Echelon as something new was unlocked!
Before he could look over it, the Great Mother spoke once more as one could see her silent smile as the brighter waves of incandescence around Ozymandias.

|Mmm, Great Phulax, will you come with me to stretch your muscles a little? I assume you will want to continue observing the growth of the Dream of the Beyonder. Whether he is truly what I wholly believe he is, or the impossible chance that I am wrong.|
Off to the side, the powerful Observer of Old and Young shook his head with a sigh as he took a step and disappeared, only leaving behind his voice as he pulled Outerversal Morphon Tabatha along.
"Let us go, I can already sense some old friends who shouldn't have been all that riled up about this."
The Great Phulax went out first.
The Great Mother beamed at this scene as her tentacles nodded towards the graceful and impeccable visage of Aspasia behind them.
|I leave it to you, Little Aspasia. Channel everything you feel with your existence, and see if we can get your affirmation regarding Young Master Ozymandias as well.|
HUUM!
With a flicker of obsidian brilliance, she also disappeared along with the Outerversal Morphon that brought over the news.
Inside this Domain where the linings pulsed as if they were inside a living organ, only Ozymandias, the Young Light Morphon, and Aspasia were left behind.

The Young Light Morphon looked at the unfolding scene with great curiosity as I'm the next moment, the silent Aspasia began floating with her astonishing figure that seemed full of mysteries and grandeur towards Ozymandias.
|Hello.|
Her intent was akin to a fresh breeze.
Ozymandias gazed at the similar white singularities that were her eyes as he replied.
|Hello.|

A single word of exchange as soon enough, Aspasia was floating beside him, her obsidian garment that covered her stellar visage radiating a terrifying authority that seemed connected with the Megalos Beyond itself as she uttered out calmly.
|With your permission, I must connect with your Outerversal and Megalos Weavings fully...|

As she spoke, her obsidian robe unclasped and revealed an astonishing figure of stellar brilliance underneath, Ozymandias raising his brows as the two tentacles stemming off of her head and past her shoulders moved like limbs towards him.
Her blessed chest and curved waist were the least of things to focus on in front of these dazzling tentacles.
Off to the side, the Light Morphon was ever so curious as she observed this unfolding scene!
